mandarin_meaning: 色情片；成人影片
english_meaning: pornographic film; adult movie
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，通常指帶有性內容的影片或成人電影，語氣偏口語或帶貶義。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang for pornographic or adult films. Informal and can be derogatory or vulgar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺我間房度播鹹片！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 gaan1 fong2 dou6 bok3 haam4 pin3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在我的房間播放色情片！
examples.english_sentence: Don't play pornographic films in my room!

mandarin_meaning: 咸牛肉（腌制或罐装的牛肉），拼音：xián niúròu
english_meaning: salted or cured beef; corned beef (often canned)
explanation_mandarin: 指用鹽或醃製方法處理的牛肉，口語中常指罐頭或醃製過的“corned beef”。在香港常見罐裝鹹牛肉可用作三文治或炒菜材料。
explanation_english: Refers to beef preserved with salt or curing methods; commonly denotes corned beef, including canned corned beef. In Hong Kong it is often used in sandwiches or cooked dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有罐裝鹹牛肉，我買咗返嚟做三文治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 gwaan3 zong1 haam4 ngau4 juk6, ngo5 maai5 zo2 faan1 lai4 zou6 saam1 man4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有罐装的咸牛肉，我买了回來做三明治。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket had canned corned beef; I bought some to make sandwiches.

mandarin_meaning: 表面清純、實際好色或下流的人
english_meaning: a person who pretends to be innocent but is actually lecherous or dirty
explanation_mandarin: 「鹹」在粵語俚語中常有好色或下流的含義，「白鴿」象徵清純。合起來用以形容表面看似清純、實際上卻很好色或下流的人，屬香港口語俚語。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, "haam" (salty) can imply lecherous or vulgar, while a "white pigeon" suggests innocence. "Haam baak gap" describes someone who appears innocent but is actually lecherous or dirty; a Hong Kong colloquial slang term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇落好乖，其實係隻鹹白鴿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 lok6 hou2 gwaai1, kei4 sat6 hai6 zek3 haam4 baak6 gap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起來很乖，其實是個裝作清純的好色鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He looks well-behaved, but actually he's a lecher who pretends to be innocent.

mandarin_meaning: 帶有猥褻、好色意味的表情或樣子
english_meaning: a lecherous or sleazy look; an appearance or expression that gives off a lewd vibe
explanation_mandarin: 「鹹相」是廣東話俗語，用來形容一個人的表情或樣子讓人覺得有點下流、好色或猥褻，常用來批評他人舉止或眼神。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, '鹹相' describes an expression or appearance that seems lewd, sleazy, or pervy. It’s often used to criticize someone’s demeanour, facial expression, or the way they look at others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對女仔咁樣笑，好有鹹相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 deoi3 neoi5 zai2 gam2 joeng6 siu3, hou2 jau5 haam4 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常對女孩子那樣笑，看起來很猥瑣／好色。
examples.english_sentence: He always smiles at girls like that; he looks very lecherous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好擺嗰啲鹹相啦，嚇親人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 baai2 go2 di1 haam4 soeng2 laa1, haak3 can1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要擺出那種鹹相，會嚇到別人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make that lecherous face; you'll scare people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友個樣有啲鹹相，唔係幾可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau5 go3 joeng6 jau5 di1 haam4 soeng2, m4 hai6 gei2 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個人的樣子有點鹹相，不太可信。
examples.english_sentence: That guy looks a bit sleazy; not very trustworthy.

mandarin_meaning: 盛放醬油或其他咸味調味料的小碟子
english_meaning: a small saucer/dipping dish used for soy sauce or other salty condiments
explanation_mandarin: 「鹹碟」指用來盛放醬油、醋等咸味調味料的小碟子，常見於港式飲食場合，如茶樓、酒樓等。屬日常用語，語氣中性。
explanation_english: “鹹碟” refers to a small dish used to hold soy sauce, vinegar, or other salty condiments. It is commonly seen in Cantonese dining settings (e.g., dim sum restaurants). The term is neutral and used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去飲茶嘅時候，侍應畀咗我哋每人一隻鹹碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 jam2 caa4 ge3 si4 hau6, si6 jing3 bei2 zo2 ngo5 dei6 mui5 jan4 jat1 zek3 haam4 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去喝早茶的時候，服務員給了我們每人一只小碟子（用來放醬油）。
examples.english_sentence: When we went for dim sum, the waiter gave each of us a small saucer for soy sauce.

mandarin_meaning: 色狼 / 好色的人
english_meaning: pervert; lecherous person
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容言行、目光或舉止猥褻、好色的人，常帶貶義，口語用法。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone whose words, looks, or behaviour are lewd or lecherous. Derogatory and colloquial; can be used as a noun or adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個男仔好鹹粒，見到女仔成日鬼祟咁望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 naam4 zai2 hou2 haam4 lap1, gin3 dou3 neoi5 zai2 sing4 jat6 gwai2 seot1 gam2 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男孩很猥琐，看到女生就偷偷地盯着看。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is such a perv; he sneaks glances whenever he sees girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢講呢啲話題，佢聽落就顯得好鹹粒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 ni1 di1 waa6 tai4, keoi5 teng1 lok6 zau6 hin2 dak1 hou2 haam4 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要跟他说这些话题，他一听就显得很好色。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bring up those topics with him; he gets lecherous when he hears them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人話係鹹粒，都係因為啲言行令人唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jan4 waa6 hai6 haam4 lap1, dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 di1 jin4 hang4 ling6 jan4 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人说是鹹粒，是因为言行让人不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He's been called a '鹹粒' because his words and behaviour make people uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 色情網站；含有下流或不雅內容的網絡平台
english_meaning: pornographic website; online content/sites that are lewd or obscene
explanation_mandarin: 「鹹網」是香港粵語的俚語，用來指代包含色情或下流內容的網站或網上內容，也可泛指不雅的網路資訊。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term referring to websites or online content that are pornographic, lewd, or obscene; used to denote adult-oriented or inappropriate online material.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日上鹹網，成日睇啲唔適合未成年嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 soeng5 haam4 mong5, sing4 jat6 tai2 di1 m4 sik1 hap6 mei6 sing4 nin4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常上色情網站，總是看一些不適合未成年人的東西。
examples.english_sentence: He often visits porn websites and keeps looking at things that aren't suitable for minors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀細路上鹹網，記得開家長監護或過濾軟件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 sai3 lou6 soeng5 haam4 mong5, gei3 dak1 hoi1 gaa1 zoeng2 gam1 wu6 wok6 gwo3 lok6 jyun5 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要讓小孩子上色情網站，記得開啟家長監護或過濾軟件。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let children access porn websites; remember to enable parental controls or filtering software.

mandarin_meaning: 咸肉 / 腌制的猪肉
english_meaning: salted meat; salted pork; cured pork
explanation_mandarin: 指用鹽或其他調味料醃製、風乾或煙燻的豬肉，常作為配料或保存肉類的方法。粤語中常指傳統的鹹豬肉或臘味的一類。
explanation_english: Refers to pork that has been salted and preserved (sometimes cured, air-dried, or smoked). Commonly used as an ingredient or preserved meat in Cantonese cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食鹹肉炒飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 haam4 juk6 caau2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃咸肉炒饭。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating salted pork fried rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽每年冬天整鹹肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 mui5 nin4 dung1 tin1 zing2 haam4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈每年冬天腌制咸肉。
examples.english_sentence: My mother cures salted meat every winter.

mandarin_meaning: 咸肉粽（包有咸肉的粽子）
english_meaning: salty (savory) pork zongzi (rice dumpling wrapped in leaves)
explanation_mandarin: 鹹肉粽是一種粽子，通常以糯米包裹咸肉（或臘肉），用竹葉或蘆葦葉包紮後蒸或煮熟，常見於端午節及華人傳統飲食中。
explanation_english: A savory zongzi (rice dumpling) filled with salty pork (often preserved or cured pork), wrapped in bamboo or reed leaves and steamed or boiled. Commonly eaten during the Dragon Boat Festival and in Chinese culinary traditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 端午節我哋會食鹹肉粽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dyun1 ng5 zit3 ngo5 dei6 wui5 sik6 ham4 juk6 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 端午节我们会吃咸肉粽。
examples.english_sentence: We eat salty pork zongzi during the Dragon Boat Festival.

mandarin_meaning: 咸脆花生；（俚語）看熱鬧的旁觀者/吃瓜群眾
english_meaning: salted crispy peanuts; (slang) a bystander who enjoys watching gossip/controversy
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是指一種鹹脆的花生零食；在廣東話口語中也作俚語，形容那些只在一旁看熱鬧、享受八卦但不介入的人，類似“吃瓜群眾”或“看熱鬧的人”。
explanation_english: Literally a salted, crispy peanut snack. In Cantonese slang it also refers to onlookers who enjoy watching gossip or controversy without getting involved — similar to '吃瓜群众' or 'bystanders enjoying the spectacle'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗袋鹹脆花生，喺屋企睇電視當零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 doi2 haam4 ceoi3 faa1 sang1, hai2 uk1 kei5 tai2 din6 si6 dong3 ling4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一袋咸脆花生，在家看电视当零食。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bag of salted crispy peanuts to snack on while watching TV at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁嘈，我哋唔好淨係做鹹脆花生，應該出手幫下忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam2 cau2, ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zou6 haam4 ceoi3 faa1 sang1, jing1 goi1 ceot1 sau2 bong1 haa5 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么吵，我们不要只是当看热闹的吃瓜群众，应该出手帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so chaotic; we shouldn't just be bystanders enjoying the spectacle (鹹脆花生), we should step in and help.

mandarin_meaning: 下流、猥褻、低俗
english_meaning: lewd; vulgar; indecent
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人、言語或內容帶有性暗示、低俗或猥褻的意味，帶有貶義。
explanation_english: Describes a person, speech, or content that is lewd, vulgar, or indecent—often with sexual undertones; pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲笑話太鹹臭，唔好再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu3 waa6 taai3 haam4 cau3, m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些笑話太下流了，不要再說了。
examples.english_sentence: Those jokes are too lewd; don't tell them anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲影片好鹹臭，未夠年紀嘅唔好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jing2 pin3 hou2 haam4 cau3, mei6 gau3 nin4 gei2 ge3 m4 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些影片很猥褻，未成年的不要看。
examples.english_sentence: These videos are very indecent; minors shouldn't watch them.

mandarin_meaning: 又鹹又苦（味道）；比喻苦澀、艱辛的感受或經歷
english_meaning: salty and bitter (taste); figuratively: bitter, hard, or astringent experience
explanation_mandarin: 可指食物同時帶有鹹味與苦味；也可作比喻，形容生活或回憶帶有苦澀、艱辛的感受。
explanation_english: Can describe food that is both salty and bitter; figuratively it describes experiences, memories, or life that feel bitter, astringent, or hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯食落鹹苦，可能放太多鹽同藥材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 sik6 lok6 haam4 fu2, ho2 nang4 fong3 taai3 do1 jim4 tung4 joek6 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這碗湯吃起來又鹹又苦，可能放太多鹽和藥材。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup tastes salty and bitter; maybe too much salt and herbs were added.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近日子真係好鹹苦，成日加班又冇錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jat6 zi2 zan1 hai6 hou2 haam4 fu2, sing4 jat6 gaa1 baan1 jau6 mou5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近日子真的很苦，很辛苦，總是加班又沒錢。
examples.english_sentence: Life's been really rough lately—always working overtime and having no money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽佢講起當年嘅事，仲帶住一種鹹苦嘅滋味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 keoi5 gong2 hei2 dong1 nin4 ge3 si6, zung6 daai3 zyu6 jat1 zung2 haam4 fu2 ge3 zi1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽他講起當年的事，還帶著一種鹹苦的滋味。
examples.english_sentence: When he talks about those years, there's still a salty‑bitter feeling to it.

mandarin_meaning: 咸菜（腌制的蔬菜，例如酸菜、芥菜等）
english_meaning: salted/pickled vegetables (preserved vegetables often used as a side dish or condiment)
explanation_mandarin: 指用鹽腌製或醃製的蔬菜（如酸菜、芥菜等），常作為配菜或調味品，也可指罐裝或瓶裝的醃製蔬菜。
explanation_english: Refers to vegetables preserved with salt or brine (e.g., pickled mustard greens); commonly used as a side dish or condiment, and can refer to jarred or bottled pickles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意食鹹菜配白飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 haam4 coi3 pui3 baak6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡吃咸菜配白飯。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating pickled vegetables with plain rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢罐鹹菜係香港超市買嘅，幾好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gun3 haam4 coi3 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ciu1 si5 maai5 ge3, gei2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這罐咸菜是在香港超市買的，挺好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This jar of pickles was bought at a Hong Kong supermarket; it's quite tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 寒酸西装；廉价俗气的西装
english_meaning: a cheap, tacky, or shabby suit
explanation_mandarin: 俚語，用來形容西裝質料差、做工粗糙或款式俗氣、穿着邋遢，帶有貶義。
explanation_english: A slang term used to describe a suit that looks cheap, poorly made, tacky, or shabby; pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著嗰套真係鹹菜西裝，成件衫睇落好廉價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 go2 tou3 zan1 hai6 haam4 coi3 sai1 zong1, sing4 gin6 saam1 tai2 lok6 hou2 lim4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿的那套真是寒酸西装，整件衣服看起来很廉价。
examples.english_sentence: The suit he's wearing is really tacky — the whole outfit looks very cheap.

mandarin_meaning: 咸蛋 (xián dàn)，通常指腌制的鸭蛋
english_meaning: salted egg (usually a duck egg cured in salt or brine)
explanation_mandarin: 經過鹽漬或鹼鹽混合腌制的蛋，通常為鴨蛋。蛋白較結實，蛋黃油潤且風味濃郁，常用於烹飪、調味或做糕點餡料。
explanation_english: An egg (usually a duck egg) preserved by curing in salt or brine. The white becomes firmer and the yolk turns oily and flavorful; commonly used in cooking, seasoning, or as a filling in pastries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食鹹蛋炒飯，鹹蛋黃好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 haam4 daan6 caau2 faan6, haam4 daan6 wong4 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃咸蛋炒饭，咸蛋黄很香。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat salted egg fried rice; the salted egg yolk is very fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲鹹蛋係用海鹽腌嘅，蛋黃仲好流心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 haam4 daan6 hai6 jung6 hoi2 jim4 aam3 ge3, daan6 wong4 zung6 hou2 lau4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些咸蛋是用海盐腌的，蛋黄还很流心。
examples.english_sentence: These salted eggs are cured with sea salt; the yolks are still nicely runny.

jyutping: haam4 daan6 bou1 tong1 — sam1 dou1 sat6
mandarin_meaning: 鹹蛋燉湯——心裡踏實／安心（俚語，表示感到放心或有保障）
english_meaning: Salted egg in the soup — feeling reassured/secure (slang; expresses a sense of relief or being put at ease)
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句香港粵語的俚語，用隱喻的方式表達因為得到保障或滿足而感到安心、踏實。字面上把鹹蛋放入煲湯比喻為讓人心裡有底、放心的情況，常用作感嘆或形容心情。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang expression that metaphorically says one feels reassured or secure — as if adding a salted egg to soup makes the heart 'solid'. It’s used to express relief or a sense of being put at ease, often jokingly or colloquially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到銀行批到按揭，真係鹹蛋煲湯——心都實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 ngan4 hong4 pai1 dou3 on3 gik1, zan1 hai6 haam4 daan6 bou1 tong1 — sam1 dou1 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到銀行批准按揭，我真的感到安心踏實。
examples.english_sentence: When I heard the bank approved the mortgage, I really felt reassured.

mandarin_meaning: 咸蛋黄 (xián dàn huáng)
english_meaning: salted egg yolk; salted duck egg yolk (culinary ingredient and flavor)
explanation_mandarin: 指經過鹽漬處理的蛋黃（多為鴨蛋黃），在華人料理中常用作餡料或調味，質地油潤、綿密且帶有鮮鹹風味，也常作為「鹹蛋黃口味」的調味概念出現。
explanation_english: Refers to the yolk of a salted (typically duck) egg, used widely in Chinese cuisine as an ingredient or flavoring. It has a rich, oily, crumbly texture and savory umami taste, and is used in fillings, sauces, and as a popular 'salted egg yolk' flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食鹹蛋黃月餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 haam4 daan6 wong4 jyut6 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡吃咸蛋黄月餅。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating salted egg yolk mooncakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有一罐鹹蛋黃醬，可以拌麵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 gun3 haam4 daan6 wong4 zoeng3, ho2 ji5 bun6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里面有一罐咸蛋黄酱，可以拌面。
examples.english_sentence: There is a jar of salted egg yolk paste in the kitchen; it can be mixed with noodles.

mandarin_meaning: 咸虾（咸虾干、腌制或晒干的虾，用作调味料）
english_meaning: salted shrimp (dried or preserved shrimp used as a seasoning/condiment)
explanation_mandarin: 鹹蝦指經過鹽漬或曬乾的蝦，常用作廣東菜、潮汕菜等的調味材料，能增加鮮味和香氣。有時亦可指製成的鹹蝦醬或調味料的一部分。
explanation_english: Salted shrimp refers to shrimp that have been preserved by salting or drying. Common in Cantonese and other southern Chinese cuisines, it is used as a seasoning or condiment to add umami and aroma. It can also appear in the form of salted shrimp paste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日用鹹蝦嚟炒菜，成日都好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 jung6 haam4 haa1 lai4 caau2 coi3, sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈经常用咸虾来炒菜，味道很香。
examples.english_sentence: My mother often uses salted shrimp when stir-frying dishes; they always taste very fragrant.

mandarin_meaning: 好色的（人）；（口語）指像色狼般行為或說話
english_meaning: a lecher/pervert (slang); to act like a lecher
explanation_mandarin: 「鹹蝦撐」是廣東話粗口、口語用法，通常用來形容好色、愛說下流話或行為令人不舒服的人（尤指年長或猥褻的男性），也可用作動詞，叫人不要做出這種行為。
explanation_english: “鹹蝦撐” is Cantonese slang (vulgar/colloquial). It describes a lecherous person who makes obscene remarks or behaves creepily (often an older man). It can be used as a noun or a verb telling someone to stop acting like a perv.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做鹹蝦撐啦，咁講嘢好尷尬㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 haam4 haa1 caang1 laa1, gam2 gong2 je5 hou2 gaan1-gaak3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別做鹹蝦撐了，這樣說話很尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act like a perv, saying things like that is really awkward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到街上有個鹹蝦撐一直望住個女仔，我哋覺得好噁心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 gaai1 soeng6 jau5 go3 haam4 haa1 caang1 jat1 zik6 mong6 zyu6 go3 neoi5 zai2, ngo5 dei6 gok3 dak1 hou2 ngo6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到街上有個鹹蝦撐一直盯著那女生，我們覺得很噁心。
examples.english_sentence: We saw a perv on the street staring at the girl nonstop — it made us feel gross.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司講鹹嘢，大家都叫佢唔好做鹹蝦撐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 gong2 haam4 je5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 zou6 haam4 haa1 caang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常在公司說下流話，大家都叫他別做鹹蝦撐。
examples.english_sentence: He often makes lewd comments at the office; everyone keeps telling him not to be a perv.

mandarin_meaning: 好色之徒；愛說下流或有猥褻舉止的人
english_meaning: a lecher; a pervert; a dirty-minded person (often used derogatorily)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，帶貶義，用來形容喜歡講鹹濕話或有猥褻／好色行為的人，常用以指中老年或愛開下流玩笑的人。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang (derogatory) for a lecherous or dirty-minded person who makes crude sexual remarks or behaves in a pervy way; often used for older men or those who tell bawdy jokes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲鹹濕嘅笑話，真係一個鹹蝦燦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 haam4 sap1 ge3 siu3 waa6, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 haam4 haa1 caan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是講些下流笑話，真是一個好色之徒。
examples.english_sentence: He always tells lewd jokes; he's really a lecher.

mandarin_meaning: 好色的人；好色之徒；色狼（粵語俚語）
english_meaning: a lecherous person; pervert; 'lecher' (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「鹹蟲」是廣東話口語，字面上為「鹹的昆蟲」，實際用來貶稱對異性好色、行為猥褻或有性騷擾傾向的人。
explanation_english: "鹹蟲" is a Cantonese colloquial/slang term (literally "salty insect") used pejoratively to describe someone who is lecherous or behaves in a sexually inappropriate or predatory way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個阿伯成日喺公園度望住啲女仔，真係個鹹蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 aa3 baak3 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 jyun4 dou6 mong6 zyu6 di1 neoi5 zai2, zan1 hai6 go3 ham4 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個老伯經常在公園盯著女孩，真是個好色之徒。
examples.english_sentence: That old man keeps staring at the girls in the park; he's such a pervert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做鹹蟲啦，尊重一下其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 ham4 cung4 laa1, zyun1 zung6 jat1 haa5 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別當鹹蟲了，尊重一下別人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a pervert—show some respect to other people.

mandarin_meaning: 咸豆（用盐腌制或加盐调味的豆类小吃或配料）
english_meaning: salted beans (beans preserved or seasoned with salt; a snack or condiment)
explanation_mandarin: 指用鹽腌製或加鹽調味的豆類食品或配料，如鹹豌豆、鹹豆角等，可作下酒菜或小食。
explanation_english: Refers to beans that are salted or preserved with salt, used as a snack or a condiment (e.g., salted peas or pickled beans); commonly served with drinks or as a side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食鹹豆，特別係同啤酒一齊食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 haam4 dau6, dak6 bit6 hai6 tung4 be1 zau2 jat1 cai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃咸豆，特别是和啤酒一起吃。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating salted beans, especially with beer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鹹豆通常用嚟配粥或者當小食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haam4 dau6 tung1 soeng4 jung6 lai4 pui3 zuk1 waak6 ze2 dong1 siu2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 咸豆通常用来配粥或者当零食。
examples.english_sentence: Salted beans are usually used to accompany congee or eaten as a snack.

mandarin_meaning: 喜欢说下流话或讲黄色笑话的人
english_meaning: a person who makes lewd/sexually suggestive remarks; dirty-mouthed/lechery
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容一個人經常說下流或帶有色情暗示的話，含貶義，常用於抱怨或取笑他人的言語行為。
explanation_english: A colloquial, pejorative term describing someone who frequently makes lewd or sexually suggestive remarks; used to complain about or mock a person's dirty/sexually explicit talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講黃色笑話，真係鹹豬嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 wong4 sik1 siu3 waa6, zan1 hai6 haam4 zyu1 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常讲黄色笑话，真是个好色的人。
examples.english_sentence: He often tells dirty jokes — he's really a dirty-mouthed/lechery person.

mandarin_meaning: 色狼；猥亵者（在公共场合摸人或性騷擾的人）
english_meaning: a groper; a molester who gropes or inappropriately touches others (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容在公共場合對他人做出猥褻或非禮行為的人。可作為辱罵或描述行為的詞語，在香港常見。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who gropes or molest others (often in public). It can be used as an insult or to describe the act of sexually inappropriate touching; commonly used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做鹹豬手啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 haam4 zyu1 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當色狼！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a groper!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朋友話喺巴士被一個鹹豬手摸，要報警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pang4 jau5 waa6 hai2 baa1 si2 bei6 jat1 go3 haam4 zyu1 sau2 mo2, jiu3 bou3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我朋友說在公車上被一個色狼摸了，要報警。
examples.english_sentence: My friend said she was groped on the bus by a pervert; she should call the police.

mandarin_meaning: 有些害羞、臉紅、腼腆的樣子
english_meaning: slightly embarrassed; bashful; sheepish
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容因害羞或尷尬而臉紅、腼腆、不好意思的樣子，帶有輕微羞澀的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a slight feeling of embarrassment or bashfulness, often accompanied by blushing and a shy or sheepish demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到讚佢件衫好靚，就鹹赧赧咁笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 zaan3 keoi5 gin6 saam1 hou2 leng3, zau6 haam4 naam5 naam5 gam2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到別人稱讚他的衣服漂亮，就有些害羞地笑了。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard people praise his clothes, he gave a slightly embarrassed smile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，見到陌生人佢會鹹赧赧，唔敢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, gin3 dou3 mak6 sang1 jan4 keoi5 wui5 haam4 naam5 naam5, m4 gam2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候，他看到陌生人會有些害羞，不敢說話。
examples.english_sentence: As a child, he would get shy around strangers and not dare to speak.

mandarin_meaning: 下流、鹹濕（指言行帶有性暗示或猥褻）
english_meaning: lewd; bawdy; risqué; sexually suggestive or dirty-minded
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，通常用來形容言談或行為帶有性暗示、下流或猥褻的性質，也可用作責備某人好色或講黃色笑話。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term used to describe speech or behavior that is sexually suggestive, lewd, or indecent; often used to criticize someone for being crude, dirty-minded, or making sexual jokes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲鹹酸嘢，真係好討厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 haam4 syun1 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 tou2 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常說些鹹酸的話，真是很討厭。
examples.english_sentence: He always says lewd things; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁鹹酸啦，講正經嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 haam4 syun1 laa1, gong2 zing3 ging1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別那麼鹹酸，說點正經的話吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so lewd; talk about something serious.

mandarin_meaning: 咸酸菜 / 醃制的酸菜（鹹味）
english_meaning: salted/sour pickled vegetables (pickled greens)
explanation_mandarin: 指以鹽、鹽水或發酵等方法醃製成帶鹹、帶酸口味的蔬菜，常用作配菜或加入湯、粥中。常見材料包括芥菜等葉菜類。
explanation_english: Vegetables preserved by salting/pickling so they become salty and sour. Commonly used as a side dish or added to soups and congee; often made from mustard greens or similar leafy vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我媽煲咗鹹酸菜湯，真係好開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maa1 bou3 zo2 haam4 syun1 coi3 tong1, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈煮了咸酸菜汤，真的很开胃。
examples.english_sentence: My mom made pickled vegetable soup; it's really appetizing.

mandarin_meaning: 咸味菜肴；咸菜/下饭菜
english_meaning: salty/savoury dishes; savory side dishes served with rice or congee
explanation_mandarin: 指帶有咸味的菜餚，通常作為主食（如白飯、粥）的配菜或下飯菜，為粵語常用說法。
explanation_english: Refers to salty or savory dishes typically served as accompaniments to staple foods (such as rice or congee). It's a common Cantonese term for side dishes that are savory rather than sweet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝冇鹹餸，淨係得一碗白粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 mou5 haam4 sung3, zing6 hai6 dak1 jat1 wun2 baak6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上没有咸菜/咸味菜，只有一碗白粥。
examples.english_sentence: There were no savory side dishes this morning, only a bowl of plain congee.

mandarin_meaning: 咸鱼（xiányú），指用鹽醃製的魚；俚語中指沒有上進心或消極放棄努力的人
english_meaning: salted fish (literally); slang for a person who is unambitious, passive, or has given up — also used in the phrase 'salted-fish revival' meaning a comeback
explanation_mandarin: 『鹹魚』原指經過鹽漬保存的魚（食品）。在廣東話俚語裡常用來形容人消極、沒上進心或放棄努力。常見的衍生說法有『鹹魚翻生』，表示絕處逢生、東山再起或重獲機會。
explanation_english: Literally a salted/preserved fish. In Cantonese slang it describes someone who is passive, lacks ambition, or has given up trying. The related expression '鹹魚翻生' ('salted-fish revival') means to make a comeback or be revived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗鹹魚嚟煮粥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 haam4 jyu4 lei4 zyu2 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚買了鹹魚來煮粥。
examples.english_sentence: I bought salted fish tonight to make congee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己係條鹹魚，冇心機搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 tiu4 haam4 jyu4, mou5 sam1 gei1 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己是咸魚，沒有動力找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He says he's a 'salted fish' — he has no motivation to look for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過呢次訓練，啲球員終於鹹魚翻生，表現好咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 ni1 ci3 fan3 lin6, di1 kau4 jyun4 zung1 jyu1 haam4 jyu4 faan1 saang1, biu2 jin2 hou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過這次訓練，球員終於鹹魚翻身，表現變好了。
examples.english_sentence: After this training, the players finally made a comeback — their performance improved.

mandarin_meaning: 鹹魚架、用來掛或晾鹹魚的欄；（口語、少見）比喻消極、沒鬥志的人或一群人（非標準用法）
english_meaning: a rack/rail for hanging salted fish; (colloquial, rare) figuratively a person or group that is passive/unambitious
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指用來掛、晾或存放鹹魚的欄架。口語中偶爾被戲稱為比喻用語，用來形容消極、不上進的人或一群沒有作為的人，但此用法並不普遍或正式。
explanation_english: Literally a rail or rack used to hang, dry, or store salted fish. Colloquially and rarely used figuratively to describe someone (or a group) who is passive or lacks ambition. This figurative usage is informal and not widespread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊街有個鹹魚欄，啲鹹魚晒到好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 gaai1 jau5 go3 haam4 jyu4 laan4, di1 haam4 jyu4 saai3 dou3 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老街上有個鹹魚欄，鹹魚曬得很香。
examples.english_sentence: There's a salted-fish rack on the old street; the salted fish smell very fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做鹹魚欄，要有衝勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 haam4 jyu4 laan4, jiu3 jau5 cung1 gan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當鹹魚欄，要有衝勁。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a 'salted-fish rack' — have some drive.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：鹹魚和白菜；引申：形容食物簡陋、寒酸，或比喻價值低、微不足道、家境清貧
english_meaning: Literally 'salted fish and Chinese cabbage'; colloquially refers to meager/humble food, or metaphorically to something of low value, trivial, or indicative of poverty
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，字面是常見的廉價家常食物。常用來形容飲食簡單寒酸，或比喻待遇、價值、狀況很差、不值一提。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning salted fish and Chinese cabbage. Used to describe very simple or meager food, or figuratively to indicate something poor, low-value, trivial, or indicative of poverty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我哋家庭成日食鹹魚白菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 ting4 seng4 jat6 sik6 haam4 jyu4 baak6 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候我們家經常吃鹹魚白菜。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, my family often ate salted fish and Chinese cabbage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾我嗰份人工，簡直係鹹魚白菜，點夠生活？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 ngo5 go2 fan6 jan4 gung1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 haam4 jyu4 baak6 coi3, dim2 gau3 sang1 wut6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你給我的那份薪水簡直像鹹魚白菜，怎夠生活？
examples.english_sentence: The salary you gave me is practically salted fish and cabbage — how am I supposed to live on that?

mandarin_meaning: 起死回生 / 死而复生（比喻從看似絕望或失敗的情況中恢復、捲土重來）
english_meaning: to make a comeback; to be revived from an apparently hopeless situation; resurrection/revival
explanation_mandarin: 字面是「鹹魚翻生」，比喻在看似已經完蛋或毫無希望的情況下突然恢復生機或翻身成功。
explanation_english: Literally 'a salted fish comes back to life'. Figuratively used to describe a sudden revival or comeback from an apparently hopeless or failed situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舖差啲要收舖，但老闆捱過難關，最後鹹魚翻生，生意好返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 caa1 di1 jiu3 sau1 pou3, daan6 lou5 baan2 ngaai4 gwo3 naan4 gwaan1, zeoi3 hau6 haam4 jyu4 faan1 saang1, saang1 ji3 hou2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 店舖差點要關門，但老闆挺過難關，最後鹹魚翻生，生意好轉回來。
examples.english_sentence: The shop was almost forced to close, but the owner weathered the difficulties and eventually made a comeback; business recovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嗰次差啲唔及格，點知補考之後鹹魚翻生，最後拎到B。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go2 ci3 caa1 di1 m4 gip6 gaak3, dim2 zi1 bou2 haau2 zi1 hau6 haam4 jyu4 faan1 saang1, zeoi3 hau6 ling1 dou3 B.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我那次差點不及格，沒想到補考之後鹹魚翻生，最後拿到B。
examples.english_sentence: I almost failed that exam, but after the resit I made a comeback and ended up with a B.

mandarin_meaning: 咸鱼翻身（比喻由失意或落魄的境况，重新振作或取得成功）
english_meaning: to make a comeback; to turn one's fortunes around after being down-and-out
explanation_mandarin: 原指鹹魚（晒乾的魚）翻身，後引申指一個人或處境從低潮或失敗中反轉，重獲成功或好轉。
explanation_english: Literally 'a salted fish turns over.' Idiomatically it describes someone or something reversing a previous misfortune or failure and achieving a comeback or improvement in fortunes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個讀書唔掂，依家考到律師，真係鹹魚翻身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 duk6 syu1 m4 dim6, ji1 gaa1 haau2 dou3 leot6 si1, zan1 hai6 haam4 jyu4 faan1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候讀書不好，現在考上律師，真是咸鱼翻身。
examples.english_sentence: He did poorly in school as a child, but now passed the bar to become a lawyer — it's a real comeback.

mandarin_meaning: 死而复生；东山再起
english_meaning: to come back to life; to make a comeback after seeming hopeless; an unexpected revival
explanation_mandarin: 「鹹魚返生」是粵語俗語，字面意思是已經變成鹹魚的魚又返生，比喻本來被認為無望或已經失敗的人或事物突然恢復生機或重新翻身，常用於口語及帶有幽默色彩的語境。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "a salted fish comes back to life." It describes a person or thing that makes an unexpected recovery or comeback after being written off, often used informally or humorously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經瀕臨倒閉，點知靠住新投資終於鹹魚返生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 ban1 lam4 dou2 bei6, dim2 zi1 kaau3 zyu6 san1 tau4 zi1 zung1 jyu1 ham4 jyu4 faan1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已经濒临倒闭，没想到靠着新投资终于东山再起。
examples.english_sentence: The company was on the verge of collapse, but unexpectedly, with new investment it finally made a comeback.

mandarin_meaning: 咸鸭蛋
english_meaning: salted duck egg
explanation_mandarin: 經過鹽漬或鹽水醃製的鴨蛋，蛋白偏鹹，蛋黃油潤，為常見的中式保存食品或配料。
explanation_english: A duck egg preserved by salting or brining; the white is salty and the yolk becomes rich and oily. Commonly eaten as a preserved food or used as an ingredient in Chinese cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日早餐食咗一隻鹹鴨蛋，個蛋黃真係好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou2 caan1 sik6 zo2 jat1 zek3 haam4 ngaap3 daan6, go3 daan6 wong4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早餐吃了一顆咸鸭蛋，蛋黄真的很香。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a salted duck egg for breakfast today; the yolk was really fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我媽整鹹鴨蛋，要用粗鹽醃幾個星期先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maa4 zeng2 haam4 ngaap3 daan6, jiu3 jung6 cou1 jim1 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈做咸鸭蛋，要用粗盐腌好几周才行。
examples.english_sentence: My mom makes salted duck eggs; she needs to cure them in coarse salt for several weeks.

mandarin_meaning: 有點下流、帶有性暗示（有點『黃色』）
english_meaning: a bit lewd; slightly risqué or sexually suggestive
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話說法，用來形容言語或舉止帶有輕微的性暗示或下流意味，語氣偏輕。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression describing something mildly lewd or sexually suggestive; used as a light, informal modifier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲笑話鹹鹹哋，唔好放喺小朋友面前講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 siu3 waa6 haam4 haam4 di1, m4 hou2 fong3 hai6 siu2 pang4 jau5 min6 cin4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑話有點下流，不要在小朋友面前講。
examples.english_sentence: His jokes are a bit risqué; don't tell them in front of children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢有時鹹鹹哋，唔好咁直接。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 jau5 si4 haam4 haam4 di1, m4 hou2 gam3 zik6 zip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說話有時有點帶性暗示，不要那麼直接。
examples.english_sentence: You sometimes talk a bit suggestively; don't be so direct.

mandarin_meaning: 带有下流、猥亵或令人不舒服的意味；有点爱开黄色玩笑/言行下流
english_meaning: slightly lewd/dirty; suggestive in a way that makes people uncomfortable; a bit creepy or indecent
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，用來形容說話或行為帶有色情、下流或令人不適的意味。字面上「鹹」本意為鹹（口味），但在廣東話中常引申為下流、猥褻；「臭」強調令人不舒服或討厭的感覺。一般帶負面或半開玩笑的語氣。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe speech or behavior that is sexually suggestive, lewd, or otherwise makes people uncomfortable. Literally 'salty' and 'smelly'—in Cantonese 'salty' (鹹) often implies lewdness. Usually negative or teasing in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講嘢鹹鹹臭臭，令人好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 je5 haam4 haam4 cau3 cau3, ling6 jan4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说话有点下流，让人很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks in a slightly lewd way; it makes people really uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 色狼；好色鬼；好色的男人
english_meaning: lecher; pervert; a man who behaves lecherously
explanation_mandarin: 香港俗語，帶貶義，用來形容性慾強、舉止猥褻或經常對異性有不當言行的男人。相當於「色狼」或「鹹佬」。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong slang term (pejorative) for a man who is lecherous or behaves indecently toward others, similar to 'lecher' or 'pervert'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有個鹹龍成日跟住啲女仔，睇到好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 haam4 lung4 sing4 jat6 gan1 zyu6 di1 neoi5 zai2, tai2 dou3 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園裡有個鹹龍總是跟著那些女生，看得很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lecher in the park who always follows the girls; it's very uncomfortable to see.

mandarin_meaning: 碱（鹼），指能与酸反应的碱性物质，常见于氢氧化物等
english_meaning: alkali; lye; a basic substance that reacts with acids
explanation_mandarin: 指呈鹼性的化學物質（如氫氧化物），在日常可指鹼水或具有鹼性的溶液，使用時需小心防護。
explanation_english: Refers to alkaline substances (e.g., hydroxides). Can mean lye or an alkaline solution; often used in chemistry and household cleaning contexts. Handle with care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鹼水好危險，唔好接觸皮膚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan2 seoi2 hou2 ngai4 him2, m4 hou2 zip3 zuk1 pei4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 碱水很危险，不要接触皮肤。
examples.english_sentence: Lye is dangerous; do not touch the skin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種化學品呈鹼性，需要戴防護裝備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 faa3 hok6 ban2 cing4 gaan2 sing3, seoi1 daai3 fong4 wu6 zong1 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种化学品呈碱性，需要戴防护装备。
examples.english_sentence: This chemical is alkaline and requires protective equipment.

mandarin_meaning: 碱性（鹼性）
english_meaning: alkaline; basic (chemistry)
explanation_mandarin: 表示溶液或物質呈鹼（堿）性，與酸性相對，pH 值大於7。
explanation_english: Indicates that a solution or substance is alkaline (basic), the opposite of acidic; typically corresponds to pH greater than 7.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個溶液係鹼性，處理時要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jung4 jik6 hai6 gaan2 sing3, cyu2 lei5 si4 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个溶液是碱性，处理时要小心。
examples.english_sentence: This solution is alkaline; be careful when handling it.

mandarin_meaning: 碱水（jiǎnshuǐ）：指碱性的水溶液，常由氢氧化钠、碳酸钠等形成，既可用于烹饪也可用于清洁或皂化。
english_meaning: lye water; an alkaline aqueous solution (e.g., sodium hydroxide or sodium carbonate) used in cooking and for cleaning/soap-making.
explanation_mandarin: 鹼水是一種鹼性水溶液。在中式烹飪中常用來改變麵粉製品或糕點的口感與上色（如部分傳統糕點與麵食），亦可作為清潔或皂化用途。
explanation_english: Lye water is an alkaline solution. In Chinese cooking it is used to alter texture and color of doughs and traditional pastries or noodles; it can also be used for cleaning and soap-making.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整發糕要落啲鹼水先至會發，口感先至會彈牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 faat3 gou1 jiu3 lok6 di1 gaan2 seoi2 sin1 zi3 wui5 faat3, hau2 gam2 sin1 zi3 wui5 daan6 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做发糕要放些碱水才会发起来，口感才会有弹性。
examples.english_sentence: To make fa gao (steamed sponge cake) you need to add some lye water so it will rise and have a springy texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽用鹼水整油角，記住淨係用少少，唔好放太多，否則會有苦味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jung6 gaan2 seoi2 zing2 jau4 gok2, gei3 zyu6 zing6 hai6 jung6 siu2 siu2, m4 hou2 fong3 taai3 do1, fau2 zik6 wui5 jau5 fu2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈用碱水做油角，记住只用一点，别放太多，否则会有苦味。
examples.english_sentence: My mom uses lye water to make yau gok; remember to use only a little—too much will make it bitter.

mandarin_meaning: 鹼水粽 / 碱水粽（用鹼水處理的粽子）
english_meaning: alkaline-water zongzi; lye-treated rice dumpling
explanation_mandarin: 用鹼性水（鹼水）處理糯米或外皮製作的粽子，處理後米色呈現微黃或褐色，口感較爽、略帶鹼味。這類粽子在南方和端午節期間較為常見，有時作為傳統食品保存或增添風味。
explanation_english: A type of zongzi (glutinous rice dumpling) made using alkaline (lye) water to treat the rice or wrapper. The process gives the rice a yellowish-brown tint, a firmer, springy texture and a mild alkaline taste. Common in southern China and often associated with Dragon Boat Festival traditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排屋企人成日買鹼水粽食，話係端午節嘅傳統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei1 paai4 uk1 kei5 jan4 sing4 jat6 maai5 gaam2 seoi2 zung2 sik6, waa6 hai6 dyun1 ng5 zit3 ge3 cyun4 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近家裡人經常買鹼水粽吃，說是端午節的傳統。
examples.english_sentence: Lately my family often buys alkaline-water zongzi to eat, saying it's a Dragon Boat Festival tradition.

mandarin_meaning: 鹼水粽子
english_meaning: lye-water zongzi (alkaline-treated rice dumpling)
explanation_mandarin: 一種製作時用鹼水（鹼性溶液）處理糯米的粽子。鹼水會使米粒呈微黃並增添彈性與獨特的鹼味，為廣東/香港地區部分傳統粽子的做法與口感特徵。
explanation_english: A type of zongzi (rice dumpling) in which the glutinous rice is treated with lye (an alkaline solution). The lye gives the rice a slightly yellow color, a firmer/chewier texture, and a subtle alkaline flavor; a traditional preparation used in some Cantonese/Hong Kong varieties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食鹼水糉，佢嘅口感彈牙，仲有少少鹼味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 gaam2 seoi2 zung6, keoi5 ge3 hau2 gam2 daan6 ngaa4, zung6 jau5 siu2 siu2 gaam2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃鹼水粽，它的口感有嚼勁，還帶一點鹼味。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating lye-water zongzi; its texture is chewy and it has a slight alkaline taste.

mandarin_meaning: 碱水粽（用鹼水處理過的粽子）
english_meaning: alkaline (lye-treated) zongzi / lye-treated rice dumpling
explanation_mandarin: 一種用鹼水處理或以鹼水製皮的粽子，常見於廣東地區，外皮顏色、口感和風味與一般粽子不同。
explanation_english: A type of zongzi (rice dumpling) treated with alkaline (lye) water. Common in Cantonese cuisine; the outer layer, color, texture, and flavor differ from regular zongzi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食鹼水糭，外皮有啲滑，帶有特殊嘅鹼味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 gaam2 seoi2 zung2, ngoi6 pei4 jau5 di1 waat6, daai3 jau5 dak6 syu1 ge3 gaam2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃碱水粽，外皮有点滑，带有特殊的碱味。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating alkaline (lye-treated) zongzi; the outer skin is a bit smooth and has a distinct alkaline taste.

mandarin_meaning: 盐 (yán)
english_meaning: salt (sodium chloride); used for seasoning and preserving)
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的化学物质，主要指氯化钠，常用于调味、腌制和防腐等日常用途。
explanation_english: A common chemical substance (mainly sodium chloride) used for seasoning, preserving foods, and other everyday purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗鹽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了盐。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some salt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯太鹹，可能落咗太多鹽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 taai3 haam4, ho2 nang4 lok6 zo2 taai3 do1 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗汤太咸，可能放了太多盐。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup is too salty; maybe too much salt was added.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋用鹽嚟保鮮同防腐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jung6 jim4 lai4 bou2 sin1 tung4 fong4 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们用盐来保鲜和防腐。
examples.english_sentence: We use salt to preserve and prevent spoilage.

mandarin_meaning: 盐分；含盐量
english_meaning: salt content; amount of salt; saltiness
explanation_mandarin: 指食物或物质中所含的盐的量，也可指味道的咸度。常用于饮食、營養或健康方面，讨论应摄取或控制的盐量。
explanation_english: Refers to the amount of salt contained in a food or substance, or the level of saltiness. Commonly used in discussions about diet, nutrition, or health when referring to salt intake or control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯嘅鹽份太高，要減少啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 ge3 jim4 fan6 taai3 gou1, jiu3 gaam2 siu2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗汤的盐分太高，要减少一些。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup has too much salt; you should reduce it a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我要控制鹽份，因為我有高血壓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 hung3 zai3 jim4 fan6, jan1 wai6 ngo5 jau5 gou1 hyut3 aat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我要控制盐分，因为我有高血压。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need to control my salt intake because I have high blood pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 加工食品通常含有好高嘅鹽份，食之前要睇下營養標籤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 gung1 sik6 ban2 tung1 soeng4 ham4 jau5 hou2 gou1 ge3 jim4 fan6, sik6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 tai2 haa5 jing4 joeng5 biu1 cim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 加工食品通常含有很高的盐分，吃之前要看一下营养标签。
examples.english_sentence: Processed foods usually contain high amounts of salt; check the nutrition label before eating.

mandarin_meaning: 鹽倉用地；（舊時）存放食鹽的倉庫所在的土地；引申為偏僻或荒廢的地區
english_meaning: land for a salt warehouse; historically land where salt was stored; by extension, a remote or desolate piece of land
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指存放鹽的倉庫所佔的土地。因為這類地點通常靠近海邊或偏遠地帶，『鹽倉土地』有時也用來形容荒涼、少人居住的地區或無人管理的空地。
explanation_english: Literally refers to land occupied by a salt warehouse. Because such locations were often by the coast or in outlying areas, '鹽倉土地' can also be used to describe desolate, sparsely inhabited, or neglected land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰塊鹽倉土地已經荒廢，幾乎冇人嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 faai3 jim4 cong1 tou2 dei6 ji5 ging1 wong4 fai3, gei2 fu1 mou5 jan4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那块盐仓土地已经荒废，几乎没有人来。
examples.english_sentence: That area where the salt warehouse used to be is abandoned; almost no one goes there.

mandarin_meaning: 鹽分（yánfèn）：食物或物質中所含鹽或鈉的量
english_meaning: salt content; amount of salt (sodium) in food or a substance
explanation_mandarin: 表示食物或其他物質中所含的鹽（主要指鈉）的量，常用於營養、健康建議或食品標示等語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the amount of salt (primarily sodium) contained in food or a substance. Commonly used in contexts of nutrition, health advice, and food labeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯嘅鹽分太高，唔健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 ge3 jim4 fan6 taai3 gou1, m4 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這碗湯的鹽分太高，不健康。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup has too much salt; it's unhealthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議我要減少鹽分攝取。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji3 ngo5 jiu3 gaam2 siu2 jim4 fan6 sip3 ceoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生建議我要減少鹽分攝取。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor advised me to reduce my salt intake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包薯片嘅鹽分標示好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 syu4 pin3 ge3 jim4 fan6 biu1 si6 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包洋芋片的鹽分標示很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The salt content on this bag of chips is clearly labeled.

mandarin_meaning: 鹽滷（鹽滷）指以鹽為主的滷水或鹼性卤液，用於醃製、滷製或作為豆製品的凝固劑（例如製作豆腐時使用的卤水/鹽滷）。
english_meaning: A salt-based brine or 'lu' liquid used for braising, pickling, or as a coagulant for soy products (e.g., used in making tofu).
explanation_mandarin: 常見於粵語飲食或傳統製作豆製品的用語，指用鹽和其他成分調製成的滷水或鹼性液體，能用來滷味、醃製或使豆漿凝固成豆腐。
explanation_english: A culinary term in Cantonese-speaking areas referring to a salt-based brine or alkaline solution used for braising, pickling, or coagulating soy milk to make tofu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽用鹽滷整豆腐，豆腐好滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jung6 jim4 lou5 zing2 dau6 fu6, dau6 fu6 hou2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽用鹽滷做豆腐，豆腐很滑。
examples.english_sentence: Mom uses salt brine (鹽滷) to make tofu; the tofu is very smooth.

mandarin_meaning: 盐焗（烹饪方法）
english_meaning: salt-baked; salt-roasted (a cooking method)
explanation_mandarin: 鹽焗是一種烹飪方法，通常用粗鹽包裹食材再焗/烘至熟，常見於鹽焗雞等菜式。
explanation_english: A culinary technique where ingredients are encased in coarse salt and baked/roasted until cooked; commonly used for dishes like salt-baked chicken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食鹽焗雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 jim4 guk6 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們去吃鹽焗雞。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight we're going to eat salt-baked chicken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鹽焗係用粗鹽包住食材再焗熟嘅煮法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jim4 guk6 hai6 jung6 cou1 jim4 baau1 zyu6 sik6 coi4 zoi3 guk6 suk6 ge3 zyu2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鹽焗是一種用粗鹽包裹食材再烘焗熟的烹飪方法。
examples.english_sentence: Salt-baking is a cooking method that wraps ingredients in coarse salt and bakes them until cooked.

mandarin_meaning: 盐焗鸡
english_meaning: salt-baked chicken (salt-roasted chicken)
explanation_mandarin: 一种广东传统菜肴，把整只鸡用盐和香料包裹或以盐焗方式烹制，皮香肉嫩，常见于粤菜与茶楼宴席。
explanation_english: A Cantonese dish in which a whole chicken is cooked by baking/roasting in salt and spices (salt-baked); the result is fragrant skin and tender meat. Common in Cantonese cuisine and tea houses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食唔食鹽焗雞？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 m4 sik6 jim4 guk6 gai1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃不吃盐焗鸡？
examples.english_sentence: Are you eating salt-baked chicken tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅鹽焗雞非常出名，係地道嘅廣東菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 jim4 guk6 gai1 fei1 soeng4 ceot1 ming4, hai6 dei6 dou6 ge3 gwong2 dung1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的盐焗鸡非常有名，是地道的广东菜。
examples.english_sentence: The salt-baked chicken here is very famous; it's an authentic Cantonese dish.

mandarin_meaning: 鹽焗雞
english_meaning: salt‑baked (salt‑roasted) chicken
explanation_mandarin: 一種廣東傳統菜式，通常以整隻雞裹上香料或包入鹽中，再以焗或燜的方法烹調，外皮香脆、肉質鮮嫩，常見於酒樓或家庭宴席。
explanation_english: A traditional Cantonese dish consisting of a whole chicken cooked by baking/roasting with salt (or buried in hot salt). The method yields flavorful, tender meat and a savory skin; commonly served in restaurants and at banquets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去食鹽焗雞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 jim4 guk6 gai1 laa1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去吃鹽焗雞吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat salt‑baked chicken tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒樓嘅鹽焗雞好出名，皮夠香、肉又唔會太乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 lau4 ge3 jim4 guk6 gai1 hou2 ceot1 ming4, pei4 gau3 hoeng1, juk6 jau6 m4 wui5 taai3 gon1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間酒樓的鹽焗雞很有名，皮夠香、肉也不會太乾。
examples.english_sentence: The salt‑baked chicken at this restaurant is famous — the skin is fragrant and the meat isn't dry.

mandarin_meaning: 盐田 (yántián)
english_meaning: salt field; salt pan; (also a place name, e.g., Yantian District)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來製鹽的田地或鹽場；亦可作地名，如深圳的鹽田區。
explanation_english: Refers to fields or pans used for producing salt; can also be used as a place name (e.g., Yantian District in Shenzhen).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度以前有好多鹽田，依家變咗工業區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ji5 cin4 jau5 hou2 do1 jim4 tin4, ji1 gaa1 bin3 zo2 gung1 jip6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里以前有很多盐田，现在变成了工业区。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be many salt fields here; now it has become an industrial area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個週末我哋去深圳嘅鹽田旅遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sam1 zan3 ge3 jim4 tin4 leoi5 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个周末我们去深圳的盐田旅游。
examples.english_sentence: This weekend we're going to Yantian in Shenzhen for a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鹽田入面嘅鹽工用傳統方法晒鹽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jim4 tin4 jap6 min6 ge3 jim4 gung1 jung6 cyun4 tung2 fong1 faat3 saai3 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盐田里的盐工用传统方法晒盐。
examples.english_sentence: Salt workers in the salt fields dry salt using traditional methods.

mandarin_meaning: （網路/俚語）形容酸溜溜、刻薄且陰險的人（字面為「鹽蛇」）
english_meaning: An informal slang term (literally 'salt snake') for a person who is 'salty'—bitter, petty, backhanded or sly; someone who makes cutting remarks or acts hypocritically.
explanation_mandarin: 「鹽蛇」為粵語口語／網路俚語，字面由「鹽」與「蛇」組成。用來貶稱那些言行帶刺、喜歡酸人、暗中說人壞話或陰險的小動作的人。屬非正式、口語化用法，常見於香港或網絡語境。
explanation_english: A Cantonese informal/online slang term combining 'salt' and 'snake'. It derogatorily describes people whose words or behaviour are cutting, petty, sly or hypocritical—those who make 'salty' remarks or subtly undermine others. Usage is informal and chiefly conversational or online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度扮好人，實際上係個鹽蛇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 baan6 hou2 jan4, sat6 zai3 soeng6 hai6 go3 jim4 se4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在那裡裝好人，實際上是個鹽蛇（酸溜溜又陰險的人）。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to be a good person, but in reality he's a 'salt snake'—petty and sly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢，佢淨係識做鹽蛇，專登講人壞話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5, keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 zou6 jim4 se4, zyun1 dang3 gong2 jan4 waai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理他，他只會當鹽蛇，故意說別人的壞話。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pay him any attention; he only plays the 'salt snake'—deliberately badmouthing others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上有啲留言好鹽蛇，見人開心就潑冷水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng6 jau5 di1 lau4 jin4 hou2 jim4 se4, gin3 jan4 hoi1 sam1 zau6 put3 laang5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 網上有些留言很鹽蛇，看到別人開心就潑冷水。
examples.english_sentence: Some comments online are very 'salt-snake'—they pour cold water on other people's happiness.

mandarin_meaning: 盐酸 (yánsuān)
english_meaning: hydrochloric acid
explanation_mandarin: 鹽酸是一種強酸，化學式為 HCl，具有強烈腐蝕性，常用於工業、實驗室及清潔用途。高濃度或不當接觸會對皮膚、眼睛和呼吸道造成傷害。
explanation_english: Hydrochloric acid (HCl) is a strong, corrosive acid used in industry and laboratories and for some cleaning tasks. It is hazardous at high concentrations and can cause severe burns and respiratory irritation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 實驗室入面唔好亂用鹽酸，記得戴手套同護目鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat6 jim6 sat1 jap6 min6 m4 hou2 lyun6 jung6 jim4 syun1, gei3 dak1 daai3 sau2 tou3 tung4 wu6 muk6 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在實驗室內不要亂用鹽酸，記得戴手套和防護眼鏡。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use hydrochloric acid recklessly in the lab; remember to wear gloves and safety goggles.

mandarin_meaning: 鹿 (lù) — 指鹿這種偶蹄的哺乳動物
english_meaning: deer — a hoofed ruminant mammal (e.g., deer, fawn)
explanation_mandarin: 鹿是一種反芻的偶蹄類哺乳動物，常見於森林或草地，亦常用於比喻或成語中（如「鹿死誰手」）。
explanation_english: Deer are hoofed ruminant mammals of the family Cervidae, commonly found in forests or grasslands. The character is also used in idioms (e.g., "鹿死誰手").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有隻鹿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 zek3 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一只鹿。
examples.english_sentence: There is a deer in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園見到啲鹿仔，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 gin3 dou3 di1 luk6 zai2, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公园看到小鹿，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: Saw the fawns in the park; they're very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場比賽，到底鹿死誰手就要拭目以待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3, dou3 dai3 luk6 sei2 seoi4 sau2 zau6 jiu3 sik1 muk6 ji5 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛，鹿死谁手还要拭目以待。
examples.english_sentence: As for who will win this match, we'll have to wait and see.

mandarin_meaning: 鹿死誰手 (lù sǐ shuí shǒu)：勝負未定，究竟誰會勝出還不知道。
english_meaning: Who will win? (literally: 'whose hand will the deer die in') — the outcome of a contest is undecided.
explanation_mandarin: 表示競爭或對抗中勝負尚未分明，誰會勝出還無法確定。字面來自古代打獵或兵法，比喻勝負歸屬未定。
explanation_english: An idiom indicating that the result of a competition or struggle is still undecided and it is unclear who will prevail. Literally refers to which hand the deer will die in (originating from hunting/battle imagery).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選舉結果未出，鹿死誰手仲未知道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 git3 gwo2 mei6 ceot1, luk6 sei2 seoi4 sau2 zung6 mei6 zi1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次選舉結果還沒出，誰會勝出還不知道。
examples.english_sentence: The election results haven't come out yet; it's still unclear who will win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場球賽兩隊實力相若，真係鹿死誰手喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 kau4 coi3 loeng5 deoi6 sat6 lik6 soeng1 joek6, zan1 hai6 luk6 sei2 seoi4 sau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場比賽兩隊實力相當，誰勝誰負難以預料。
examples.english_sentence: This match features two teams of similar strength; it's hard to tell who will win.

mandarin_meaning: 鹿茸（lù róng）：雄鹿初長角時的柔茸，常作為中藥材，據稱有補腎壯陽、補氣血等功效。
english_meaning: Deer antler velvet: the soft, velvety tissue on a deer's newly growing antlers, used in traditional Chinese medicine for tonic purposes.
explanation_mandarin: 鹿茸是雄鹿在長角初期表面覆蓋的柔毛和血管豐富的組織，乾燥或製成藥材，常用於中醫補品中。
explanation_english: Deer antler velvet is the soft, hairy, vascular tissue covering a stag's developing antlers. It is harvested, dried or processed, and commonly used as a medicinal tonic in traditional Chinese medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包係正宗嘅鹿茸，喺中藥店買到嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 hai6 zing3 zung1 ge3 luk6 jung4, hai2 zung1 joek6 dim3 maai5 dou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包是正宗的鹿茸，可以在中藥店買到。
examples.english_sentence: This pack is authentic deer antler velvet; you can buy it at a Chinese medicine shop.

mandarin_meaning: 字面上指「鹿形或與鹿有關的餅／餅乾」，在廣東話中極為罕見，無廣泛認可的特定含義或慣用說法。
english_meaning: Literally "deer biscuit" (a biscuit/cookie in the shape of, or related to, a deer). Extremely rare in Cantonese and not a widely recognized word or slang term.
explanation_mandarin: 「鹿餅」並非主流廣東話常用詞彙，主要是字面用法，指形狀像鹿或以鹿為主題的餅或餅乾。未見於主要詞典作為固定成語或俚語使用，可能屬地方或臨時造語。
explanation_english: This term is not commonly used in mainstream Cantonese. It is a literal expression referring to a biscuit/cookie shaped like a deer or themed around deer. It has no widely recognized idiomatic or slang meaning and may be a local or ad hoc coinage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上個市集見到有檔賣鹿餅，好得意，係鹿形嘅餅乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 go3 si5 zaap6 gin3 dou3 jau5 dong3 maai6 luk6 beng2, hou2 dak1 ji3, hai6 luk6 jing4 ge3 beng2 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在市集上看到有攤位賣鹿餅，很可愛，是鹿形的餅乾。
examples.english_sentence: At the market I saw a stall selling "deer biscuits"—they were cute, deer-shaped cookies.

mandarin_meaning: 麂（小型鹿科动物，俗称麂子）
english_meaning: muntjac; barking deer
explanation_mandarin: 麂是一種小型的鹿，常見於亞洲部分地區，俗稱麂子或麂鹿，特徵是體型較小，有時會發出似吠聲的叫聲（故名“barking deer”）。
explanation_english: A small deer of the genus Muntiacus common in parts of Asia, often called the muntjac or barking deer. It is small in size and sometimes makes a bark-like call.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山入面見到一隻麂，好可愛喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 jap6 min6 gin3 dou3 jat1 zek3 gei2, hou2 ho2 oi3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在山里看到一只麂，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a muntjac on the mountain; it was very cute.

mandarin_meaning: 麂皮（麂皮革）
english_meaning: suede (suede leather)
explanation_mandarin: 麂皮指由麂或其他動物皮經過起絨處理形成的革，表面有柔軟絨毛，常用於鞋、外套、包等服飾或配件。
explanation_english: Suede refers to leather (originally from deer or other animals) that has been buffed to create a soft, napped surface; commonly used for shoes, jackets, bags and other accessories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋係麂皮做嘅，著落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 hai6 gei2 pei4 zou6 ge3, zoek3 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這雙鞋是麂皮做的，穿起來很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes are made of suede; they feel very comfortable to wear.

mandarin_meaning: 拂塵；用動物毛或鹿尾製成的拂子（古代用來拂拭塵土或作儀式用具）
english_meaning: fly-whisk; a whisk made from animal hair or a deer's tail used for dusting or ceremonial purposes
explanation_mandarin: 麈指古代用來拂塵、驅塵或作儀式用途的器具，通常以獸毛或鹿尾製成，常見於佛教、道教或文人雅士的使用情境。
explanation_english: A traditional handheld whisk (fly-whisk) used to brush away dust or as a ceremonial implement, typically made from animal hair or a deer tail and commonly seen in religious or scholarly contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師父手執麈尾，慢慢行上台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 sau2 zap1 zyu2 mei5, maan6 maan6 hang4 soeng5 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师父手执拂尘，慢慢走上台。
examples.english_sentence: The master held a fly whisk and slowly walked up onto the stage.

mandarin_meaning: （指）麋鹿；古代用來指一種鹿，常見於合成詞如「麋鹿」
english_meaning: a type of deer (commonly appears in 麋鹿, referring to Père David's deer / milu)
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「麋」在古代用來指一種鹿，現代漢語中多見於詞語「麋鹿」，特指麋鹿（學名 Elaphurus davidianus），是一種曾在野外滅絕後由人工保護重建族群的珍稀鹿種。
explanation_english: The character 麋 historically refers to a type of deer. In modern usage it most often appears in the compound 麋鹿, referring to the Père David's deer (Elaphurus davidianus), a rare deer species that was once extinct in the wild.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 動物園入面有隻珍貴嘅麋鹿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 zek3 zan1 gwai3 ge3 mei4 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 动物园里有一只珍贵的麋鹿。
examples.english_sentence: There is a rare Père David's deer in the zoo.

mandarin_meaning: 麒麟（傳說中的祥瑞神獸）
english_meaning: The 'qi' in 'qilin' (a mythical auspicious beast, often called the Chinese unicorn)
explanation_mandarin: 「麒」常見於「麒麟」一詞，指中國傳說中的祥瑞神獸，象徵吉祥、和平，亦常用作人名或地名的一部分。
explanation_english: The character '麒' appears in 'qilin' (麒麟), a mythical auspicious beast in Chinese culture symbolizing good omens and peace. It is also used in personal and place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面有一尊麒麟雕像。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 zyun1 kei4 leon4 diu1 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 庙里有一尊麒麟雕像。
examples.english_sentence: There is a qilin statue inside the temple.

mandarin_meaning: 麒麟（qílín），中國神話中的瑞獸，也可指吉祥的象徵或用作人名、商標等。
english_meaning: Qilin (a Chinese mythical auspicious beast); symbol of good omen; sometimes used metaphorically or as a brand/name.
explanation_mandarin: 麒麟是古代傳說中的神獸，形象常為鹿、馬等動物的混合體，象徵吉祥與和平。除字面意思外，有時也比喻賢能之人或用作公司、品牌名稱。
explanation_english: The qilin is a legendary auspicious creature in Chinese folklore, often depicted as a chimera with features of deer, horse, and ox. It symbolizes good fortune and peace, and can also be used figuratively for an outstanding person or as a name/brand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢尊麒麟係廟入面嘅鎮殿之寶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zyun1 kei4 leon4 hai6 miu6 jap6 min6 ge3 zan3 din6 zi1 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這尊麒麟是廟裡的鎮殿之寶。
examples.english_sentence: This Qilin statue is the temple's treasured guardian.

mandarin_meaning: 奇異果（獼猴桃）
english_meaning: kiwifruit (kiwi)
explanation_mandarin: 「麒麟果」在廣東話中並非標準稱呼，常見於口語或網路用法，通常是將「奇異果」（獼猴桃）誤寫或戲稱為「麒麟果」。
explanation_english: “麒麟果” is not a standard name; it is a colloquial, mistaken, or joking form used to refer to the kiwifruit (kiwi).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗幾個麒麟果返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 gei2 go3 kei4 leon4 gwo2 faan1 uk1 kei2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們買了幾個麒麟果回家。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a few kiwifruits and took them home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其實「麒麟果」只係誤寫或者戲稱，正確係叫奇異果（獼猴桃）。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 sat6 "kei4 leon4 gwo2" zi2 hai6 ng6 se2 waak6 ze2 hei3 ceng1, zing3 kok3 hai6 giu3 kei4 ji6 gwo2 (mai4 hau4 tou4).
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其實「麒麟果」只是誤寫或戲稱，正確叫奇異果（獼猴桃）。
examples.english_sentence: Actually '麒麟果' is just a mistaken or joking name; the correct name is kiwifruit (also called Chinese gooseberry).

mandarin_meaning: 麒麟臂（qi2 lin2 bi4）
english_meaning: muscular/brawny forearm or arm
explanation_mandarin: 口語／網絡用語，指前臂或上臂肌肉發達、粗壯或血管明顯的手臂，常用來形容健壯、有力的手臂。
explanation_english: A colloquial term referring to well-developed, muscular forearms or arms—often with visible veins—used to describe strong, brawny arms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇佢條麒麟臂，肯定成日練肌肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 keoi5 tiu4 kei4 leon4 bei3, hang2 ding6 sing4 jat6 lin6 gei1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看他的麒麟臂，肯定经常锻炼肌肉。
examples.english_sentence: Look at his 麒麟臂 — he must work out a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做搬運工嘅人通常都有麒麟臂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 bun1 wan6 gung1 ge3 jan4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 jau5 kei4 leon4 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做搬运工的人通常都有麒麟臂。
examples.english_sentence: People who work as movers usually have 麒麟臂.

mandarin_meaning: （山）麓；山脚（lù）
english_meaning: the foot of a mountain; foothills; the lower slopes of a mountain
explanation_mandarin: 指山的底部或山脚下的地带，常用於书面或较书面化的表达，如“山麓”。
explanation_english: Refers to the base or foot of a mountain—the lower slopes or foothills. Often used in written or formal contexts (e.g., "山麓").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 村莊座落喺山麓，空氣清新，風景優美。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun1 zong1 zo6 lok6 hai2 saan1 luk6, hung1 hei3 cing1 san1, fung1 ging2 jau1 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 村庄座落在山麓，空气清新，风景优美。
examples.english_sentence: The village lies at the foot of the mountain; the air is fresh and the scenery is beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 登山隊喺山麓起步，準備登頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 saan1 deoi2 hai2 saan1 luk6 hei2 bou6, zeon2 bei6 dang1 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 登山队在山麓出发，准备登顶。
examples.english_sentence: The climbing team set off from the mountain's foot, preparing to reach the summit.

mandarin_meaning: 古代文獻中記載的一種鹿類或羚羊類動物（罕用、古字）
english_meaning: An archaic/rare term for a type of deer or antelope (rare/obsolete)
explanation_mandarin: “麖”為較少見的古字，常見於古籍中，用來指稱某類鹿或羚羊，現代漢語中罕用。
explanation_english: “麖” is an uncommon, archaic character found in classical texts, used to refer to a kind of deer or antelope. It is rarely used in modern Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古書上寫到麖這種動物，好少見而且多出現在古代記載。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 syu1 soeng6 se2 dou3 cau1 ze2 zung2 dung6 mat6, hou2 siu2 gin3 ji4 ce2 do1 ceot1 hin2 zoi6 gu2 doi6 gei3 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古書上寫到麖這種動物，很少見且多出現在古代記載中。
examples.english_sentence: The ancient books mention an animal called '麖', which is rare and mostly appears in historical records.

mandarin_meaning: 麗（lì）：美麗、華美、光彩奪目
english_meaning: beautiful; lovely; splendid
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（可用作詞根，用於複合詞如「美麗」「華麗」）
explanation_mandarin: 「麗」常用於合成詞，表示外觀美好、華美或光彩。單獨作字時多在書面或人名、成語中出現，如「美麗」、「華麗」。
explanation_english: The character 麗 denotes beauty, splendour, or finery. It is often used in compounds (e.g., 美麗, 華麗) and appears in written language, names, and idiomatic expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方好美麗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 mei5 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方很美丽。
examples.english_sentence: This place is very beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 美妙的声音；也可作为人名（女性名字）。
english_meaning: a beautiful or melodious sound; also used as a female given name.
explanation_mandarin: 「麗音」字面上指悅耳、優美的聲音。在日常用法中既可描述聲音的特質，也常見作為女性人名。
explanation_english: Literally 'beautiful sound' — it describes a pleasant, melodious sound. It is also commonly used as a feminine personal name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 麗音今日喺音樂會度表演，表現得非常出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei6 jam1 gam1 jat6 hai2 jam1 ngok6 wui2 dou6 biu2 jin2, biu2 jin6 dak1 fei1 soeng4 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麗音今天在音乐会演出，表现得非常出色。
examples.english_sentence: Liyin performed at the concert today and gave an outstanding performance.

mandarin_meaning: 麝香；麝（麝鹿）
english_meaning: musk; musk deer
explanation_mandarin: 指由麝鹿分泌的香料（麝香），或指麝這種動物；常用於香料和中藥材。
explanation_english: Refers to musk (the aromatic substance produced by the musk deer) or the musk deer itself; commonly used in perfumery and traditional medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗少少麝香喺香水入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zo2 siu2 siu2 se6 hoeng1 hai2 hoeng1 seoi2 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在香水裡用了少量麝香。
examples.english_sentence: He used a small amount of musk in the perfume.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時嘅醫書記載麝可以入藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 ge3 ji1 syu1 gei3 zoi6 se6 ho2 ji5 jap6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的醫書記載麝可以入藥。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient medical books record that musk can be used in medicine.

mandarin_meaning: 麟（lín）：常指麒麟，傳說中的祥瑞神獸。
english_meaning: qilin; a mythical auspicious beast (often appears in compounds like 'qilin', symbolizing good omens and rarity).
explanation_mandarin: 「麟」常見於「麒麟」等詞，指中國傳說中的一種象徵祥瑞的神獸，有時用來表示稀有或吉兆。
explanation_english: The character refers to the qilin, a mythical auspicious beast in Chinese folklore. It commonly appears in compounds (e.g., 'qilin') and symbolizes good omens, virtue, or rarity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳說麒麟係一種祥瑞嘅神獸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 syut3 kei4 leon4 hai6 jat1 zung2 coeng4 seoi6 ge3 san4 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 傳說麒麟是一種祥瑞的神獸。
examples.english_sentence: Legend says the qilin is an auspicious mythical beast.

mandarin_meaning: 鳳毛麟角；極其稀有的事物或人才
english_meaning: extremely rare; a very scarce or precious thing/person
explanation_mandarin: 「麟角鳳毛」指像麒麟的角、鳳凰的羽毛那樣罕見，比喻極為稀有的人或事物。常用來形容難得的珍品或稀有的人才。
explanation_english: Literally 'unicorn horn and phoenix feather.' An idiom meaning something extremely rare or precious, often used to describe scarce talents or extraordinary items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個行業，要搵到麟角鳳毛嘅人才真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hong4 jip6, jiu3 wan2 dou3 leon4-gok3-fung6-mou4 ge3 jan4-coi4 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个行业，要找到凤毛麟角的人才真的不容易。
examples.english_sentence: In this industry, it's really not easy to find such rare talents.

mandarin_meaning: 小麥；穀物；在粵語口語中也可作「麥克風」的簡稱
english_meaning: wheat; cereal; (colloquial Cantonese) short for microphone
explanation_mandarin: 「麥」本義指小麥或相關穀類作物與製品（如麥粉）。在香港粵語口語中，常把「麥克風」簡稱為「麥」，用於直播或演出時指麥克風或上/落麥（上/離開麥克風）。
explanation_english: "麥" primarily means wheat or related cereal products (e.g., flour). In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, it is also used as a short form of "microphone" (from "麥克風"), referring to the mic or the action of going on/off mic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包麥粉係用小麥整㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 mak6 fan2 hai6 jung6 siu2 mak6 zing2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包麵粉是用小麥做的。
examples.english_sentence: This bag of flour is made from wheat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你上麥講幾句啦，等下大家有嘢問你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng5 mak6 gong2 gei2 geoi3 laa1, dang2 haa6 daai6 gaa1 jau5 je5 man6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你上麥克風講幾句吧，等一下大家有事要問你。
examples.english_sentence: Go on the mic and say a few words; people will have questions for you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣我哋去麥記食嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 mak6 gei3 sik6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下我們去麥當勞吃東西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to McDonald's to eat in a bit.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）漢堡；常指麥當勞的漢堡
english_meaning: burger (colloquial; often refers to McDonald's burger)
explanation_mandarin: 「麥包」是廣東話的口語用法，指漢堡包，有時特指麥當勞的漢堡。用於日常會話中較隨意的說法。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a hamburger; sometimes specifically refers to a McDonald's burger. Used informally in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚唔想煮飯，想食個麥包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 m4 soeng2 zyu2 faan6, soeng2 sik6 go3 mak6 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚不想煮飯，想吃個麥包。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to cook tonight; I want to eat a burger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔鍾意食麥包同薯條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zung1 ji3 sik6 mak6 baau1 tung4 syu4 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子喜歡吃漢堡和薯條。
examples.english_sentence: Kids like to eat burgers and fries.

mandarin_meaning: 小麥啤酒（口語）
english_meaning: wheat beer (colloquial); beer
explanation_mandarin: 「麥啤」是粵語口語，常作小麥啤酒的簡稱，指以小麥為原料釀製的啤酒；在日常對話中也可能泛指某些淡色或麥芽味明顯的啤酒。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term, short for wheat beer (beer brewed with a significant proportion of wheat). In everyday speech it can refer specifically to wheat beers or more generally to certain pale/ grain-forward beers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去酒吧，想唔想飲杯麥啤？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1maan5 heoi3 zau2baa1, soeng2 m4 soeng2 jam2 bui1 mak6 be1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去酒吧，你想不想喝杯小麥啤酒？
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the bar tonight — do you want a wheat beer?

mandarin_meaning: 麦子；小麦的籽实或小麦植物
english_meaning: wheat; wheat grain
explanation_mandarin: 指小麦的籽实或禾本科作物小麦，常用来磨成面粉或作为饲料、原料等。
explanation_english: Refers to the seeds of wheat or the wheat plant (a cereal crop); commonly milled into flour or used as feed/ingredient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農夫依家喺田度種緊麥子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 fu1 ji1 gaa1 hai2 tin4 dou6 zung3 gan2 mak6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农夫现在在田里种麦子。
examples.english_sentence: The farmer is planting wheat in the field now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 麥子可以磨成麵粉，用嚟整麵包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mak6 zi2 ho2 ji5 mo4 sing4 min6 fan2, jung6 lai4 zing2 min6 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麦子可以磨成面粉，用来做面包。
examples.english_sentence: Wheat can be milled into flour to make bread.

mandarin_meaning: 麦乐鸡（麦当劳的鸡块，即McNuggets）
english_meaning: McNuggets (McDonald's chicken nuggets)
explanation_mandarin: “麦乐鸡”是粤语/中文口语中对麦当劳鸡块（McNuggets）的称呼，常见于香港、澳门等以粤语为主的地区，用来指麦当劳出售的鸡块产品。
explanation_english: “麥樂雞” is the Cantonese name for McDonald's Chicken McNuggets. It is commonly used in Hong Kong and other Cantonese-speaking areas to refer to McDonald's chicken nugget product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想去麥當勞買啲麥樂雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 heoi3 mak6 dong1 lou4 maai5 di1 mak6 lok6 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想去麦当劳买些麦乐鸡。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to McDonald's to buy some McNuggets tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 麦乐鸡（麦当劳的鸡块/鸡块产品，指 Chicken McNuggets）
english_meaning: McDonald's Chicken McNuggets (chicken nuggets)
explanation_mandarin: 「麥樂鷄」是粤语/港式中文对麦当劳旗下炸鸡块产品（Chicken McNuggets）的称呼，常用于口语，亦可泛指麦当劳的鸡类快餐。
explanation_english: The Cantonese name for McDonald's Chicken McNuggets. It refers to the fast-food breaded chicken nugget product and is commonly used in colloquial speech to refer to McDonald's chicken items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食麥樂鷄，今晚去唔去麥當勞買啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 mak6 lok6 gai1, gam1 maan5 heoi3 m4 heoi3 mak6 dong1 lou4 maai5 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃麦乐鸡，今晚去麦当劳买一些吗？
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat McNuggets — shall we go to McDonald's tonight to buy some?

mandarin_meaning: 麦片 / 燕麦片
english_meaning: oatmeal; rolled oats; breakfast cereal
explanation_mandarin: 由燕麦加工成的片状食品，常作为早餐，可冲泡即食或煮成粥状，亦有即食或粗加工等不同形式。
explanation_english: Food made from processed oats in flake form, commonly eaten for breakfast; can be instant (ready-to-eat) or cooked into porridge, typically served with milk or water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早食咗一碗即食麥片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1zou2 sik6 zo2 jat1 wun2 zik1 sik6 mak6 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上吃了一碗即食麦片。
examples.english_sentence: I had a bowl of instant oatmeal this morning.

mandarin_meaning: 麦当劳（连锁快餐品牌）
english_meaning: McDonald's (international fast-food restaurant chain)
explanation_mandarin: 麥當勞是國際知名的連鎖快餐品牌，供應漢堡、薯條、飲料等快餐食品，在香港常被稱為「麥記」。
explanation_english: McDonald's is an international fast-food chain serving items like burgers, fries, and beverages. In Hong Kong it is commonly referred to colloquially as "Mak's" (麥記).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去麥當勞食嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 mak6 dong1 lou4 sik6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去麥當勞吃東西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to McDonald's tonight.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）指麥當勞，是麥當勞的戲稱或暱稱
english_meaning: A colloquial/familiar name for McDonald's (the fast-food restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 「麥當當」是廣東話的俏皮稱呼，用來指代速食連鎖店麥當勞，常見於日常口語和年輕人用語中。
explanation_english: “麥當當” is a playful Cantonese nickname for the fast-food chain McDonald's, commonly used in casual speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去麥當當食晚飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 mak6 dong1 dong1 sik6 maan5 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們去麥當當吃晚飯吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to McDonald's for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我最鍾意去麥當當玩開心樂園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 heoi3 mak6 dong1 dong1 waan2 hoi1 sam1 lok6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候我最喜歡去麥當當玩開心樂園。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid I loved playing in McDonald's Happy Meal play area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔夠時間整飯，買返啲麥當當打包就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gau3 si4 gaan3 zang2 faan6, maai5 faan1 di1 mak6 dong1 dong1 daa2 baau1 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沒時間做飯，就買些麥當當打包回去吃。
examples.english_sentence: No time to cook, just grab some McDonald's takeout.

mandarin_meaning: 燕麦片；麦片（可做成麦片粥或早餐用的燕麦）
english_meaning: oatmeal; rolled oats (oats used as cereal or porridge)
explanation_mandarin: 「麥皮」指由燕麥經壓扁或切碎製成的食品，常用來做粥或當早餐麥片，在粵語口語中也常用「麥片」互換使用。
explanation_english: Refers to oats that have been rolled or crushed to make a cereal or porridge. Commonly eaten for breakfast; in Cantonese it is often used interchangeably with 麥片.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早食咗碗麥皮，夠晒飽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 sik6 zo2 wun2 mak6 pei4, gau3 saai3 baau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上吃了一碗麦片，很饱。
examples.english_sentence: I had a bowl of oatmeal this morning; it filled me up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用牛奶整麥皮，或者加啲果仁同蜜糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 ngau4 naai5 zeng2 mak6 pei4, waak6 ze2 gaa1 di1 gwo2 jan4 tung4 mat6 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用牛奶做麦片粥，或者加些坚果和蜂蜜。
examples.english_sentence: You can make oatmeal with milk, or add some nuts and honey.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語、貶義）寄生於他人、靠別人供養、不自立的人（類似「米蟲」、「啃老族」）
english_meaning: colloquial pejorative for a freeloader/sponger — someone who depends on others for support and does not support themselves
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，帶貶義。用來形容不工作或不自立、靠家人或他人供養的人，含「白吃白喝/寄生」之意。
explanation_english: Informal and derogatory term used to describe a person who does not work or support themselves and instead relies on family or others for upkeep — similar to 'freeloader' or 'sponger'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔搵工，淨係靠屋企供養，真係個麥皮蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 wan2 gung1, zing6 hai6 kaau3 uk1 kei5 gung1 joeng5, zan1 hai6 go3 mak6 pei4 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天不工作，只靠家人供養，真是個麥皮蟲。
examples.english_sentence: He never looks for work and just lives off his family — he's really a freeloader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做麥皮蟲，要自力更生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 mak6 pei4 cung4, jiu3 zi6 lik6 gang1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當麥皮蟲，要自立更生。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a freeloader; be self-reliant.

mandarin_meaning: 麥芽製的飲品或粉末（如麥芽飲品、麥芽精）
english_meaning: malt extract; malted drink powder (a malted beverage mixed with milk or hot water, e.g., Ovaltine/Horlicks)
explanation_mandarin: 指以麥芽為主要原料的即溶飲品或粉末，常用熱牛奶或熱水沖調。在香港口語中常用來指代阿華田、Horlicks 等麥芽類飲品。
explanation_english: Refers to a malt-based instant beverage or powdered malt extract commonly mixed with hot milk or hot water. In Hong Kong it is often used to refer to malted drink products such as Ovaltine or Horlicks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個我每日朝早都飲一杯麥精。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 jam2 jat1 bui1 mak6 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候我每天早上都喝一杯麥精。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child I used to drink a cup of malted milk every morning.

mandarin_meaning: 麥芽（màiyá）
english_meaning: malt; malt sprout; malt extract/syrup (used in brewing and confectionery)
explanation_mandarin: 麥芽指經過發芽的穀物（通常為大麥）或由此製成的提取物或糖漿，常用於釀酒、製作麥芽糖或作為調味/營養成分。
explanation_english: Refers to germinated cereal grains (usually barley) or the extract/syrup derived from them. Commonly used in brewing, making maltose candy, and as a flavoring or ingredient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲麥芽係用嚟釀啤酒嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 mak6 ngaa4 hai6 jung6 lai4 joeng6 be1 zau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些麥芽是用來釀啤酒的。
examples.english_sentence: These malts are used to brew beer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一斤麥芽準備整麥芽糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 gan1 mak6 ngaa4 zeon2 bei6 zing2 mak6 ngaa4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了一斤麥芽準備做麥芽糖。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a catty of malt to make maltose candy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 釀酒廠會將麥芽烘乾再磨粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joeng6 zau2 cong2 wui5 zoeng1 mak6 ngaa4 hung1 gon1 zoi3 mo4 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 釀酒廠會把麥芽烘乾再磨成粉。
examples.english_sentence: The brewery dries the malt and then grinds it into powder.

mandarin_meaning: 麥芽糖（màiyátáng）：由麥芽提取或製成的糖，常為黏稠的糖漿或拉成的糖果
english_meaning: maltose / malt sugar; a sticky malt syrup or traditional malt candy
explanation_mandarin: 麥芽糖是以麥芽為原料的糖類，常見為黏稠的糖漿或可以拉成絲的傳統零食。香港街市和廟會的小吃中經常出現。
explanation_english: A sugar derived from malt (maltose); commonly appears as a sticky syrup or pulled candy. It is a traditional snack often found in markets and festivals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個我成日食麥芽糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ngo5 sing4 jat6 sik6 mak6 ngaa4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候我常常吃麥芽糖。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child I often ate maltose candy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手整麥芽糖要快手，否則會好快凝固。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 zing2 mak6 ngaa4 tong4 jiu3 faai3 sau2, fau2 zek6 wui5 hou2 faai3 jing4 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手工製作麥芽糖需要動作快，否則很快會凝固。
examples.english_sentence: When making malt candy by hand you need to be quick, otherwise it will harden quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 麥芽糖製成的小吃或餅乾
english_meaning: maltose cookie / malt-syrup biscuit (traditional sweet snack)
explanation_mandarin: 以麥芽糖為主要材料製成的傳統甜點或小吃，常見於粵語地區的街頭或市場，形態可為薄餅或餅乾，表面會有黏性或糖衣。
explanation_english: A traditional sweet snack made from maltose (malt sugar), commonly found in Cantonese-speaking areas. It can take the form of a thin cake or biscuit, often with a sticky maltose coating or glaze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我最鍾意食麥芽糖餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 mak6 ngaa4 tong4 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小的时候我最喜欢吃麦芽糖饼。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I loved eating maltose cookies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市有檔賣麥芽糖餅，好多人排隊買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 jau5 dong3 maai6 mak6 ngaa4 tong4 beng2, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜市场有摊位卖麦芽糖饼，很多人排队买。
examples.english_sentence: There is a stall at the market selling maltose cookies; many people queue to buy them.

mandarin_meaning: （香港粵語俗稱）麥當勞
