explanation_english: An idiom used to describe a person (often a woman or child) whose appearance or manner seems delicate and pitiable, drawing sympathy; sometimes implies affectation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺出一副楚楚可憐嘅樣，想攞多啲人關心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ceot1 jat1 fu6 co2 co2 ho2 lin4 ge3 joeng6, soeng2 lo2 do1 di1 jan4 gwaan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他擺出一副楚楚可憐的樣子，想要得到更多人的關心。
examples.english_sentence: They put on a pitiable, delicate look to get more people's concern.

mandarin_meaning: 极为 (jíwéi) — 非常、极其
english_meaning: extremely; exceedingly; highly
explanation_mandarin: 用于修饰形容词或动词，表示程度很高，书面语或正式语体中常用。
explanation_english: Used to modify adjectives or verbs to indicate a very high degree; commonly found in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現極爲出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 gik6 wai4 ceot1 sik1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现极为出色。
examples.english_sentence: His performance is extremely outstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事極爲重要，唔可以掉以輕心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gik6 wai4 zung6 jiu3, m4 ho2 ji5 diu6 ji5 hing1 sam1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事极为重要，不可以掉以轻心。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is extremely important; you mustn't be complacent.

mandarin_meaning: 竭尽所能；尽最大努力
english_meaning: to do everything possible; to spare no effort; to go to great lengths
explanation_mandarin: 表示拿出所有能力去做某事，尽一切努力，常用于书面或强调语境。
explanation_english: Indicates using all one’s abilities to accomplish something or making every possible effort; often somewhat formal or emphatic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗完成個項目，極盡能事，冇嘢唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 jyun4 sing4 go3 hong6 muk6, gik6 zeon6 nang4 si6, mou5 je5 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了完成这个项目，竭尽所能，什么都做。
examples.english_sentence: He did everything he could to finish the project; there was nothing he wouldn't do.

mandarin_meaning: 极端（jíduān），表示程度或性質極端、過分或偏激
english_meaning: extreme; radical; excessive
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或態度處於極端的狀態，通常用來形容過分、偏激或沒有中間程度的情況。
explanation_english: Describes something that is at an extreme or excessive state; often used to characterize radical, unmoderated, or overly intense attitudes, actions, or conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅觀點好極端，冇中間路線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gun1 dim2 hou2 gik6 dyun1, mou5 zung1 gaan1 lou6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的观点很极端，没有中间路线。
examples.english_sentence: His/her views are very extreme, with no middle ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個決定太極端，會影響到好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 taai3 gik6 dyun1, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个决定太极端，会影响到很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This decision is too extreme and will affect many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為好極端，有時會做出危險嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai6 hou2 gik6 dyun1, jau5 si4 wui5 zou6 ceot1 ngai4 him2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为很极端，有时会做出危险的事。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is extreme; sometimes he does dangerous things.

mandarin_meaning: 极端例子 / 极端的例子
english_meaning: extreme example; an extreme case used to illustrate a point
explanation_mandarin: 表示一个极端或极少见的例子，通常用来说明某种情况并不具有代表性或不常见。
explanation_english: Refers to an unusually extreme or atypical example, often used to show that something is not representative of the general situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅只係一個極端例子，唔代表一般情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 gik6 dyun1 lai6 zi2, m4 doi6 biu2 jat1 bun1 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的只是一个极端例子，并不代表一般情况。
examples.english_sentence: What you're describing is just an extreme example; it doesn't represent the general situation.

mandarin_meaning: 極點、最完美或最極端的狀態（达到极致）
english_meaning: the ultimate; the extreme; pinnacle; utmost
explanation_mandarin: 表示達到極點或最高層次，常用來形容事物、表現或感受已到達最完美或最極端的狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates reaching the extreme or highest degree; used to describe something, a performance, or a quality that is at its utmost or most perfect state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演出真係達到極致。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 ceot1 zan1 hai6 daat6 dou3 gik6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表演真的達到了極致。
examples.english_sentence: His performance really reached the pinnacle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款手袋嘅設計美得極致。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 sau2 doi2 ge3 cit3 gai3 mei5 dak1 gik6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款手袋的設計美到了極致。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this handbag is beautiful to the extreme.

mandarin_meaning: 极快；极速（表示非常高的速度）
english_meaning: very high speed; ultra-fast; at top speed
explanation_mandarin: 「極速」表示速度非常快，可用來形容行駛、運作或完成某事的速度，既可作形容詞修飾名詞，也可作副詞修飾動詞。
explanation_english: “極速” denotes extremely high speed. It can describe vehicles, services, or how quickly something is done. It can function as an adjective (e.g. extreme-speed train) or as an adverb (e.g. do something at top speed).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 極速列車準備出發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gik6 cuk1 lit6 ce1 zeon2 bei6 ceot1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 极速列车准备出发。
examples.english_sentence: The high-speed train is about to depart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢極速完成咗份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gik6 cuk1 jyun4 sing4 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以极快的速度完成了那份报告。
examples.english_sentence: He finished the report extremely quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 极限 (jíxiàn)
english_meaning: limit; extreme; utmost
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或能力能達到的最大限度或不能再超過的程度。
explanation_english: Indicates the maximum degree or boundary that cannot be exceeded; the utmost limit or extreme.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個已經係我嘅極限啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ji5 ging1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gik6 haan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這已經是我的極限了。
examples.english_sentence: This is already my limit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動員突破人體嘅極限。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 jyun4 tuk1 po3 jan4 tai2 ge3 gik6 haan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 運動員突破了人體的極限。
examples.english_sentence: Athletes push past the limits of the human body.

mandarin_meaning: 极限影片／极限视频
english_meaning: extreme video / extreme film (videos with risky, intense, shocking, or explicit content)
explanation_mandarin: 俗稱，用來指包含極限動作、驚悚、血腥或過於露骨／成人內容的影片或短片。語境上常見於社交媒體或口語討論，帶有負面或警示意味。
explanation_english: Colloquial term referring to videos or clips that contain extreme stunts, shocking/gory scenes, or overly explicit/adult content. Commonly used in social media or everyday speech and often carries a warning or negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好去睇啲極限片，啲動作好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 heoi3 tai2 di1 gik6 haan6 pin3, di1 dung6 zok3 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要去看那些極限影片，那些動作很危險。
examples.english_sentence: Don't watch those extreme videos; the stunts are very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社交平台上有好多極限片，會嚇到人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 gaau1 ping4 toi4 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 gik6 haan6 pin3, wui5 haak3 dou3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社交平台上有很多極限影片，會嚇到人。
examples.english_sentence: There are many extreme videos on social platforms; they can be shocking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話嗰啲係極限片，唔適合未成年人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 go2 di1 hai6 gik6 haan6 pin3, m4 sik1 hap6 mei6 sing4 nin4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們說那些是極限影片，不適合未成年人。
examples.english_sentence: They said those are extreme videos and not suitable for minors.

mandarin_meaning: 极限运动
english_meaning: extreme sports
explanation_mandarin: 指那些具有較高風險、刺激性和技術要求的體育或戶外活動，如攀岩、跳傘、衝浪等，通常需要專業訓練與安全措施。
explanation_english: Refers to sports or outdoor activities with high risk, excitement, and technical demands—such as rock climbing, skydiving, and surfing—usually requiring professional training and safety measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意做極限運動，成日去攀石同跳傘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 zou6 gik6 haan6 wan6 dung6, sing4 jat6 heoi3 paan1 sek6 tung4 tiu3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡做极限运动，经常去攀岩和跳伞。
examples.english_sentence: He likes doing extreme sports and often goes rock climbing and skydiving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 參加極限運動之前要有專業訓練同埋安全裝備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caam1 gaa1 gik6 haan6 wan6 dung6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 jau5 zyun1 jip6 fan3 lin6 tung4 maai4 ngon1 cyun4 zong1 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 参加极限运动之前要有专业训练和安全装备。
examples.english_sentence: Before participating in extreme sports, you need professional training and safety equipment.

mandarin_meaning: 极点 / 极限；最高点或最极端的状态
english_meaning: extreme point; pinnacle; limit; utmost degree
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的最高点或最极端的位置或程度，也可用来形容情況或感受达到极限。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest point or most extreme position/degree of something; can describe a situation or feeling that has reached its limit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天無冷氣嗰陣，屋企熱到極點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 mou4 laang5 hei3 go2 zan6, uk1 kei5 jit6 dou3 gik6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天沒有冷氣的時候，家裡熱到極點。
examples.english_sentence: Without air conditioning in summer, the house gets extremely hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅耐性已經到達極點，唔會再等落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 noi6 sing3 ji5 ging1 dou3 daat6 gik6 dim2, m4 wui5 zoi3 dang2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的耐性已經到達極點，不會再繼續等待。
examples.english_sentence: His patience has reached its limit; he won't wait any longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅爭拗令到大家情緒激動到極點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 zang1 au3 ling6 dou3 daai6 gaa1 cing4 seoi3 gik1 dung6 dou3 gik6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次的爭執讓大家的情緒激動到極點。
examples.english_sentence: This dispute has driven everyone's emotions to the extreme.

mandarin_meaning: 楷（楷模、楷书）：模范、榜样；也指一种汉字的书法体——楷书。
english_meaning: model; exemplar; regular script (kaishu) - a standard style of Chinese calligraphy.
explanation_mandarin: 「楷」常用來表示典範或榜樣（如「楷模」），也指漢字的正規書體之一（楷書）。
explanation_english: Often denotes a model or exemplar (as in 'role model' - 楷模). It also refers to kaishu, the regular/standard script style in Chinese calligraphy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋嘅楷模。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 kaai2 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她是我们的楷模。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is our role model.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅字係用楷書寫嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 zi6 hai6 jung6 kaai2 syu1 se2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅字是用楷书写的。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of calligraphy is written in regular script (kaishu).

mandarin_meaning: 楷书 (kǎishū)：一种汉字的书写字体，也称楷体，笔画端正、结构方整，常用于正式书写与印刷。
english_meaning: Kaishu / regular script: a standard style of Chinese calligraphy and typeface characterized by clear, standardized strokes and square structure; used for formal writing and print.
explanation_mandarin: 楷書是一種漢字字體，筆畫規範、結構方正，便於學習和識別，常見於教科書、印刷字體與正式書寫場合。
explanation_english: Kaishu (regular script) is a style of Chinese characters with standardized, upright strokes and clear structure. It is easy to read and learn, commonly used in textbooks, print, and formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫字成日用楷書，筆畫好工整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zi6 sing4 jat6 jung6 kaai2 syu1, bat1 waak6 hou2 gung1 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他寫字總是用楷書，筆畫很工整。
examples.english_sentence: He always writes in kaishu (regular script); his strokes are very neat.

mandarin_meaning: 模範；榜樣
english_meaning: model; exemplar; role model
explanation_mandarin: 指值得學習或仿效的典型人物或行為，作為他人的榜樣或標準。
explanation_english: A model or exemplar—someone or something worthy of imitation, serving as a standard or role model.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅楷模，教我點樣面對壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 kaai2 mou4, gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 min6 deoi3 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的楷模，教我如何面對壓力。
examples.english_sentence: He is my role model; he teaches me how to face pressure.

mandarin_meaning: 樣本冊；範本簿
english_meaning: sample book; pattern book; specimen notebook
explanation_mandarin: 粵語中較少見或較口語化的用法，指用作參考或展示範本、樣式的冊子或簿子，類似「樣本冊」或「樣書」。
explanation_english: A less common Cantonese term referring to a booklet used to show or reference samples or patterns, similar to a sample book or specimen notebook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啲設計師攞咗本楷簿嚟俾客人揀款式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 di1 cit3 gai3 si1 lo2 zo2 bun2 kaai2 bou6 lei4 bei2 haak3 jan4 gan2 fun2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的設計師拿了一本樣本冊給客人挑選款式。
examples.english_sentence: The company's designers brought a sample book for the client to choose a style.

mandarin_meaning: 柱子；（在合成词中）指门旁悬挂的对联（如楹联）
english_meaning: pillar/column; (in compounds) relates to couplets hung beside doorways (e.g., couplets)
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑物的竖直柱子，常见于庙宇、厅堂；在复合词中（如「楹联」）与门旁的对联有关。
explanation_english: Refers to a vertical architectural pillar or column, commonly found in temples and halls; in compounds (e.g., "楹聯") it is associated with couplets placed beside doorways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間廟嘅楹柱上刻住好多花紋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 miu6 ge3 jing4 zyu3 soeng6 haak1 zyu6 hou2 do1 faa1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座庙的楹柱上刻着很多花纹。
examples.english_sentence: The pillars of that temple are carved with many patterns.

mandarin_meaning: 大概；概念
english_meaning: approximate; general idea; concept
explanation_mandarin: 表示大致、概略的意思，或用于表示“概念”等抽象名词，常见于合成词如“大概”、“概念”、“概括”。
explanation_english: Indicates approximation or a general idea; also used in words meaning 'concept'. Commonly appears in compounds such as '大概' (approximately/probably), '概念' (concept), and '概括' (summarize).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大概五點到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 goi3 ng5 dim2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大概五点到。
examples.english_sentence: I'll probably arrive around five o'clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係一個抽象嘅概念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 cau1 zoeng6 ge3 goi3 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个抽象的概念。
examples.english_sentence: This is an abstract concept.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以概括一下重點嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 goi3 kut3 jat1 haa5 zung6 dim2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以概括一下重点吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you summarize the key points?

mandarin_meaning: 概念 (gàiniàn)
english_meaning: concept; notion; idea
explanation_mandarin: 指對某個事物或現象的抽象認識或一般性的理解，用來表示一類事物的共同特徵或觀念。
explanation_english: Refers to an abstract understanding or general idea about something; a notion used to represent common features or an overarching idea of a category.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個概念有啲唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 goi3 nim6 jau5 di1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對這個概念有點不明白。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a bit unclear about this concept.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個概念喺課堂上好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 goi3 nim6 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個概念在課堂上很重要。
examples.english_sentence: This concept is very important in class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提出一個新嘅概念，改變咗我哋嘅思考方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 ceot1 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 goi3 nim6, goi2 bin3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 si1 haau2 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提出一個新的概念，改變了我們的思考方式。
examples.english_sentence: He proposed a new concept that changed our way of thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 概括 / 总结、概括地说
english_meaning: to summarize; to generalize; a summary
explanation_mandarin: 把事物的主要內容或共性提煉出來，簡要說明或總結，常作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: To extract and state the main points or common features briefly; to summarize or generalize. Can be used as a verb or as a noun meaning 'summary'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 概括嚟講，呢個計劃有可行性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: goi3 kut3 lai4 gong2, ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 ho2 hang4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 概括來說，這個計劃有可行性。
examples.english_sentence: In summary, this plan is feasible.

mandarin_meaning: 概况（总体情况；概述）
english_meaning: general situation; overview; summary
explanation_mandarin: 對某事物或某情況的整體、概括性描述，通常用以提供大致狀況或要點。
explanation_english: A concise description of the overall condition or general state of something, usually used to provide the main points or an overview.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報告應該先寫一段概況，說明整個項目的進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 gou3 jing1 goi1 sin1 se2 jat1 dyun6 goi3 fong3, syut3 ming4 zing2 go3 hong6 muk6 dik1 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报告应该先写一段概况，说明整个项目的进度。
examples.english_sentence: The report should start with an overview that explains the overall progress of the project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以畀我一份概況報告？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 jat1 fan6 goi3 fong3 bou3 gou3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以给我一份概况报告吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you give me an overview report?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 根據最近嘅概況，情況比預期更樂觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 geoi3 zeoi3 gan6 ge3 goi3 fong3, cing4 fong3 bei2 jyu6 kei4 gang1 lok6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 根据最近的概况，情况比预期更乐观。
examples.english_sentence: Based on the recent overview, the situation is more optimistic than expected.

mandarin_meaning: 概率（表示某事件發生的可能性）
english_meaning: probability; likelihood; chance
explanation_mandarin: 表示某一事件在特定條件下發生的可能性大小，常用於數學、統計及日常語境。
explanation_english: Indicates the likelihood that a particular event will occur under given conditions; used in mathematics, statistics, and everyday contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事發生嘅概率好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 faat3 sang1 ge3 goi3 leot6 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事发生的概率很低。
examples.english_sentence: The probability of this happening is very low.

mandarin_meaning: 大致、粗略或概要
english_meaning: general outline; rough summary; gist
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物的大體內容或粗略的說明，不包含詳細細節。
explanation_english: Indicates the general outline or a rough description of something, without detailed specifics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以先講個概略俾我聽？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 sin1 gong2 go3 goi3 loek6 bei2 ngo5 teng1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以先给我讲一下概略吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you give me a brief outline first?

mandarin_meaning: 概要 / 大綱、摘要
english_meaning: summary; outline; synopsis; gist
explanation_mandarin: 對某個主題或文件的簡要概述，列出重點或大綱，通常用於報告、論文或計劃書的前言或摘要部分。
explanation_english: A brief summary or outline that lists the main points or the gist of a topic, often used in reports, papers, or proposals as an overview.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教授叫我交一份研究項目嘅概要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 sau6 giu3 ngo5 gaau1 jat1 fan6 jin4 gau3 hong6 muk6 ge3 goi3 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教授叫我交一份研究項目的概要。
examples.english_sentence: The professor asked me to submit an outline of the research project.

mandarin_meaning: 概覽 / 概要、總覽
english_meaning: overview; general survey; summary
explanation_mandarin: 概覽指對某事物的概要性瀏覽或總覽，用於快速掌握整體情況或重點資訊。
explanation_english: An overview or general survey that gives a concise summary, used to quickly grasp the overall situation or main points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺會議開始之前，請大家先睇一個概覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 wui6 ji5 hoi1 ci2 zi1 cin4, ceng2 daai6 gaa1 sin1 tai2 jat1 go3 goi3 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在會議開始之前，請大家先看一個概覽。
examples.english_sentence: Before the meeting starts, please take a look at the overview first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網站上有個公司概覽，介紹主要服務同埋歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 zaam6 seong6 jau5 go3 gung1 si1 goi3 laam5, gaai3 siu6 zyu2 jiu3 fuk6 mou6 tung4 maai4 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 網站上有公司概覽，介紹主要服務和歷史。
examples.english_sentence: The website has a company overview introducing the main services and history.

mandarin_meaning: 概论（对某一学科或问题的概括性介绍）
english_meaning: general introduction; overview; survey
explanation_mandarin: 指对某一学科或主题的概括性介绍或总体论述，常用作课程名称（如“心理学概论”）。
explanation_english: A general introduction or overview of a subject or topic, often used as the title of introductory courses (e.g., "Introduction to Psychology").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢堂心理學概論課教咗我好多基礎知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tong4 sam1 lei5 hok6 goi3 leon6 fo3 gaau3 zo2 ngo5 hou2 do1 gei1 co2 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这堂心理学概论课教了我很多基础知识。
examples.english_sentence: This introductory psychology class taught me a lot of basic knowledge.

mandarin_meaning: 概述 (gàishù)：概括地敘述事物的大意或要點
english_meaning: overview; summary; to outline
explanation_mandarin: 概述是對某事物進行簡要的描述或總結，指出主要內容或要點。可用作動詞（概述某事）或名詞（作為一個概要）。
explanation_english: A concise description or summary that outlines the main points of something. It can be used as a verb (to outline) or as a noun (an overview).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你先概述一下呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 sin1 goi3 seot6 jat1 haa5 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請你先概述一下這個計劃。
examples.english_sentence: Please give a brief overview of this plan first.

mandarin_meaning: 罕用字／古字（現代漢語中很少使用的字，常見於古文或人名）
english_meaning: rare/archaic character (a Chinese character rarely used in modern language, often seen in classical texts or personal names)
explanation_mandarin: 「榃」是一個罕見的漢字，現代粵語和普通話中很少使用，多出現在古文、地名或人名裡，沒有廣泛的日常詞義。
explanation_english: “榃” is an uncommon Chinese character with little to no usage in modern Cantonese or Mandarin. It typically appears in classical texts, place names, or personal names and does not have a common everyday meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「榃」好少用，多數只見於古文或者人名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'taan2' hou2 siu2 jung6, do1 sou3 zi2 gin3 jyu1 gu2 man4 waak6 ze2 jan4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“榃”很少使用，多数只见于古文或者人名。
examples.english_sentence: The character '榃' is rarely used and is mostly seen in classical texts or personal names.

mandarin_meaning: 榆（榆树），一种落叶乔木，属榆科
english_meaning: elm (tree); elm wood
explanation_mandarin: 榆通常指榆树，是一种常见的落叶乔木，属榆科，常用于绿化和木材用途。
explanation_english: Refers to the elm tree (family Ulmaceae), a common deciduous tree used for landscaping and timber.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企後面有一棵榆樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 hau6 min6 jau5 jat1 fo1 jyu4 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家后面有一棵榆树。
examples.english_sentence: There is an elm tree behind my house.

mandarin_meaning: （1）槟榔，指可嚼食的果实；（2）用于合成词如“榔头”，指木槌、锤子。
english_meaning: 1) Areca / betel nut (the fruit often chewed). 2) Appears in compounds such as '榔頭' (mallet/hammer).
explanation_mandarin: 漢字“榔”常見於“檳榔”（槟榔）一詞，指一種可嚼的子實；也可出現在“榔頭”等合成詞中，表示木槌或錘子。
explanation_english: The character 榔 commonly appears in 檳榔 (betel/areca nut) referring to the chewable fruit; it also occurs in compounds like 榔頭, meaning a mallet or hammer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬成日買檳榔嚼，牙醫話唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 sing4 jat6 maai5 ban1 long4 zoek3, ngaa4 ji1 waa6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟经常买槟榔嚼，牙医说不好。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother always buys and chews betel nuts; the dentist says it's bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用榔頭敲木板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 long4 tau4 haau1 muk6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用榔头敲木板。
examples.english_sentence: He used a mallet to hit the wooden board.

mandarin_meaning: 榕（榕树），属于无花果属的一种常绿乔木，常见于热带和亚热带地区。
english_meaning: Banyan (a type of fig tree, genus Ficus), an evergreen tree common in tropical and subtropical regions.
explanation_mandarin: 指榕树（如榕属植物），常用于描述植物或作为地名、象征性用法。榕树在华南和东南亚地区常见，树冠宽大，气根发达。
explanation_english: Refers to the banyan tree (Ficus species). Used to denote the tree itself and sometimes appears in place names or symbolic contexts. Banyans have wide canopies and aerial roots and are common in southern China and Southeast Asia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有一棵大榕樹，好多人喺樹下休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 fo1 daai6 jung4 syu6, hou2 do1 jan4 hai2 syu6 haa6 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一棵大榕树，很多人在树下休息。
examples.english_sentence: There is a large banyan tree in the park; many people are resting under it.

mandarin_meaning: 榕树（榕属植物，一种热带/亚热带常绿乔木）
english_meaning: banyan tree (a type of fig tree, evergreen, known for aerial roots and wide canopy)
explanation_mandarin: 榕樹屬於榕屬（Ficus），為常綠大型喬木，氣根發達、枝葉茂密，常見於熱帶及亞熱帶地區，如香港街道、公園常見的老樹。
explanation_english: A banyan is a tree of the Ficus genus, an evergreen tree notable for aerial roots and a broad canopy. Common in tropical and subtropical regions, banyans are a familiar sight in parks and streets in places like Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有棵好大嘅榕樹，夏天好多市民喺度乘涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 fo1 hou2 daai6 ge3 yung4 syu6, haa6 tin1 hou2 do1 si5 man4 hai2 dou6 sing4 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園裡有一棵很大的榕樹，夏天很多市民在那裡乘涼。
examples.english_sentence: There is a big banyan tree in the park; many people cool off there in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆話呢棵榕樹已經有幾十年歷史，係街坊聚會嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 waa6 ni1 fo1 yung4 syu6 ji5 ging1 jau5 gei2 sap6 nin4 lik6 si2, hai6 gaai1 fong1 zeoi6 wui6 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶說這棵榕樹已經有幾十年的歷史，是街坊聚會的地方。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma said this banyan tree has several decades of history and is a gathering spot for neighbors.

mandarin_meaning: 横幅（héngfú）
english_meaning: banner; horizontal banner; placard
explanation_mandarin: 指掛在牆上或街道上的長條布、紙或其他材質，上面書寫或印有標語、口號或宣傳內容，常用於集會、示威或廣告宣傳。
explanation_english: A long strip of cloth, paper, or other material hung on walls or in public spaces that displays slogans, messages, or promotional content; commonly used for rallies, protests, or advertising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威嗰日，街上掛滿咗抗議嘅橫幅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 go2 jat6, gaai1 soeng6 gwaa3 mun5 zo2 kong3 ji3 ge3 waang4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威那天，街上挂满了抗议的横幅。
examples.english_sentence: On the day of the protest, the streets were filled with protest banners.

mandarin_meaning: 毁誉参半（褒贬不一，既有赞扬也有批评）
english_meaning: to receive mixed reviews; both praise and criticism
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事的評價不一致，有好評也有壞評，褒貶參半。
explanation_english: Indicates that opinions about someone or something are mixed — there are both positive and negative evaluations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅新書面世之後，讀者反應毀譽參半。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 syu1 min6 sai3 zi1 hau6, duk6 ze2 faan2 jing3 wai2 jyu6 caam1 bun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的新書面世後，讀者反應毀譽參半。
examples.english_sentence: After his new book was published, readers' responses were mixed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳最近生意好，但評論毀譽參半，有人讚味道好，有人話服務差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zeoi3 gan6 sang1 ji3 hou2, daan6 ping4 leon6 wai2 jyu6 caam1 bun3, jau5 jan4 zaan3 mei6 dou6 hou2, jau5 jan4 waa6 fuk6 mou6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳最近生意不錯，但評論毀譽參半，有人稱讚味道好，也有人說服務差。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has been busy recently, but reviews are mixed—some praise the taste while others complain about the service.

mandarin_meaning: 毁（毁坏、破坏，汉语拼音 huǐ）
english_meaning: to destroy; to ruin; to damage; to defame (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 表示使事物受损、破坏或消灭，也可引申为毁掉名誉、前途等。
explanation_english: Indicates causing damage, destruction, or annihilation; can also be used figuratively to mean ruining someone's reputation or prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲評論真係好傷人，差唔多毀咗佢嘅名聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ping4 leon6 zan1 hai6 hou2 soeng1 jan4, caa1 m4 do1 wai2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 ming4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的评论真的很伤人，差不多毁了他的名声。
examples.english_sentence: His comments were really hurtful and almost ruined his reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風差啲就將條村毀晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 caa1 di1 zau6 zoeng1 tiu4 cyun1 wai2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风差点把整个村庄都毁掉了。
examples.english_sentence: The typhoon almost destroyed the whole village.

mandarin_meaning: 毅 (yì)：堅定、毅力、果斷，常見於「毅力」「毅然」等詞。
english_meaning: resolve; firmness of will; perseverance; resolute
explanation_mandarin: 「毅」表示堅定的意志或堅強的毅力，常用於複合詞如「毅力」「毅然」，也常出現在人名或書面語中。
explanation_english: Indicates firmness of will or strong perseverance. Commonly appears in compounds like "毅力" (perseverance) and "毅然" (resolutely), as well as in names and formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有毅力，終於考上醫科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 ngai6 lik6, zung1 jyu1 haau2 soeng5 ji1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有毅力，終於考上醫學系。
examples.english_sentence: He had great perseverance and finally got into medical school.

mandarin_meaning: 毅力（yìlì）——堅持不懈的意志和耐力
english_meaning: perseverance; determination; willpower
explanation_mandarin: 表示堅定不移的意志和持久的努力與耐力，用來形容能夠堅持完成艱難任務的能力。
explanation_english: Refers to firm and persistent determination — the ability to endure hardship and keep working toward a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有堅強嘅毅力，終於考上醫科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 gin1 koeng4 ge3 ngai6 lik6, zung1 jyu1 haau2 soeng5 ji1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有堅強的毅力，終於考上了醫科。
examples.english_sentence: He had strong perseverance and finally got into medical school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑馬拉松需要毅力同恆心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 maa5 laai1 sung1 seoi1 jiu3 ngai6 lik6 tung4 hang4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑馬拉松需要毅力和恆心。
examples.english_sentence: Running a marathon requires perseverance and persistence.

mandarin_meaning: 毫不犹豫、断然（做某事）
english_meaning: resolutely; without hesitation
explanation_mandarin: 表示下定決心、毫不猶豫地做出決定或採取行動，語氣堅定。
explanation_english: Indicates taking a firm, decisive action without hesitation; expresses determination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢毅然辭職，去追尋自己嘅夢想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngai6 jin4 ci4 zik1, heoi3 zeoi1 cam4 zi6 gei2 ge3 mung6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他毅然辞职，去追寻自己的梦想。
examples.english_sentence: He resolutely resigned to pursue his own dreams.

mandarin_meaning: 毅行（指長距離徒步活動，常用於慈善籌款或耐力行走活動）
english_meaning: endurance walk; long-distance hike (often a charity or fundraising walk)
explanation_mandarin: 指為慈善、籌款或團體活動而舉辦的長距離徒步行走，強調耐力與持續性，香港常見的社區活動名稱。
explanation_english: An organized long-distance walk emphasizing endurance, often held as a charity or fundraising event. The term is commonly used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校嘅毅行每年都吸引好多人參加，為慈善機構籌款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 ge3 ngai6 haang4 mui5 nin4 dou1 kap1 jan5 hou2 do1 jan4 caam1 gaa1 wai4 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3 cau4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們學校的毅行每年都吸引很多人參加，為慈善機構籌款。
examples.english_sentence: Our school's endurance walk attracts many participants every year to raise funds for charities.

mandarin_meaning: 毅然前进 / （在香港）指「毅進課程」等教育項目
english_meaning: to advance with perseverance; (in Hong Kong) name/short form for certain education programmes (e.g. Yijin program)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 短语 / 專有名詞（視上下文而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「毅進」由「毅」（堅毅）與「進」（前進）組成，可表示堅定地向前進，也常用作香港某些教育或進修項目的名稱（如「毅進課程」）。
explanation_english: Combines 毅 (perseverance) and 進 (advance). It can mean to move forward resolutely, and in Hong Kong it is also used as a name/short form for certain education or advancement programmes (e.g. the Yijin programme).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢報咗毅進課程，想升學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou3 zo2 ngai6 zeon3 fo3 cing4, soeng2 sing1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他報名了毅進課程，想升學。
examples.english_sentence: He signed up for the Yijin program to pursue further education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要毅進嘅精神，先至可以克服挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 ngai6 zeon3 ge3 zing1 san4, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 hak1 fuk6 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們需要毅進的精神，才能克服挑戰。
examples.english_sentence: We need the spirit of perseverance and progress to overcome challenges.

mandarin_meaning: 就讀毅進文憑課程的學生（有時帶貶義）
english_meaning: a student enrolled in the Yi Jin Diploma programme (sometimes used derogatorily to imply lower academic achievement)
explanation_mandarin: 「毅進仔」是香港口語，指讀毅進文憑（Yi Jin Diploma）課程的學生。有時帶輕蔑或戲稱意味，但也可中性描述就讀該課程的人。
explanation_english: “毅進仔” is Hong Kong colloquial slang referring to students enrolled in the Yi Jin Diploma programme. It can be used neutrally to identify such students, but is sometimes used pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係毅進仔，依家喺職訓局讀毅進文憑，打算之後升大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngai6 zeon3 zai2, ji1gaa1 hai6 zik1fan3 guk6 duk6 ngai6 zeon3 man4 ping4, daa2syun3 zi1hau6 sing1 daai6hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是毅進仔，現在在職訓局讀毅進文憑，打算之後升大學。
examples.english_sentence: He's a Yi Jin student; he's studying the Yi Jin Diploma at the Vocational Training Council and plans to go to university afterwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇低毅進仔，好多都好努力同有前途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 dai1 ngai6 zeon3 zai2, hou2 do1 dou1 hou2 nou5lik6 tung4 jau5 cin4tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看毅進仔，很多人都很努力且有前途。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on Yi Jin students; many work hard and have promising futures.

mandarin_meaning: （香港）毅進計劃/毅進文憑所屬的教育制度或升學途徑
english_meaning: The Yi Jin system — an education programme/system in Hong Kong (Yi Jin Programme/Diploma) providing an alternative pathway for secondary school leavers to obtain sub-degree qualifications and progress to higher education.
explanation_mandarin: 指香港的毅進相關教育制度或體系（如毅進計劃／毅進文憑），為未能直接入讀大學的中學畢業生提供副學位、銜接課程或升學途徑。
explanation_english: Refers to the Yi Jin-related educational system/programme in Hong Kong (e.g., Yi Jin Programme/Diploma). It offers an alternative pathway for secondary school graduates who cannot enter university directly, providing sub-degree qualifications, bridging courses, and routes to further studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔夠分讀本地大學，只好報讀毅進制，等之後再升學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 gau3 fan1 duk6 bun2 dei6 daai6 hok6, zi2 hou2 bou3 duk6 ngai6 zeon3 zai3, dang2 zi1 hau6 zoi3 sing1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他分數不夠讀本地大學，只好報讀毅進制，等之後再升學。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't score enough to get into a local university, so he enrolled in the Yi Jin system to continue his studies later.

mandarin_meaning: 毅進文凭（香港的一种副学历/文凭课程，作为中学毕业生或未能通过主流考试学生的升学或就业途径）
english_meaning: Yi Jin Diploma (a Hong Kong post-secondary diploma program providing alternative pathways for secondary school leavers to further study or vocational training)
explanation_mandarin: 毅進文凭是香港提供的一种文凭资格（原称毅進計劃/毅進課程），面向中學畢業生或未能通過主流公開考試的學生，透過學術與職業技能並重的課程，提供升讀副學位或就業的途徑，並由相關教育機構頒發承認資歷。
explanation_english: The Yi Jin Diploma is a Hong Kong diploma qualification (originally the Yi Jin Programme) aimed at secondary school leavers or those who did not achieve mainstream exam results. It combines academic and vocational elements and provides pathways to sub-degree/associate programmes or employment; it is awarded and recognized by relevant local education bodies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我報咗毅進文憑，想升讀副學位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou3 zo2 ngai6 zeon3 man4 ping4, soeng2 sing1 duk6 fu3 hok6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我报读了毅进文凭，想升读副学位。
examples.english_sentence: I enrolled in the Yi Jin Diploma; I want to progress to an associate degree.

mandarin_meaning: 毅進計劃（Yi Jin Programme），香港的一項副學位/銜接課程，為中學畢業生或學業成績未達直接升讀大學要求的學生提供升學或職業培訓的途徑。
english_meaning: Yi Jin Programme (Yijin Programme) — a Hong Kong post-secondary bridging programme that offers diploma-level study and vocational training as a pathway for secondary school leavers to progress to higher education or employment.
explanation_mandarin: 毅進計劃由香港教育機構提供，旨在幫助中學畢業生通過修讀專業與基礎學科取得文憑，從而銜接高等教育或直接就業。
explanation_english: A government/education sector programme in Hong Kong designed to help secondary school graduates obtain a diploma through academic and vocational courses, enabling progression to higher education or the workforce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿妹中學畢業後成績未夠，佢報讀咗毅進計劃，希望之後可以升讀大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 mui6 zung1 hok6 bat1 jip6 hau6 sing4 zik1 mei6 gau3, keoi5 bou3 duk6 zo2 ngai6 zeon3 gai3 waak6, hei1 mong6 zi1 hau6 ho2 ji5 sing1 duk6 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妹妹中學畢業後成績不夠，就報名了毅進計劃，希望之後能升讀大學。
examples.english_sentence: My younger sister didn't get high enough grades after secondary school, so she enrolled in the Yi Jin Programme hoping to enter university later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校舉辦咗毅進計劃嘅講座，介紹課程內容同升學出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 geoi2 baan6 zo2 ngai6 zeon3 gai3 waak6 ge3 gong2 zo6, gaai3 siu6 fo3 cing4 noi6 jung4 tung4 sing1 hok6 ceot1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校舉辦了有關毅進計劃的講座，介紹課程內容和升學出路。
examples.english_sentence: The school held a seminar about the Yi Jin Programme, introducing its curriculum and progression routes.

mandarin_meaning: 毆打；殴打；打人
english_meaning: to beat; to assault; to strike
explanation_mandarin: 表示用拳腳或工具打人、毆打、攻擊他人。
explanation_english: To strike or beat someone with fists, feet, or weapons; to assault or physically attack someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀幾個人毆咗一頓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 gei2 go3 jan4 au1 zo2 jat1 deon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被幾個人毆了一頓。
examples.english_sentence: He was beaten up by several people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方拘捕咗幾名涉嫌毆鬥嘅青年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 kau1 bou6 zo2 gei2 ming4 sik1 haam6 au1 dau3 ge3 cing1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方逮捕了幾名涉嫌毆鬥的青年。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested several youths suspected of fighting.

mandarin_meaning: 殴打；用暴力打人
english_meaning: to beat up; to assault; to physically strike someone
explanation_mandarin: 表示用拳腳或其他方式對他人進行暴力打擊，造成身體傷害的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to using physical force (punching, kicking, etc.) to strike or assault someone, causing bodily harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺酒吧同人起衝突，結果畀人毆打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zau2 baa1 tung4 jan4 hei2 cung1 dat6, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 au1 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在酒吧與人發生衝突，結果被人毆打。
examples.english_sentence: He got into a conflict with someone at the bar and ended up being beaten up.

mandarin_meaning: 把人打到跛（嚴重毆打）
english_meaning: to beat someone up severely; to beat someone until they become lame
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指被人用暴力嚴重毆打，弄到行動不便或受重傷。常用於口語描述打鬥結果。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to severely beat someone, to the point of causing lameness or serious injury. Commonly used in colloquial speech to describe the outcome of a fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街度畀人毆跛晒，仲要送去醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 bei2 jan4 au1 bo2 saai3, zung6 jiu3 sung3 heoi3 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上被人打到跛，要送去醫院。
examples.english_sentence: He was beaten up in the street until he was lame and had to be taken to the hospital.

mandarin_meaning: 毆打；打鬥；打架
english_meaning: to fight; to brawl; to beat up
explanation_mandarin: 指雙方或多方互相毆打、打鬥或發生肢體衝突。
explanation_english: Refers to physical fighting or brawling between two or more people; engaging in a physical altercation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺酒吧外面毆鬥咗一輪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zau2 baa1 ngoi6 min6 au1 dau3 zo2 jat1 leon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在酒吧外面打了一架。
examples.english_sentence: They got into a fight outside the bar.

mandarin_meaning: 不要；无须；无论（书面或文言用法）
english_meaning: a literary/formal negative particle meaning 'do not', 'not', or as part of compounds 'no need', 'regardless of'
explanation_mandarin: 「毋」在粤语及文言或書面語中作否定用，相當於口語的「唔/不要」，亦常見於合成詞如「毋須」「毋論」。
explanation_english: Used as a negative particle in Cantonese and Classical/Literary Chinese. It corresponds to colloquial '唔/don't' and appears in compounds like '毋須' (no need) and '毋論' (regardless of).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毋須擔心，工程會按時完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 seoi1 daam1 sam1, gung1 cing4 wui5 on3 si4 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，工程会按时完成。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, the project will be completed on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毋論貧富，大家都有權利接受教育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 leon6 pan4 fu3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 kyun4 lei6 zip3 sau6 gaau3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论贫富，大家都有权利接受教育。
examples.english_sentence: Regardless of wealth, everyone has the right to receive an education.

mandarin_meaning: 毋庸置疑；毫無疑問
english_meaning: beyond doubt; indisputable; without a doubt
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作副詞或形容詞）
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要懷疑，事情或判斷非常確定，毫無疑問。
explanation_english: Indicates that something requires no doubt; it is certain or indisputable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅專業經驗毋庸置疑，大家都好信得過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zyun1 jip6 ging1 jim6 m4 jung4 zi3 ji4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 seon3 dak1 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的專業經驗毋庸置疑，大家都很信得過他。
examples.english_sentence: His professional experience is beyond doubt; everyone trusts him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個消息毋庸置疑，因為有官方發佈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 m4 jung4 zi3 ji4, jan1 wai6 jau5 gung1 fong1 faat3 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個消息毋庸置疑，因為有官方發布。
examples.english_sentence: This news is indisputable because it's an official release.

mandarin_meaning: 勿忘在莒 (wù wàng zài jǔ) — 不要忘記當年在莒避難或復國的經歷，比喻不忘本、不忘艱苦歲月並保持戒慎和警惕。
english_meaning: A classical Chinese idiom literally 'do not forget (what happened) in Ju.' Figuratively: 'never forget one's roots or past hardships; remember the refuge or trials that led to present success and remain vigilant.'
explanation_mandarin: 出自歷史典故，原指勿忘在莒這段避難與復國的經歷。現用以提醒人們不忘本、不忘過去的艱苦與教訓，保持謹慎與奮鬥的精神。
explanation_english: From a historical anecdote referring to the place Ju; originally meant 'do not forget what happened in Ju.' Nowadays it is used to remind people to remember their origins and hardships, to stay humble and vigilant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要毋忘在莒，記住當年嘅艱苦，繼續努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 m4 mong4 zoi6 geoi2, gei3 zyu6 dong1 nin4 ge3 gaan1 fu2, gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要毋忘在莒，記住當年的艱苦，繼續努力。
examples.english_sentence: We must not forget our past hardships; remember the difficult years and keep working hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師喺歷史課提到「毋忘在莒」，講明要記住國家流亡時期嘅教訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hai2 lik6 si2 fo3 tai4 dou3 「m4 mong4 zoi6 geoi2」, gong2 ming4 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 gwok3 gaa1 lau4 mong4 si4 kei4 ge3 gaau3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師在歷史課提到「毋忘在莒」，說明要記住國家流亡時期的教訓。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher mentioned '毋忘在莒' in history class to explain that we should remember the lessons from the nation's period of exile.

mandarin_meaning: 毋須 / 無須（不必、无需）
english_meaning: no need; need not
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要做某事，相當於「不必」「無須」。常用於書面或較正式語境。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not necessary (equivalent to 'no need' or 'need not'). Often used in written or more formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毋須擔心，我已經處理好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 seoi1 daam1 sam1, ngo5 ji5 ging1 cyu2 lei5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不必擔心，我已經處理好了。
examples.english_sentence: No need to worry; I've already taken care of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毋須客氣，坐低啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 seoi1 haak3 hei3, co5 dai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不必客氣，坐下吧。
examples.english_sentence: No need to be polite, please have a seat.

mandarin_meaning: 毋（wú）——表示否定，相当于“不要/无须”
english_meaning: A classical/written negative particle meaning 'do not' or 'need not'.
explanation_mandarin: 毌为毋的异体字或古字，用作否定，多用于书面或文言，相当于“不要”“无须”，见于“毋須”“毋庸”等词。
explanation_english: 毌 is a variant of 毋, a classical written negative particle meaning 'do not' or 'need not'. It is mainly used in formal or literary contexts and appears in compounds like '毋須' and '毋庸'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毋須擔心，老師會幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 seoi1 daam1 sam1, lou5 si1 wui5 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无需担心，老师会帮助你。
examples.english_sentence: No need to worry; the teacher will help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 毋庸置疑，佢係最佳人選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 jung4 zi6 ji4, keoi5 hai6 zeoi3 gaai1 jan4 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毋庸置疑，他是最佳人选。
examples.english_sentence: There is no doubt; he is the best candidate.

mandarin_meaning: 母（母亲；女性；作为构词成分）
english_meaning: mother; female; a morpheme used in compounds (e.g., mother tongue, alma mater)
explanation_mandarin: 作為單字時可表示母親或雌性，也常用作構詞成分出現在詞語如「母親」「母語」「母校」中。
explanation_english: As a character it can mean mother or female; it is also used as a morpheme in compounds such as 'mother', 'mother tongue', and 'alma mater'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅母親好錫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mou5can1 hou2 sek3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的母亲很疼他。
examples.english_sentence: His mother loves him very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅母語係廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 mou5jyu5 hai6 gwong2dung1waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的母语是粤语。
examples.english_sentence: My mother tongue is Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校係我嘅母校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6haau6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 mou5haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校是我的母校。
examples.english_sentence: This school is my alma mater.

mandarin_meaning: 母乳 / 母亲分泌的奶水（mǔrǔ）
english_meaning: breast milk; mother's milk
explanation_mandarin: 母親分泌的奶水，用於哺育嬰兒，含有營養與抗體，有助於嬰兒免疫和成長。
explanation_english: Milk produced by a mother to feed her infant; rich in nutrients and antibodies, supporting the infant's immunity and growth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 初生嘅嬰兒最好能夠直接吸母乳，因為母乳含有抗體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co1 saang1 ge3 jing1 ji4 zeoi3 hou2 nang4 gau3 zik6 zip3 kap1 mou5 jyu5, jan1 wai6 mou5 jyu5 ham4 jau5 kong3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 初生的婴儿最好能够直接吸母乳，因为母乳含有抗体。
examples.english_sentence: Newborns should ideally feed directly on breast milk because it contains antibodies.

mandarin_meaning: 母公司
english_meaning: parent company
explanation_mandarin: 指控制或擁有一個或多個子公司的公司，通常持有子公司的控股權或管理權。
explanation_english: A company that controls or owns one or more subsidiaries, typically by holding a majority of shares or exercising managerial control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間係我哋集團嘅母公司，負責監督子公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zaap6 tyun4 ge3 mou5 gung1 si1, fu6 zaak3 gaam1 duk6 zi2 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間是我們集團的母公司，負責監督子公司。
examples.english_sentence: This is our group's parent company; it is responsible for overseeing the subsidiaries.

mandarin_meaning: 母子（母親與子女/通常指母親與兒子）
english_meaning: mother and child (often mother and son); the pair or relationship of a mother and her child
explanation_mandarin: 表示母親和子女的組合或關係，常用來指一對母親和小孩（有時特指母親與兒子）。在書面語較常見，口語亦可使用。
explanation_english: Refers to a mother and her child (often mother and son); denotes the pair or the relationship. Commonly used in written language but also used in speech to refer to a mother with her child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 護士喺病房照顧一對母子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu6 si6 hai2 beng6 fong4 ziu3 gu3 jat1 deoi3 mou5 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 护士在病房照顾一对母子。
examples.english_sentence: The nurse is taking care of a mother and child in the ward.

mandarin_meaning: 母带（原始錄音或影片的母本）
english_meaning: master tape / master copy (the original recording or file used for production and duplication)
explanation_mandarin: 指錄音、影片或數位檔案的原始母本，用作後期製作、複製或發行的基礎檔案。
explanation_english: Refers to the original master recording or master file for audio, video, or digital media, used as the source for editing, production, duplication, or distribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅母帶仲未剪接好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 mou5 daai3 zung6 mei6 zin2 zip3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的母带还没剪辑好。
examples.english_sentence: The master tape for this song hasn't been edited yet.

mandarin_meaning: 母性（指母親的天性、母愛或保護本能）
english_meaning: maternal nature; motherhood; maternal instinct
explanation_mandarin: 指母親特有或傾向於照顧、保護與關愛子女的性格、天性或本能，也可泛指人的母性一面。
explanation_english: Refers to the qualities, tendencies, or instincts associated with being a mother—especially affection, protectiveness, and caregiving toward children; can also mean a person's maternal side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅母性好強，一見到細路就忍唔住想抱佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mou5 sing3 hou2 koeng4, jat1 gin3 dou2 sai3 lou6 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 soeng2 pou5 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的母性很強，一看到小孩就忍不住想抱他們。
examples.english_sentence: Her maternal instincts are strong; whenever she sees children she can't help wanting to hug them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢冇自己個小朋友，但佢都有母性的一面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 mou5 zi6 gei2 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5, daan6 keoi5 dou1 jau5 mou5 sing3 dik1 jat1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然她沒有自己的小孩，但她也有母性的一面。
examples.english_sentence: Although she doesn't have her own children, she still has a maternal side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為護士，佢工作入面嘅母性令病人感到安心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 wu6 si6, keoi5 gung1 zok3 jap6 min6 ge3 mou5 sing3 ling6 beng6 jan4 gam2 dou3 on1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作為護士，她在工作中展現的母性讓病人感到安心。
examples.english_sentence: As a nurse, the maternal care she shows at work puts patients at ease.

mandarin_meaning: 母爱 (mǔ'ài)
english_meaning: maternal love; motherly love
explanation_mandarin: 指母親對子女的深厚愛護與關懷，常強調無私奉獻與保護。
explanation_english: Refers to the deep love, care, and devotion a mother has for her children, often emphasizing selflessness and protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽嘅母愛係無條件嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 ge3 mou5 oi3 hai6 mou4 tiu4 gin6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽的母愛是無條件的。
examples.english_sentence: A mother's love is unconditional.

mandarin_meaning: 母凭子贵
english_meaning: a mother gains prestige or elevated status because of her child's success or position
explanation_mandarin: 指母親憑藉兒子的地位或成就而獲得榮寵或地位提升的現象或說法，含有倚仗子女光環的意思。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a situation where a mother's social standing or prestige rises owing to her child's achievements or position; often implies reliance on the child's influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔出人頭地，佢阿媽而家受人恭維，真係母憑子貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 ceot1 jan4 tau4 dei6, keoi5 aa3 maa1 ji4 gaa1 sau6 jan4 gung1 wai4, zan1 hai6 mou5 ping4 zi2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他兒子出人頭地，他媽媽現在受到別人的恭維，真是母凭子贵。
examples.english_sentence: His son has become successful, and now people flatter his mother — truly, a mother gains prestige from her child.

mandarin_meaning: 母校 (mǔxiào)
english_meaning: alma mater
explanation_mandarin: 指自己曾經就讀過的學校，常用來表示對該校的感情或歸屬感。
explanation_english: Refers to the school one once attended; commonly used to express emotional attachment or a sense of belonging to that school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日返咗母校，見到好多舊同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 zo2 mou5 haau6, gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 gau6 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天回到母校，看見了很多老同學。
examples.english_sentence: I went back to my alma mater today and saw many old classmates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每年都會捐錢畀母校做發展基金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 gyun1 cin2 bei2 mou5 haau6 zou6 faat3 zin2 gei1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每年都會捐錢給母校作為發展基金。
examples.english_sentence: He donates money to his alma mater every year as a development fund.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 返母校參加校慶，好多回憶湧上心頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan1 mou5 haau6 caam1 gaa1 haau6 hing3, hou2 do1 wui4 jik1 jung5 soeng5 sam1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 回母校參加校慶，很多回憶湧上心頭。
examples.english_sentence: Returning to my alma mater to attend the school anniversary brings back many memories.

mandarin_meaning: 母牛（成年雌性牛）
english_meaning: cow; adult female cattle
explanation_mandarin: 指成年雌性的牛，通常用于畜牧业，会产犊并可供奶用（若为奶用品种）。
explanation_english: An adult female bovine (cow). Commonly refers to female cattle raised on farms; may give birth to calves and, in dairy breeds, produce milk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個農場有好多母牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 nung4 coeng4 jau5 hou2 do1 mou5 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个农场有很多母牛。
examples.english_sentence: This farm has many cows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 母牛生咗一隻小牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 ngau4 saang1 zo2 jat1 zek3 siu2 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 母牛生了一头小牛。
examples.english_sentence: The cow gave birth to a calf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農夫餵母牛飲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 fu1 wai3 mou5 ngau4 jam2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农夫给母牛喂水。
examples.english_sentence: The farmer gave water to the cow.

mandarin_meaning: 母系（以母親一方為血緣與繼承線的制度或關係）
english_meaning: matrilineal; relating to descent or inheritance traced through the mother's line
explanation_mandarin: 指以母親或母方家族為主要血緣延續、繼承或身份確認來源的社會制度或親屬關係。
explanation_english: Refers to a social system or kinship pattern in which descent, inheritance, and family affiliation are traced through the mother's line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係母系社會，家族嘅姓同財產通常由母親嗰邊傳落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 mou5 hai6 se5 wui6, gaa1 zuk6 ge3 sing3 tung4 coi4 caan2 tung1 soeng4 jau4 mou5 can1 go2 bin1 cyun4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是母系社会，家族的姓氏和财产通常由母亲那一方继承。
examples.english_sentence: They are a matrilineal society; family names and property are usually inherited through the mother's side.

mandarin_meaning: 母亲 (mǔqīn)
english_meaning: mother; female parent
explanation_mandarin: 指女性家長，即自己的母親。這個詞偏正式，多見於書面或正式場合。
explanation_english: Refers to one's mother or female parent. The term is relatively formal and often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅母親今日嚟探我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 mou5 can1 gam1 jat6 lai4 taam3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的母亲今天来看我。
examples.english_sentence: My mother came to visit me today.

mandarin_meaning: 母亲节
english_meaning: Mother's Day
explanation_mandarin: 紀念母親的節日，通常在每年五月的第二個星期日慶祝，人們會送禮、拜訪或表達感謝。
explanation_english: A holiday honoring mothers, typically celebrated on the second Sunday in May; people give gifts, visit, or express gratitude to their mothers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個星期日係母親節，我哋會帶媽媽去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 hai6 mou5 can1 zit3, ngo5 dei6 wui5 daai3 maa4 maa1 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个星期天是母亲节，我们会带妈妈去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Next Sunday is Mother's Day; we'll take mom out to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 母語 (mǔyǔ)，即一個人從小學會並最熟悉的語言
english_meaning: mother tongue; native language
explanation_mandarin: 指個人從小接觸並最熟悉的語言，通常是家庭或族群內使用的語言。
explanation_english: Refers to the language a person learns first and is most comfortable with, typically used within the family or community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅母語係廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 mou5 jyu5 hai6 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的母語是廣東話。
examples.english_sentence: My mother tongue is Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個時成日用母語同屋企人傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 si4 sing4 jat6 jung6 mou5 jyu5 tung4 uk1 kei5 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候經常用母語和家人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: When he was a child, he often used his mother tongue to chat with family.

mandarin_meaning: 母鸡（雌性家禽）；比喻性用法：像“母鸡”一样过分关心或保护他人的人（mother hen）
english_meaning: hen (female chicken); figuratively, a 'mother hen' — an overly protective person
explanation_mandarin: 「母雞」原指雌性的家雞。在口語中也可比喻某人像母雞一樣對他人過度關心或保護。
explanation_english: Literally a female chicken (hen). Colloquially used metaphorically to describe someone who is overly protective or fusses over others (a 'mother hen').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 院子入面有幾隻母雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun6 zi2 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 zek3 mou5 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 院子里有几只母鸡。
examples.english_sentence: There are a few hens in the yard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似隻母雞咁，成日為啲細路擔心同保護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 zek3 mou5 gai1 gam2, sing4 jat6 wai6 di1 sai3 lou6 daam1 sam1 tung4 bou2 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他像母鸡一样，总是为孩子们担心并保护他们。
examples.english_sentence: She's like a mother hen, always worrying about and protecting the children.

mandarin_meaning: 元音（語音中的一類音素）
english_meaning: vowel (a class of speech sounds in phonetics)
explanation_mandarin: 在語音學中，母音是由聲帶振動且氣流不受完全阻礙而發出的音，例如 a、e、i、o、u 等。
explanation_english: In phonetics, a vowel is a speech sound produced with the vocal cords vibrating and an open vocal tract without complete obstruction of airflow; examples include a, e, i, o, u.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 母音係語音學入面嘅一種音素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 jam1 hai6 jyu5 jam1 hok6 jap6 min6 ge3 jat1 zung2 jam1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 母音是語音學中的一種音素。
examples.english_sentence: A vowel is a type of phoneme in phonetics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 英文字母入面有五個主要母音：a、e、i、o、u。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 man4 zi6 mou5 jap6 min6 jau5 ng5 go3 zyu2 jiu3 mou5 jam1: a, e, i, o, u.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 英文字母中有五個主要的母音：a、e、i、o、u。
examples.english_sentence: There are five main vowels in the English alphabet: a, e, i, o, u.

mandarin_meaning: 比基尼环礁（比基尼岛）
english_meaning: Bikini Atoll (an atoll in the Marshall Islands)
explanation_mandarin: 位於馬紹爾群島的環礁，二戰後成為美國進行核試驗的地點，曾造成放射性污染；「比基尼」泳衣的名稱據說亦源自此地的核試引發的震撼效應。
explanation_english: An atoll in the Marshall Islands that was used by the United States for nuclear testing after WWII, resulting in radioactive contamination; the name of the bikini swimsuit is said to have been inspired by the shock caused by those tests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋暑假去咗比基尼島旅行，想去潛水睇海底景觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 syu1 gaa3 heoi3 zo2 bei2 gei1 nei4 dou2 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 heoi3 cim4 seoi2 tai2 hoi2 dai2 ging2 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們暑假去過比基尼島旅行，想去潛水看海底景觀。
examples.english_sentence: We went to Bikini Atoll on summer vacation and want to go diving to see the seabed scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史課講到二戰之後，比基尼島成為美國核試爆的地點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 fo3 gong2 dou3 ji6 ci3 daai6 zin3 zi1 hau6, bei2 gei1 nei4 dou2 sing4 wai4 mei5 gwok3 hat6 si3 baau3 dik1 dei6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 歷史課講到二戰後，比基尼島成為美國核試爆炸的地點。
examples.english_sentence: History class covered that after WWII, Bikini Atoll became a site for U.S. nuclear tests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人話比基尼泳衣個名係從比基尼島嘅核試得嚟，因為當時效果好震撼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 waa6 bei2 gei1 nei4 wing6 ji1 go3 ming4 hai6 cung4 bei2 gei1 nei4 dou2 ge3 hat6 si3 dak1 lai4, jan1 wai6 dong1 si4 haau6 gwo2 hou2 zan3 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說比基尼泳衣的名字來自比基尼島的核試，因為當時產生很大的震撼。
examples.english_sentence: Some say the bikini swimsuit's name came from the nuclear tests at Bikini Atoll because they produced a huge shock.

mandarin_meaning: 沉没成本：已发生且无法收回的成本（sunk cost）
english_meaning: Sunk cost — a cost that has already been incurred and cannot be recovered
explanation_mandarin: 指已经发生并且无法收回的支出或投入，在后续决策中不应作为决策依据。
explanation_english: Refers to expenditures or investments that have already been made and cannot be recovered; they should not influence future decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好畀沉沒成本影響你嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 cam4 mut6 sing4 bun2 jing2 hoeng2 nei5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让沉没成本影响你的决定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let sunk costs affect your decision.

mandarin_meaning: 温文尔雅 (wēn wén ěr yǎ)
english_meaning: gentle and refined; courteous and urbane
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的舉止溫和、有禮貌且有修養，言行文雅不粗魯。
explanation_english: Describes a person whose manner is gentle, courteous, cultured, and refined in speech and behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為人温文爾雅，大家都好鍾意同佢傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 jan4 wan1 man4 ji5 ngaa5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人温文爾雅，大家都很喜歡跟他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He is gentle and refined; everyone likes chatting with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅作者文筆温文爾雅，讀起身好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zok3 ze2 man4 bat1 wan1 man4 ji5 ngaa5, duk6 hei2 san1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書的作者文筆温文爾雅，讀起來很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The author's writing in this book is gentle and refined; it's pleasant to read.

mandarin_meaning: 濕透；淋濕
english_meaning: soaking wet; drenched
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示被水弄得很濕、濕透了，常用於形容衣物或身體在雨中或水中被弄濕的狀態。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be thoroughly wet or drenched, often used to describe clothing or a person after being in the rain or water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落大雨，我條褲都溚溼晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, ngo5 tiu4 fu3 dou1 taap3 sap1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下大雨，我的褲子都濕透了。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily today; my pants are completely soaked.

mandarin_meaning: 说出不吉利的话或容易招来霉运的人（即 '招来霉运' 或 '说倒霉话' 的意思）
english_meaning: jinx; (someone who) jinxes things by saying something unlucky
explanation_mandarin: 形容說出容易導致不幸、倒楣話的人或行為；也可指一句話會帶來壞運氣（俗稱『招衰』）。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who utters words that are believed to bring bad luck, or the act of saying something that jinxes a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啱啱買咗彩票，唔好做烏鴉嘴，唔好而家就講會唔會中獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 aam1 aam1 maai5 zo2 coi2 piu3, m4 hou2 zou6 wu1 aa1 zeoi2, m4 hou2 ji4 gaa1 zau6 gong2 wui5 m4 wui5 zung6 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们刚刚买了彩票，别说倒霉话，别现在就谈会不会中奖。
examples.english_sentence: We just bought the lottery ticket—don't jinx it; don't talk now about whether we'll win.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）因悶熱、緊張或被逼迫而出汗；感到不舒服或尷尬
english_meaning: Colloquial: to sweat from heat, stuffiness, or nervousness; to feel uncomfortable or put on the spot
explanation_mandarin: 「焗汗」為廣東話口語，字面上指被悶熱「焗」到出汗；引申亦可指因緊張、尷尬或被逼問而出汗、感到難受或壓力。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase literally meaning to be 'baked' into sweating. Used for sweating because of heat or stuffiness, and by extension sweating due to nervousness, embarrassment, or being put under pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚好焗，成身都焗汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hou2 guk6, sing4 san1 dou1 guk6 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚很悶熱，我全身都出汗了。
examples.english_sentence: It's really stuffy tonight; I'm sweating all over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細咁樣問我，我即刻焗汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam2 joeng6 man6 ngo5, ngo5 zik1 hak1 guk6 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆這樣問我，我立刻緊張出汗。
examples.english_sentence: When my boss asked me that, I immediately started sweating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐喺冇風嘅房入面，悶到焗汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 hai2 mou5 fung1 ge3 fong2 jap6 min6, mun6 dou3 guk6 hon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐在沒有風的房間裡，悶得出汗。
examples.english_sentence: Sitting in a windless room made me so stuffy that I started sweating.

mandarin_meaning: 不毒不足以為丈夫／不狠不成大丈夫（意指男人若不夠狠或毒，算不上真正的男子漢）
english_meaning: Literally 'no poison, not a man' — a slang saying that a 'real man' must be ruthless, sharp-tongued, or 'toxic.'
explanation_mandarin: 這句粵語俚語字面意思是「沒有毒就不是丈夫」，通常用來形容或調侃一個男人要夠狠、夠毒（如心機重、說話毒舌或處事狠辣）才算有本事。常帶玩笑或諷刺意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning 'no poison, not a man.' It suggests that to be considered a 'real man' one must be ruthless, sharp-tongued, or 'toxic.' Often used jokingly or critically to praise toughness or ruthless behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意好毒，成日講「無毒不丈夫」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 sang1 ji3 hou2 duk6, sing4 jat6 gong2 'mou4 duk6 bat1 zoeng6 fu1'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意很毒，常說「不毒不足以為丈夫」。
examples.english_sentence: He's ruthless in business and often says, 'No poison, not a man.'

mandarin_meaning: 小熊；泰迪熊（也可作親暱稱呼或出現在產品名稱，如熊仔餅）
english_meaning: little bear; teddy bear; (can be) an affectionate nickname or appear in product names (e.g. bear-shaped biscuits)
explanation_mandarin: 「熊仔」在粵語中字面是小熊，常用來指玩具小熊或泰迪熊，也可作為對人的親暱稱呼。在香港語境中，亦常見於食品或商品名稱（如「熊仔餅」）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '熊仔' literally means 'little bear' and commonly refers to a teddy bear or small bear toy. It can also be used as an affectionate nickname and appears in product names in Hong Kong (for example, bear-shaped biscuits).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我送咗個熊仔俾佢，佢好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sung3 zo2 go3 hung4 zai2 bei2 keoi5, keoi5 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我送了一个小熊给她，她很开心。
examples.english_sentence: I gave her a teddy bear; she was very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路抱住隻熊仔瞓覺，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 bou6 zyu6 zek3 hung4 zai2 fan3 gaau3, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩抱著小熊睡覺，真可愛。
examples.english_sentence: The child is sleeping holding a teddy bear — so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有賣熊仔餅，我買咗一包嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 maai6 hung4 zai2 beng2, ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 baau1 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有卖熊仔饼，我买了一包来吃。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket sells bear-shaped biscuits; I bought a pack to eat.

jyutping: wai6 jan4 wai6 (ambiguous; original input mixes character and jyutping)
mandarin_meaning: 不明确（可能指「為人為…」或「為…而…」，常見意思：為了某人/某事）
english_meaning: Ambiguous phrase; likely intended meaning: 'for someone' / 'for the sake of (someone or something)' or an expression about how one behaves as a person
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞/介詞性短語（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 輸入的「爲jan1 wai6」在書寫上混合了字和注音，並非標準詞形。最可能的解釋是與「為人」或「為……而……／為了……」相關，意指「為了某人或某事」或描述一個人的處世方式。具體意思要視上下文而定。
explanation_english: The input mixes characters and jyutping and is therefore ambiguous. The most likely readings relate to '為人' (to be, to conduct oneself) or '為... (而...)' meaning 'for the sake of somebody/something.' The exact meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己係為人好，成日幫人做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 wai6 jan4 hou2, seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常說自己為人很好，經常幫人做事。
examples.english_sentence: He often says he's a good person and frequently helps others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係為咗金錢而做呢啲決定，諗下人情同良心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 wai6 zo2 gam1 cin2 ji4 zou6 ni1 di1 kyut3 ding6, lam2 haa5 jan4 cing4 tung4 loeng4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只是為了金錢而做這些決定，考慮一下人情與良心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make decisions just for money; consider human relations and your conscience.

mandarin_meaning: 得罪众人；招致众人厌恶
english_meaning: to incur public dislike; to make oneself widely unpopular; to offend many people
explanation_mandarin: 做了或說了讓很多人不滿、討厭或生氣的事，從而被大眾厭惡或得罪多人。
explanation_english: Doing or saying something that causes many people to dislike or resent you, resulting in widespread unpopularity or hostility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講嘢只會犯衆憎，唔好再挑事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gong2 je5 zi2 wui5 faan6 zung3 zang1, m4 hou2 zoi3 tiu1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样说话只会得罪大家，不要再挑事了。
examples.english_sentence: Saying things like that will only make everyone dislike you; don't pick a fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度講人壞話，搞到成班同事都討厭佢，真係犯衆憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gong2 jan4 waai6 waa6, gaau2 dou3 sing4 baan1 tung4 si6 dou1 tou2 jim3 keoi5, zan1 hai6 faan6 zung3 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在背后说别人的坏话，弄得一堆同事都讨厌他，真是得罪众人。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps badmouthing others, causing his coworkers to dislike him — he's really made himself unpopular with everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 痛斥 (tòngchì)：严厉斥责、公开谴责
english_meaning: to denounce severely; to sharply rebuke or lambaste (often publicly)
explanation_mandarin: 痛斥：以強烈的語氣斥責或公開譴責某人的言行，常用於正式或新聞報導語境。
explanation_english: To rebuke or condemn someone harshly and often publicly; to criticize severely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺記者會上，市長痛斥貪污行為，要求徹查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gei3 ze2 wui6 seong6, si5 zoeng2 tung3 cik1 taam1 wu1 hang4 wai6, jiu1 kau4 cit3 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在记者会上，市长痛斥贪污行为，要求彻查。
examples.english_sentence: At the press conference, the mayor denounced the corruption and demanded a thorough investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師喺課堂上痛斥學生抄襲，仲話會嚴懲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hai2 fo3 tong4 seong6 tung3 cik1 hok6 saang1 caau1 zaap6, zung6 waa6 wui5 jim4 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师在课堂上痛斥学生抄袭，并说会严惩。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher severely rebuked the student for plagiarism in class and said there would be strict punishment.

mandarin_meaning: 被送去坐牢 / 要坐牢
english_meaning: to be sent to jail; to end up in prison
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，常於香港粵語中使用，表示某人可能會被捕並送進監獄。語氣較粗俗、非正式。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang phrase (commonly used in Hong Kong) meaning someone is likely to be arrested and sent to prison. Informal and somewhat coarse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷嘢俾人捉，可能要監粗嚟喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 je5 bei2 jan4 zuk1, ho2 nang4 jiu3 gaam1 cou1 lei4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷東西被人抓到，可能要被送去坐牢了。
examples.english_sentence: He stole something and got caught; he might be sent to jail.

mandarin_meaning: 眼不见为净（眼不见，心不烦 / 眼不见为净）
english_meaning: Out of sight, out of mind.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是看不到就不會被煩惱或困擾，常用來表示寧可不去關注某些事情以保持心情平靜。
explanation_english: Means that if something is out of sight, it won't trouble you emotionally—used to express preferring not to know or see something to stay calm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於公司啲內幕，我寧願眼不見爲淨，唔想知道太多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 gung1 si1 di1 noi6 muk6, ngo5 ning4 jyun6 ngaan5 bat1 gin3 wai4 zeng6, m4 soeng2 zi1 dou6 taai3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 對於公司的內幕，我寧願眼不見為淨，不想知道太多。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding the company's internal affairs, I'd rather keep my eyes off it—I don't want to know too much.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）愛唸叨、碎碎念；不停抱怨（常見正序為「濕濕碎」）
english_meaning: Colloquial term meaning to nag/whine persistently about trivial matters (often used as a descriptor: 'whiny, nitpicking')
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，表示人經常為小事抱怨或唠叨。常見的慣用說法是「濕濕碎」，帶有貶義，形容令人厭煩的唠叨行為。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe someone who constantly nags or complains about trivial things. Often seen as the form "濕濕碎"; has a negative/annoyed connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日碎濕濕，講咩都唔滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 seoi3 sap1 sap1, gong2 me1 dou1 m4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是唠唠叨叨，对什么都不满意。
examples.english_sentence: He's always whining and never satisfied with anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲小事唔使碎濕濕，傾下就算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 siu2 si6 m4 sai2 seoi3 sap1 sap1, king1 haa5 zau6 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些小事不用唠唠叨叨，谈一谈就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't nitpick over these small things — just talk it out and let it go.

mandarin_meaning: 通過發送「筆芯」（愛心表情）或類似訊息讓對方心動、被吸引（網路/口語用法）
english_meaning: to make someone feel attracted or flattered by sending '筆芯' (heart emojis) or similar messages; to flirt/send hearts online
explanation_mandarin: 「筆芯」原為網絡用語，象徵愛心或表情；加上「電」表示使人心動或被吸引。整體用來形容用發送愛心／曖昧訊息的方式去撩人或令對方心動。
explanation_english: A colloquial/internet expression: '筆芯' represents a heart (heart emoji), and '電' means to electrify/attract. Together it describes sending hearts or flirtatious messages that make someone feel attracted or flattered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺我張相下面傳啲筆芯畀我，真係令我好心動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 zoeng1 soeng2 haa6 min6 cyun4 di1 bat1 sam1 bei2 ngo5, zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 hou2 sam1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在我照片下面傳筆芯（發愛心表情）給我，真的讓我很心動。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps sending me '筆芯' (heart emojis) under my photos; it really makes my heart race.

mandarin_meaning: 指平凡、平庸或地位低微的人；常帶貶義，表示不值得重視的人
english_meaning: persons of ordinary or mediocre caliber; people of no particular distinction (often derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 「等閒之輩」用來形容那些平凡、平庸或不值得特別重視的人，常帶有貶低意味。也可用於強調某人不是普通之輩（如「他不是等閒之輩」）。
explanation_english: The phrase describes ordinary or mediocre people, often with a derogatory connotation implying they are not worth special attention. It can also be used to emphasize that someone is not an ordinary person (e.g., "He is no ordinary man").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好小看佢，佢唔係等閒之輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 siu2 hon3 keoi5, keoi5 m4 hai6 dang2 haan4 zi1 bui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看他，他不是等閒之輩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him; he's no ordinary person.

mandarin_meaning: 就这样吧；算是这样
english_meaning: let it be like this; that's that; accept the situation (colloquial, resigned)
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某個結果或情況接受、妥協或無可奈何，類似「就這樣算了」或「就這樣吧」。常用於口語。
explanation_english: Used to express acceptance or resignation to an outcome or situation—similar to 'let's call it a day', 'that's that', or 'we'll let it be'. It's a colloquial Cantonese phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚冇得再傾，算係咁啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 mou5 dak1 zoi3 king1, syun3 hai6 gam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚没法再谈了，就这样吧。
examples.english_sentence: We can't discuss this tonight any further — let's just leave it at that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成件事雖然唔完美，但都算係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 gin6 si6 seoi1 jin4 m4 jyun4 mei5, daan6 dou1 syun3 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事虽然不完美，但也就算这样吧。
examples.english_sentence: Although the matter isn't perfect, we'll let it be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 試咗問老闆加人工，但佢唔肯，算係咁啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si3 zo2 man6 lou5 baan2 gaa1 jan4 gung1, daan6 keoi5 m4 hang2, syun3 hai6 gam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 试着向老板要加薪，但他不同意，就算这样吧。
examples.english_sentence: I tried asking the boss for a raise but he refused — well, that's that.

mandarin_meaning: 继承香火；延续家族的祭祀与香火
english_meaning: to continue the ancestral incense/rituals; to carry on the family's lineage or legacy
partOfSpeech_english: verb-object phrase (can function as a noun)
explanation_mandarin: 指後代繼續奉祀祖先、保持家中的香火和祭祀傳統，也可引申為延續家族香火或事業、遺志。
explanation_english: Refers to descendants continuing ancestral worship—keeping the household incense and ritual traditions alive. It can also be used figuratively to mean continuing a family's lineage, legacy, or tradition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間廟冇子孫，冇人繼後香燈，最終香火都熄咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 miu6 mou5 zi2 syun1, mou5 jan4 gai3 hau6 hoeng1 dang1, zeoi3 zung1 hoeng1 fo2 dou1 sik1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座庙没有子孙，没有人继后香灯，最后香火都熄灭了。
examples.english_sentence: This temple has no descendants to carry on the ancestral incense, and in the end the incense offerings died out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯好擔心冇人可以繼後香燈，所以佢成日囑咐細佬要生仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3 hou2 daam1 sam1 mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 gai3 hau6 hoeng1 dang1, so2 ji5 keoi5 seng4 jat6 zuk1 fu3 sai3 lou2 jiu3 saang1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯父很担心没有人可以继后香灯，所以他常常嘱咐弟弟要生孩子。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle was worried there would be no one to continue the ancestral incense, so he often urged his younger brother to have children.

mandarin_meaning: 听书（听有声书、听录音或听讲座/故事）
english_meaning: to listen to audiobooks / to listen to recordings, lectures, or storytelling
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，「聽書」通常指透過錄音或線上平台聽有聲書、廣播劇、播客，或指聽別人講課、說故事。常用來描述在通勤或休閒時以聽的方式「閱讀」或學習。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '聽書' generally means listening to audiobooks, radio dramas, podcasts, or recordings, and can also refer to listening to lectures or storytelling. It describes 'reading' or learning by listening, often during commuting or leisure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家返工搭車嘅時候成日聽書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 faan1 gung1 daap3 ce1 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 teng1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在上班搭車的時候常常聽有聲書。
examples.english_sentence: I often listen to audiobooks while commuting to work.

mandarin_meaning: 胸口發緊、心裡怦怦、緊張或興奮（俗語）
english_meaning: chest fluttering; feeling nervous, excited, or having heart palpitations (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「胸泳」是香港口語俗語，字面為「胸口像在游動」，用來形容因緊張、興奮或心緒波動而胸口怦怦、心跳加速或不安。屬非正式用語，在書面語較少見。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial expression literally meaning "chest swims". It describes the sensation of chest fluttering or palpitations from nervousness, excitement, or emotional turmoil. Informal and regionally used rather than standard/formal Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見到佢嗰陣，成個人胸泳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 dou3 keoi5 go2 zan6, seng4 go3 jan4 hung1 wing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到他／她的時候，整個人胸口怦怦（很緊張或很興奮）。
examples.english_sentence: When I saw them, my whole chest fluttered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前我好胸泳，連呼吸都覺得唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 ngo5 hou2 hung1 wing6, lin4 fu1 kap1 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前我很緊張，連呼吸都覺得不順暢。
examples.english_sentence: I was really nervous before the exam; even my breathing felt off.

mandarin_meaning: 脱口而出 (tuō kǒu ér chū)
english_meaning: blurt out; say something impulsively without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 形容话语未经思考就说出来，常指不经意或一时口快说出不该说的话。
explanation_english: To say something suddenly and impulsively without thinking, often referring to unintentionally saying something inappropriate or revealing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到嗰件事就脫口而出，講咗啲唔應該講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 go2 gin6 si6 zau6 tyut3 hau2 ji4 ceot1, gong2 zo2 di1 m4 jing1 goi1 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到那件事就脱口而出，说了不该说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He blurted it out as soon as he heard about it and said something he shouldn't have.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心脫口而出，惹得老闆唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 tyut3 hau2 ji4 ceot1, je5 dak1 lou5 baan2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心脱口而出，惹得老板不开心。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally blurted it out and made the boss upset.

mandarin_meaning: 致辭（發表講話、致詞）
english_meaning: to give a speech; to deliver remarks or an address
explanation_mandarin: 指在公開場合（如典禮、會議、開幕式等）發表講話或致辭，通常為正式或簡短的發言。
explanation_english: To speak or deliver remarks at a public or formal event (e.g., ceremonies, meetings, openings). Usually a formal or brief address.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅開幕禮上，校長會致詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 hoi1 muk6 lei5 soeng6, haau6 zoeng2 wui5 zi3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的開幕禮上，校長會致辭。
examples.english_sentence: At today's opening ceremony, the principal will give a speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到時你要準備一段致詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 si4 nei5 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 jat1 dyun6 zi3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到時請你準備一段致辭。
examples.english_sentence: Please prepare a short speech for that time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 致詞時間每人限三分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi3 ci4 si4 gaan1 mui5 jan4 haan6 saam1 fan1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 致辭時間每人限三分鐘。
examples.english_sentence: Each person is limited to three minutes for their remarks.

mandarin_meaning: 包含；含有（某種內容或意義）
english_meaning: to contain; to embody; to imply
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物內含、包含某種內容、意義或情感，語氣較書面或正式，常用於文章或學術語境。
explanation_english: Indicates that something contains or embodies certain content, meaning, or emotion. The term is relatively formal and often used in written or academic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章蘊含住深刻嘅情感同歷史記憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 wan6 ham4 zyu6 sam1 hak1 ge3 cing4 gam2 tung4 lik6 si2 gei3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章蕴含着深刻的情感和历史记忆。
examples.english_sentence: This article contains deep emotions and historical memories.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻坏人结成一伙，互相勾结（如“狼狈为奸”或“一丘之貉”）
english_meaning: Literally 'a nest of snakes and rats'; figuratively a group of unscrupulous people colluding together — a nest of villains or crooks in cahoots.
explanation_mandarin: “蛇鼠一窝”原指蛇和老鼠聚在一处，现用于比喻一群坏人互相勾结、结成一伙，通常含有强烈的贬义。
explanation_english: Originally meaning 'snakes and rats in one nest', this idiom figuratively describes a group of bad people who collude with each other. It is derogatory and used to accuse people of being a gang of wrongdoers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲貪官同商人，真係蛇鼠一窩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 taam1gwaan1 tung4 soeng1jan4, zan1 hai6 se4 syu2 jat1 wo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些贪官和商人，真是蛇鼠一窝。
examples.english_sentence: Those corrupt officials and businessmen are truly a nest of snakes and rats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞揭發佢哋經營地下交易，睇嚟係蛇鼠一窩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1man4 git3faat3 keoi5dei6 ging1jing4 dei6haa6 gaau1jik6, tai2 lai4 hai6 se4 syu2 jat1 wo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻揭露他们经营地下交易，看来是一伙狼狈为奸的人。
examples.english_sentence: The news exposed their underground dealings; it looks like they're a ring of people in cahoots.

mandarin_meaning: 蟹膏、蟹黃（俗寫或罕見用法）
english_meaning: crab roe / crab paste (rare or colloquial spelling)
