mandarin_meaning: 污蔑 / 诽谤 (miè) — 诋毁、污辱他人名誉
english_meaning: to slander; to smear someone's reputation; to vilify
explanation_mandarin: 指以不实或恶意的言论损害他人名誉、诋毁、诽谤。
explanation_english: To make false or malicious statements that damage someone's reputation; to defame or vilify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好無憑據咁污衊佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mou4 pang4 geoi3 gam2 wu1 mit6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在没有证据的情况下污蔑他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slander him without evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 走；行走；可行；行得通（口語中亦可表示“可以”）
english_meaning: to walk; to go; to be feasible; (informal) to be okay/can
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词；（口语）形容词/副词用法
explanation_mandarin: 「行」在粵語主要作動詞，表示行走或前往某處；在口語中亦可表示某事可行、可以接受，例如「唔行」表示不可行或不可以。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 行 (haang4) is primarily a verb meaning to walk or to go. Colloquially it can also mean something is feasible or acceptable (e.g. '唔行' = not workable/not okay).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行路小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 lou6 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走路小心点。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去逛街。
examples.english_sentence: We're going shopping tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做唔行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 m4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不行。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing won't work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃唔行得通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 haang4 dak1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划行不通。
examples.english_sentence: This plan won't work / isn't feasible.

mandarin_meaning: 行之有效（經實踐檢驗後能奏效、有效可行）
english_meaning: Effective; proven to work when implemented
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種方法、措施或做法經過實踐檢驗，能夠達到預期效果，切實可行。
explanation_english: Indicates that a method or measure has been tested in practice and achieves the intended result; practical and effective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個辦法行之有效，可以繼續用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 baan6faat3 hang4 zi1 jau5 haau6, ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个办法行之有效，可以继续使用。
examples.english_sentence: This method is effective and can continue to be used.

mandarin_meaning: 乞討 (向人或公眾請求施舍金錢或食物)
english_meaning: to beg; to solicit money or food (panhandle)
explanation_mandarin: 指向路人或公眾請求施舍金錢或食物的行為，常用於描述乞討或討飯的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of asking passersby or the public for money or food; used to describe begging or panhandling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上有個老人家喺行乞，好心人都會畀啲嘢佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng5 jau5 go3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 hai2 haang4 hat1, hou2 sam1 jan4 dou1 wui5 bei2 di1 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上有位老人家在行乞，好心人都会给他一些东西。
examples.english_sentence: There is an elderly person begging on the street; kind people will give him something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為失業而要出街行乞，生活好困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sat1 jip6 ji4 jiu3 ceot1 gaai1 haang4 hat1, sang1 wut6 hou2 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為失業而要上街行乞，生活很困難。
examples.english_sentence: He has to go out begging because he's unemployed; life is very difficult.

mandarin_meaning: 办事；处事；行动
english_meaning: to act; to handle matters; conduct or manner of doing things
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be a noun meaning 'conduct' or 'way of doing things')
explanation_mandarin: 表示行动、办理事务或处事的方式。可作动词，表示“做事、处理事务”；也可作名词，表示“处事的方式或态度”。
explanation_english: Refers to acting or handling matters, or the manner in which one conducts affairs. Can be used as a verb ('to do things/handle matters') or as a noun ('manner of conduct').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行事好謹慎，唔會衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang4 si6 hou2 gan2 seon2, m4 wui5 cung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很谨慎，不会冲动。
examples.english_sentence: He handles things very cautiously and doesn't act impulsively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司行事好保守，唔太願意冒險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hang4 si6 hou2 bou2 sau2, m4 taai3 jyun6 ji3 mou6 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间公司行事很保守，不太愿意冒险。
examples.english_sentence: This company acts very conservatively and is not very willing to take risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家對佢行事嘅方法都有意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 deoi3 keoi5 hang4 si6 ge3 fong1 faat3 dou1 jau5 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家对他行事的方法都有意见。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone has opinions about the way he does things.

mandarin_meaning: 行事历 / 日历（用来记录日期和安排活动、会议或重要事项的工具）
english_meaning: calendar; planner; schedule (a tool for recording dates and scheduling events, appointments, or tasks)
explanation_mandarin: 行事曆是用來記錄日期與安排活動、會議或提醒事項的工具，可指紙本日曆或電子行事曆（如手機或電腦上的日程表）。
explanation_english: A calendar or planner used to record dates and arrange events, meetings, or reminders. It can refer to a physical calendar or an electronic calendar (e.g., on a phone or computer).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將今年嘅行事曆放喺辦公室入面，方便查閱會議時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 gam1 nin4 ge3 haang4 si6 lik6 fong3 hai2 baan6 gung1 sat1 jap6 min6, fong1 bin6 caa4 jyut6 wui6 ji5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把今年的行事曆放在辦公室裡，方便查閱會議時間。
examples.english_sentence: I put this year's calendar in the office so it's easy to check meeting times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以喺我嘅行事曆入面加個提醒，禮拜一朝早九點開會？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 ngo5 ge3 haang4 si6 lik6 jap6 min6 gaa1 go3 tai4 jing4, lai5 baai3 jat1 ziu1 zou2 gau2 dim2 hoi1 wui6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在我的行事曆裡加個提醒嗎？禮拜一早上九點開會。
examples.english_sentence: Can you add a reminder to my calendar? We have a meeting at 9 AM on Monday.

mandarin_meaning: 行人 (xíngrén)，过路人
english_meaning: pedestrian; passerby
explanation_mandarin: 指在道路上步行的人，通常用于交通或路上通行的語境，例如人行道或過馬路的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to a person walking on the road; used in traffic or street contexts, e.g., sidewalks or crossing the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行人過馬路要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 jan4 gwo3 maa5 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行人过马路要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Pedestrians should be more careful when crossing the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行人路上唔好泊車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 jan4 lou6 soeng6 m4 hou2 paak3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人行道上不要停车。
examples.english_sentence: Don't park on the sidewalk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 交通燈變綠，行人先可以過馬路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau1 tung1 dang1 bin3 luk6, haang4 jan4 sin1 ho2 ji5 gwo3 maa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 交通灯变绿时，行人才能过马路。
examples.english_sentence: When the traffic light turns green, pedestrians can cross the road.

mandarin_meaning: 人行天桥
english_meaning: pedestrian overpass; footbridge
explanation_mandarin: 供行人穿越馬路的高架通道，常見於繁忙路段，用以提高行人安全與交通流暢。
explanation_english: An elevated walkway that allows pedestrians to cross a road above street level, commonly found over busy streets to improve pedestrian safety and traffic flow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放學嗰陣，大家都會經過學校對面嘅行人天橋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 hok6 go2 zan6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 wui5 ging1 gwo3 hok6 haau6 deoi3 min6 ge3 hang4 jan4 tin1 kiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放学的时候，大家都会经过学校对面的行人天桥。
examples.english_sentence: After school, everyone passes the pedestrian overpass opposite the school.

mandarin_meaning: 行人专用区
english_meaning: pedestrian-only zone; pedestrian area
explanation_mandarin: 指只供行人通行、不允许机动车或其他车辆进入的街道或区域，通常用于繁忙的商业步行区或临时封闭道路。
explanation_english: Refers to a street or area designated only for pedestrians, prohibiting motor vehicles or other traffic; commonly used for busy shopping streets or temporary street closures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街由今日起劃為行人專用區，車輛唔可以駛入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 jau4 gam1 jat6 hei2 waak6 wai4 haang4 jan4 zyun1 jung6 keoi1, ce1 loeng6 m4 ho2 ji5 sai2 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街从今天起划为行人专用区，车辆不得驶入。
examples.english_sentence: This street has been designated a pedestrian-only zone from today; vehicles are not allowed to enter.

mandarin_meaning: 人行道
english_meaning: sidewalk; pavement
explanation_mandarin: 指供行人行走、與車道分隔的道路部分，通常在人行道上禁止停放車輛。
explanation_english: Refers to the part of the road designated for pedestrians, separated from the carriageway; typically parking vehicles on the sidewalk is prohibited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行人路上唔好泊車，會阻住行人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 jan4 lou6 soeng6 m4 hou2 bok3 ce1, wui5 zo2 zyu6 haang4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人行道上不要停车，会挡住行人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't park on the sidewalk; you'll block pedestrians.

mandarin_meaning: 人行道
english_meaning: sidewalk; pavement; pedestrian path
explanation_mandarin: 指供行人行走的道路或路邊通道，通常位於車行道旁。香港廣東話常稱為「行人道」，大陸普通話多稱「人行道」。
explanation_english: A path or portion of the road designated for pedestrians, usually alongside the carriageway. Commonly called "行人道" in Cantonese and "人行道" in Mandarin; equivalent to sidewalk or pavement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條行人道最近整得幾乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 hang4 jan4 dou6 zeoi3 gan6 zing2 dak1 gei2 gon1 zeng6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條人行道最近整得很乾淨。
examples.english_sentence: This sidewalk has been cleaned up recently and is quite clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行人道上有隻狗，行路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 jan4 dou6 soeng6 jau5 zek3 gau2, hang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人行道上有只狗，走路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: There's a dog on the sidewalk; be careful when walking.

mandarin_meaning: 行使（權利、權力或職權）
english_meaning: to exercise (a right, power, authority); to exert or employ a function/duty
explanation_mandarin: 表示運用或施展權利、權力或職權，也可指實施某項職能或職責。
explanation_english: Used to indicate exercising or employing a right, power, or authority, or carrying out a particular function or duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為董事，佢可以行使投票權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 dung2 si6, keoi5 ho2 ji5 hang4 si2 tau4 piu3 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为董事，他可以行使投票权。
examples.english_sentence: As a director, he can exercise his voting rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方行使職權，封鎖咗該區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hang4 si2 zik1 kyun4, fung1 so2 zo2 goi1 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方行使职权，封锁了该区。
examples.english_sentence: The police exercised their authority and cordoned off the area.

mandarin_meaning: 行使價 / 行使价（期權術語）
english_meaning: exercise price (also known as strike price)
explanation_mandarin: 在金融期權中，行使價是指期權買方在行使期權時，可以依照此價格買入或賣出標的資產的價格。通常用於評估期權是否處於價內、價平或價外狀態。
explanation_english: In finance, the exercise price is the price at which the holder of an option can buy or sell the underlying asset when exercising the option. It is used to determine whether an option is in-the-money, at-the-money, or out-of-the-money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份期權嘅行使價係每股五十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 kei4 kyun4 ge3 hang4 si2 gaa3 hai6 mui5 gu2 ng5 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份期權的行使價是每股五十元。
examples.english_sentence: The exercise price of this option is HK$50 per share.

mandarin_meaning: 行俠仗義 (xíng xiá zhàng yì)：像俠士一樣扶弱抑強、主持正義
english_meaning: to act chivalrously and uphold justice; to do righteous, knight-errant deeds
explanation_mandarin: 表示像俠士一樣，見義勇為、扶助弱者、維護公理和正義的行為或態度。
explanation_english: Describes behaving like a chivalrous hero: standing up for justice, helping the weak, and acting righteously or bravely on moral grounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個行俠仗義嘅人，成日幫人解圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 haang4 hap6 zoeng6 ji6 ge3 jan4, sing4 jat6 bong1 jan4 gaai2 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個行俠仗義的人，經常幫人解圍。
examples.english_sentence: He's a chivalrous person who often helps others out of trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 上厕所；去方便
english_meaning: to go to the toilet; to relieve oneself (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语的委婉说法，表示去厕所或排泄（如小便或大便）。常用于口语中，比较礼貌或含蓄地表达需要上卫生间。
explanation_english: A Cantonese euphemistic phrase meaning to go to the toilet or relieve oneself. Commonly used in colloquial speech as a polite or indirect way to say you need the restroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等一陣，我去行個方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 jat1 zan6, ngo5 heoi3 hang4 go3 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下，我去上厕所。
examples.english_sentence: Wait a moment, I'm going to the restroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前記得行個方便，唔好中途先搵廁所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 gei3 dak1 hang4 go3 fong1 bin6, m4 hou2 zung1 tou4 sin1 wan2 ci3 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门前记得去趟厕所，不要中途才找厕所。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to use the restroom before you leave, don't wait until you're out to find one.

mandarin_meaning: 实施暴力或杀人；行凶
english_meaning: to commit an act of violence or murder; to carry out an attack
explanation_mandarin: 表示以暴力方式攻擊他人，常指殺人或嚴重傷害的行為。
explanation_english: Means to carry out a violent act against someone, often referring to murder or serious assault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚有人喺地鐵站行兇，已經被捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan5 jau5 jan4 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 hang4 hung1, ji5 ging1 bei6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚有人在地鐵站行兇，已經被捕。
examples.english_sentence: Last night someone carried out an attack at the subway station and was arrested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方表示疑犯計劃喺市中心行兇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 biu2 si6 ji4 faan6 gai3 waak6 hai2 si5 zung1 sam1 hang4 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方表示，疑犯計劃在市中心行兇。
examples.english_sentence: The police said the suspect planned to carry out an attack in the city center.

mandarin_meaning: 先行一步；領先；搶先採取行動
english_meaning: to be one step ahead; to take the lead; to act before others
explanation_mandarin: 表示在行動或做事上比別人提早或領先，常用來形容搶先採取行動或取得優勢。
explanation_english: Indicates acting earlier or being ahead of others in action or progress; commonly used to describe taking initiative or gaining an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日行先一步，所以好快有升職機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 hang4 sin1 jat1 bou6, so2 ji5 hou2 faai3 jau5 sing1 zik1 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是先行一步，所以很快有升职机会。
examples.english_sentence: He always stays one step ahead at work, so he quickly gets promotion opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果想喺市場上生存，就要行先一步，搶佔客源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 sang1 cyun4, zau6 jiu3 hang4 sin1 jat1 bou6, coeng2 zim6 haak3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果想在市场上生存，就要先行一步，抢占客源。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to survive in the market, you must be one step ahead and seize customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每次都行先一步，成為團隊嘅領導者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 ci3 dou1 hang4 sin1 jat1 bou6, sing4 wai4 tyun4 deoi2 ge3 ling5 dou6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都先行一步，成为团队的领导者。
examples.english_sentence: He always takes the lead and becomes the leader of the team.

mandarin_meaning: 你先去冒險／你先去送死（口語、帶挑釁或推拒風險的說法）
english_meaning: Go first and get killed (colloquial) — meaning 'you go first and take the risk' (often said provocatively or to avoid taking the risk oneself)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 感嘆詞 / 口語短語（俚語）
explanation_mandarin: 一句廣東話俚語，字面意思是「先走的先死」，常用來挑釁別人去冒險或拒絕自己承擔風險，語氣可帶嘲諷或諷刺。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression literally meaning 'go first, die first.' Used to taunt someone into taking a risky action or to refuse to take the risk oneself. Tone is often provocative or sarcastic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條橋爛咗，唔好行先死先，等專業人員嚟修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 kiu4 laan6 zo2, m4 hou2 haang4 sin1 sei2 sin1, dang2 zyun1 jip6 jan4 jyun4 lai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座桥坏了，别先去冒险，等专业人员来修。
examples.english_sentence: This bridge is broken — don't go first and risk it; wait for the professionals to fix it.

mandarin_meaning: 业内；行业内部
english_meaning: within the industry; industry insider; internal to a trade
explanation_mandarin: 表示屬於某個行業或行業內部的範疇或人，常用來指「業內人士」或「行內的做法、術語、規矩」。口語常見用法。
explanation_english: Refers to being within a particular industry or trade; used to denote industry insiders or things internal to a trade (practices, jargon, rules). Commonly used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係行內人，對呢啲法規好熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hang4 noi6 jan4, deoi3 ni1 di1 faat3 gwai1 hou2 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是行内人，对这些法规很熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: He is an industry insider and very familiar with these regulations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單交易係行內程序，外人未必明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 gaau1 jik6 hai6 hang4 noi6 cing4 zeoi6, ngoi6 jan4 mei6 bat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔交易属于行业内部的程序，外人未必能理解。
examples.english_sentence: This transaction follows internal industry procedures; outsiders may not understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅係行內術語，你可能要解釋俾我聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 hang4 noi6 seot6 jyu5, nei5 ho2 nang4 jiu3 gaai2 sik1 bei2 ngo5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的是行内术语，你可能要给我解释一下。
examples.english_sentence: He's using industry jargon; you might need to explain it to me.

mandarin_meaning: 行內人 / 內行人（行業內部的人、內部人士）
english_meaning: insider; someone within an industry or circle who knows the internal situation
explanation_mandarin: 指在某個行業或圈子裡，對內部情況、操作流程或人脈關係熟悉的人；即內行或內部人士。
explanation_english: Refers to a person within a particular industry or circle who is familiar with internal affairs, procedures, or connections — an insider or someone experienced in the field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好問佢，佢唔係行內人，唔識內情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 man6 keoi5, keoi5 m4 hai6 haang4 noi6 jan4, m4 sik1 noi6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要問他，他不是行內人，不懂內情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask him; he's not an insider and doesn't know the inside story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做招標要問行內人，佢哋識得邊間公司可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ziu1 biu1 jiu3 man6 haang4 noi6 jan4, keoi5 dei6 sik1 dak1 bin1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做招標要問行內人，他們知道哪間公司可靠。
examples.english_sentence: When bidding, ask insiders; they know which companies are reliable.

mandarin_meaning: 在公司上班／做公司職員
english_meaning: to work for a company; to have an office job
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語，指在公司或辦公室上班，做公司職員，常用以區別於自僱、做生意或外勤工作。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to work at a company or in an office as an employee; often contrasted with being self-employed or doing field work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家唔想行公司，寧願做自由職業者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 m4 soeng2 hang4 gung1 si1, ning4 jyun6 zou6 zi6 jau4 zik1 jip6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在不想在公司上班，寧願做自由職業者。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to work for a company right now; I'd rather be a freelancer.

mandarin_meaning: 進進出出 / 隨意出入 / 常來往
english_meaning: to come and go freely; to enter and leave frequently
explanation_mandarin: 表示經常進出某地或可以隨意進出的狀態，也可用來形容來來往往很頻繁。
explanation_english: Indicates frequent coming and going at a place or the ability to enter and leave at will; can describe constant back-and-forth movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同呢間公司好熟，行出行入都無人阻佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 suk6, hang4 ceot1 hang4 jap6 dou1 mou5 jan4 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和這間公司很熟，進進出出都沒有人阻攔他。
examples.english_sentence: He's very familiar with this company; he comes and goes without anyone stopping him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街成日有人行出行入，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 seng4 jat6 jau5 jan4 hang4 ceot1 hang4 jap6, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條街經常有人進進出出，很熱鬧。
examples.english_sentence: People are always coming and going on this street; it's lively.

mandarin_meaning: 执行刑罚；处决（尤指执行死刑或其他严厉的司法处罚）
english_meaning: to carry out a punishment; to execute (a sentence), especially a death sentence or other serious judicial penalty
explanation_mandarin: 指由司法或權力機關對被判刑者執行刑罰，通常用於指執行死刑或其他嚴重的刑罰，也可泛指實施處罰的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to the carrying out of a legal punishment by judicial or authoritative bodies, often used for executing a death sentence or other serious penalties; can also broadly mean the implementation of a punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭已經判處死刑，行刑日期尚未確定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 ting4 ji5 ging1 pun3 cyu3 sei2 hang4, hang4 jing4 jat6 kei4 soeng6 mei6 kok3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法庭已经判处死刑，行刑日期尚未确定。
examples.english_sentence: The court has sentenced him to death; the date for the execution has not yet been set.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺古代，有啲人犯重罪會被官府公開行刑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gu2 doi6, jau5 di1 jan4 faan6 zung6 zeoi6 wui5 bei6 gun1 fu2 gung1 hoi1 hang4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代，有些人犯重罪會被官府公開行刑。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, some people who committed serious crimes were publicly executed by the authorities.

mandarin_meaning: 队伍；行列；队列（也可指加入某一群体或行列）
english_meaning: a line, rank, column, or procession of people; (figuratively) the ranks or joining a group
explanation_mandarin: 表示排列成行的隊伍或列隊，例如遊行或排隊時的行列；也可引申為加入某一群體或隊伍（如「加入行列」）。
explanation_english: Refers to a line, rank, column, or procession of people (e.g., a parade or a queue). It can also be used figuratively to mean joining the ranks of a group or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊行嘅行列越嚟越長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 hang4 ge3 hang4 lit6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遊行的隊伍越來越長。
examples.english_sentence: The parade's procession is getting longer and longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入學嗰日，學生排好行列等校車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 hok6 go2 jat6, hok6 saang1 paai4 hou2 hang4 lit6 dang2 haau6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 入學那天，學生排好隊等校車。
examples.english_sentence: On the first day of school, the students lined up to wait for the school bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家已經入咗行列，成為正式員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 jap6 zo2 hang4 lit6, sing4 wai4 zing3 sik1 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在已經加入了行列，成為正式員工。
examples.english_sentence: He has now joined the ranks and become a full-time employee.

mandarin_meaning: （對重要人物等）行刺、刺殺、暗殺
english_meaning: to assassinate; assassination (to attempt to kill a person, often a public figure)
explanation_mandarin: 指有預謀地攻擊或刺殺某人，常用於政治或報復性暴力行為。
explanation_english: Refers to a deliberate attempt to stab or kill someone, often used for political or revenge-motivated acts of violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方表示有人企圖向政要行刺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 biu2 si6 jau5 jan4 kei5 tou4 hoeng3 zing3 jiu3 hang4 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方表示有人企圖向政要行刺。
examples.english_sentence: Police said someone attempted to assassinate a political figure.

mandarin_meaning: （行动）表示采取行为、动作或开展某项活动、行动方案
english_meaning: action; movement; to take action; an operation or campaign
explanation_mandarin: 「行動」可指個人或群體採取的具體行為或動作，也可指有組織、有目的的活動或行動計劃。
explanation_english: Refers to actions or movements; can mean to take action or an organized activity/operation undertaken to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家要開始行動啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 hoi1 ci2 hang4 dung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在要开始行动了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to start taking action now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方呼籲市民保持冷靜，唔好自行行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 fu1 jyu3 si5 man4 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6, m4 hou2 zi6 hang4 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方呼吁市民保持冷静，不要自行行动。
examples.english_sentence: The police urge citizens to stay calm and not to take matters into their own hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次行動成功咗，大家辛苦晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 hang4 dung6 sing4 gung1 zo2, daai6 gaa1 san1 fu2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次行动成功了，大家辛苦了。
examples.english_sentence: This operation was successful; thank you for everyone's hard work.

mandarin_meaning: 行动不便（行动能力受限）
english_meaning: having limited mobility; difficulty moving
explanation_mandarin: 表示行動能力受限，行走、上落樓梯或長距離移動等有困難。常用以描述老人、傷殘人士或暫時因病受限的人。
explanation_english: Indicates limited ability to move—having difficulty walking, climbing stairs, or moving long distances. Commonly used to describe elderly people, disabled persons, or those temporarily impaired by illness or injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽最近行動不便，上落樓梯好困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 zeoi3 gan6 hang4 dung6 bat1 bin6, soeng5 lok6 lau4 tai1 hou2 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我媽媽最近行動不便，上下樓梯很困難。
examples.english_sentence: My mother has had difficulty moving recently; going up and down stairs is very difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為行動不便，佢申請咗輪椅使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 hang4 dung6 bat1 bin6, keoi5 san1 cing2 zo2 leon4 ji2 si6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為行動不便，他申請了輪椅使用。
examples.english_sentence: Because of mobility issues, he applied to use a wheelchair.

mandarin_meaning: 有生意、有人光顧（做生意有客源）
english_meaning: to have business / to have customers / trade turnover
explanation_mandarin: 香港廣東話俗語，指店舖或做生意的人有客源、有買賣，生意有起色或有人光顧。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning a shop or business has customers or trade; to have sales/turnover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間小店今日完全冇行口，老闆好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 siu2 dim3 gam1 jat6 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 hang4 hau2, lou5 baan2 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间小店今天完全没有生意，老板很担心。
examples.english_sentence: This little shop has no customers at all today; the owner is very worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嚟嘅攤位開頭唔多，但一陣有行口就好過癮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 lai4 ge3 taan1 wai2 hoi1 tau4 m4 do1, daan6 jat1 zan6 jau5 hang4 hau2 zau6 hou2 gwo3 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新来的摊位一开始不多，但一有生意就很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The new stall didn't attract many customers at first, but when business picked up it was great.

mandarin_meaning: 裝出流氓或狡詐、擺架子、耍手段的樣子
english_meaning: to act like a thug or behave slyly/intimidatingly; to put on airs or play tricks
explanation_mandarin: 「行古惑」是廣東話口語俚語，含貶義，指故意表現得狡猾、威嚇或耍手段，像地痞或老千一樣行事，讓人感到不安或可疑。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, '行古惑' refers to acting like a thug or behaving in a sly, menacing, or deceitful way. It's pejorative and describes putting on airs, using tricks, or intimidating others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺街度行古惑，令人覺得好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 hang4 gu2 waak6, ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在街上裝出古惑的樣子，讓人覺得很危險。
examples.english_sentence: He often acts like a thug on the street, making people feel unsafe.

mandarin_meaning: 行不行 / 可行吗
english_meaning: Will it work? Is it feasible?
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用法，詢問某事是否可行或能否實現，常用於日常對話中表達可行性或允不允許。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase used to ask whether something is feasible or will work; commonly used in everyday conversation to check practicality or acceptability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣做，行咇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng6 zou6, haang4 bat1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Will doing it this way work?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搬去嗰間屋企，行咇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun1 heoi3 go2 gaan1 uk1 kei2, haang4 bat1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我搬去那间住可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I move to that place? Will that work?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我改條稿，行咇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 goi2 tiu4 gou2, haang4 bat1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我改这稿可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me edit this draft? Will that work?

mandarin_meaning: 合不來
english_meaning: can't get along; incompatible
explanation_mandarin: 表示兩人或雙方性格、價值觀或做事方式不合，難以和諧相處或合作。
explanation_english: Indicates that two people or parties are incompatible — their personalities, values, or ways of working don't match, so they cannot get along or cooperate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個性格差太遠，行唔埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 caa1 taai3 jyun5, haang4 m4 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们性格差得太远，合不来。
examples.english_sentence: Their personalities are too different; they can't get along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司入面我哋同嗰個部門行唔埋，合作好困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ngo5 dei6 tung4 go2 go3 bou6 mun4 haang4 m4 maai4, hap6 zok3 hou2 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司里面我们和那个部门合不来，合作很困难。
examples.english_sentence: Within the company our team and that department don't get along; collaboration is very difficult.

mandarin_meaning: 行不通 / 不可行
english_meaning: won't work; not feasible; doesn't fly
explanation_mandarin: 表示某個方法、計劃或理由不可行、無辦法成立或不被接受。
explanation_english: Indicates that a method, plan, or excuse is not workable, feasible, or acceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣做行唔通㗎，你要諗其他辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng6 zou6 haang4 m4 tung1 gaa3, nei5 jiu3 lam2 kei4 taa1 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做行不通，你得想其他办法。
examples.english_sentence: This won't work; you need to think of another solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個理由行唔通，老闆唔會接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 lei5 jau4 haang4 m4 tung1, lou5 baan2 m4 wui5 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的理由行不通，老板不会接受。
examples.english_sentence: His excuse won't fly; the boss won't accept it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果只靠運氣嚟做事，長遠睇係行唔通嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zi2 haau3 wan6 hei3 lai4 zou6 si6, coeng4 jyun5 tai2 hai6 haang4 m4 tung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果只靠运气做事，长远来看行不通的。
examples.english_sentence: If you only rely on luck, it won't work in the long run.

mandarin_meaning: 行善 (xíng shàn) — 做善事、行慈善
english_meaning: to do good; to perform charitable deeds; to do good deeds
explanation_mandarin: 指做善事、幫助他人或從事慈善活動，通常帶有回饋社會或積德的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to performing good deeds or charitable acts—helping others or engaging in charity, often with the sense of giving back to society or accumulating merit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日行善，幫好多有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hang4 sin6, bong1 hou2 do1 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常行善，幫助很多需要幫助的人。
examples.english_sentence: He often does good deeds, helping many people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該多行善，回報社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 do1 hang4 sin6, wui4 bou3 se5 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們應該多行善，回報社會。
examples.english_sentence: We should do more good deeds and give back to society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行善唔求回報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 sin6 m4 kau4 wui4 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行善不求回報。
examples.english_sentence: Do good without expecting a reward.

mandarin_meaning: 行善積德（xíng shàn jī dé）——做好事、積累福報與功德
english_meaning: To do good deeds and accumulate virtue/merit; to cultivate moral merit (often with religious or folk-belief connotations).
explanation_mandarin: 指通過行善來積累德行和福報，常帶有佛教或民間因果報應的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to performing good deeds to accumulate virtue or merit; often implies belief in karmic rewards or blessings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經常行善積德，逢星期日都會去做義工幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 soeng4 hang4 sin6 zik1 dak1, fung4 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 zou6 ji6 gung1 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常行善積德，每個星期日都會去做義工幫助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: He often does good deeds; every Sunday he volunteers to help people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家話行善積德可以積福報，叫我哋多幫人一把手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 gaa1 waa6 hang4 sin6 zik1 dak1 ho2 ji5 zik1 fuk1 bou3, giu3 ngo5 dei6 do1 bong1 jan4 jat1 baa2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人家說行善積德可以積福報，叫我們多幫助別人一把。
examples.english_sentence: The elders say that doing good deeds and accumulating virtue can bring blessings, and tell us to help others more.

mandarin_meaning: 走吧；好了／行了（口語）
english_meaning: Let's go; go on; (colloquially) alright/that's enough
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語 / 口語表達
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語表達，常用來催促開始行動或離開，意為「走吧／我們走吧」；在某些語境也可表示同意或讓步，帶有「好吧／行了、別再說了」的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to urge someone to start moving or leave ('let's go' / 'go on'). In some contexts it can also mean 'alright' or 'that's enough' to indicate agreement or to stop further discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家行喇，巴士快到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 haang4 laa3, baa1 si2 faai3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在走吧，公交车快到了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go now, the bus is almost here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做晒嘢可以行喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 saai3 je5 ho2 ji5 haang4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做完可以走了。
examples.english_sentence: You can leave when you've finished your work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行喇，唔使再解釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 laa3, m4 sai2 zoi3 gaai2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行了，不必再解释。
examples.english_sentence: Alright, no need to explain further.

mandarin_meaning: 来回走、走来走去
english_meaning: to walk back and forth; to pace; to walk around aimlessly
explanation_mandarin: 表示在同一地點來回走動，常用來形容無所事事、緊張或不安時不停走動。
explanation_english: Indicates walking back and forth in the same area; often used to describe pacing due to nervousness, restlessness, or simply idly wandering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企行嚟行去，好似有啲心事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei5 haang4 lei4 haang4 heoi3, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 sam1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里来来回回地走，似乎有心事。
examples.english_sentence: He is pacing back and forth at home, as if something is on his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日喺度行嚟行去，學習要專心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 haang4 lei4 haang4 heoi3, hok6 zaap6 jiu3 zyun1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是在那里走来走去，学习要专心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep pacing around there; you need to concentrate on studying.

mandarin_meaning: 到處走/到不同地方活動
english_meaning: to go around; to go to different places; to hang out
explanation_mandarin: 「行地方」是廣東話的口語用法，通常指到處走動、到不同的地方逛或社交活動（即外出玩、出街）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to go around or visit different places — i.e., to hang out, go out, or move about socially or for leisure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日行地方，周圍去唱K、飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hang4 dei6 fong1, zau1 wai4 heoi3 coeng3 K, jam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常到處玩，四處去唱K、喝東西。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes out to different places, going around singing karaoke and drinking.

mandarin_meaning: 走過來 / 走過去 / 靠近 / 一起過來湊一份
english_meaning: to walk up/over (to); to come closer; to join in
explanation_mandarin: 「行埋」是粵語口語用法，表示向某處走近或走過去，也可表示加入某個行列或一起過來（常與來/去等方向詞連用，如「行埋嚟」「行埋去」）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to walk closer/over (to), to approach, or to join in. Often used with directional complements like "嚟" (come) or "去" (go).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你行埋嚟啦，我哋傾下計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hang4 maai4 lai4 laa1, ngo5 dei6 king1 haa5 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你走過來吧，我們聊一聊。
examples.english_sentence: Come over, let's have a chat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行埋去幫手搬嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang4 maai4 heoi3 bong1 sau2 bun1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走過去幫忙搬東西。
examples.english_sentence: He walked over to help move things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家行埋一齊影張相啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 hang4 maai4 jat1 cai4 jing2 zoeng1 soeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家走過來一起拍張照吧。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone come together for a photo.

mandarin_meaning: 走大运 / 走好运（表示運氣好）
english_meaning: to have a stroke of good luck; to be very lucky
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人近期或在某件事中碰到特別好的運氣，常用作祝福或形容幸運的狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone experiences particularly good luck; commonly used as a blessing or to describe being fortunate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，恭喜發財，祝你行大運！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, gung1 hei2 fat3 coi4, zuk1 nei5 hang4 daai6 wan6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快樂，恭喜發財，祝你走大運！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year, wishing you prosperity and good luck!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近做乜嘢都順利，真係行大運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zou6 mat1 je5 dou1 seon6 lei6, zan1 hai6 hang4 daai6 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近做什麼都很順利，真是走大運。
examples.english_sentence: Everything's been going smoothly for him lately—he's really been lucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去賭場，佢贏咗好多，行大運喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 dou2 coeng4, keoi5 jing4 zo2 hou2 do1, hang4 daai6 wan6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去賭場，他贏了很多，真是走大運啊。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the casino tonight and won a lot—he's really on a lucky streak.

mandarin_meaning: 走天桥／走人行天桥
english_meaning: to walk on (or use) a pedestrian footbridge
explanation_mandarin: 指行走人行天橋，通常用於過馬路或為了避免車流與危險。
explanation_english: To walk on or use a pedestrian overpass/footbridge, typically to cross a road or avoid traffic and danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過馬路嗰陣最好行天橋，咁樣會安全啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 maa5 lou6 go2 zan6 zeoi3 hou2 haang4 tin1 kiu4, gam2 joeng6 wui5 on1 cyun4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过马路的时候最好走天桥，这样会安全一点。
examples.english_sentence: When crossing the road, it's best to use the footbridge; that way it's a bit safer.

mandarin_meaning: 行宫 (xínggōng)：古代皇帝出巡時的臨時宮殿或行在之處。
english_meaning: A temporary/mobile imperial palace; the residence an emperor used while on tour.
explanation_mandarin: 指古代皇帝出巡或行在時暫時居住的宮殿，常用於歷史或文學語境，亦可指與此相關的遺址或建築。
explanation_english: Refers to a temporary palace where an emperor stayed while on tour or traveling; used in historical and literary contexts, and can also refer to the remains or buildings of such a site.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 皇帝出巡時會住喺行宮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong4 dai3 ceot1 seon4 si4 wui5 zyu6 hai2 haang4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 皇帝出巡时会住在行宫。
examples.english_sentence: The emperor stays in a temporary palace while on tour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座古城有一座保存得好嘅行宮遺址。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 gu2 sing4 jau5 jat1 zo6 bou2 cyun4 dak1 hou2 ge3 haang4 gung1 wai4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座古城有一座保存完好的行宫遗址。
examples.english_sentence: This ancient town has a well-preserved site of a former temporary imperial palace.

mandarin_meaning: 行家 / 專家
english_meaning: expert; professional; specialist
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一行業或領域具有專業知識或豐富經驗的人，也可指內行或行內人士。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with professional knowledge or extensive experience in a particular trade or field; an expert or someone 'in the know'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係行家，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hang4 gaa1, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是行家，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: He's an expert; don't worry.

mandarin_meaning: 行将就木（即将死亡；年老体衰）
english_meaning: on the verge of death; near the end of life; decrepit
explanation_mandarin: 表示快要死亡，常用來形容年老體衰或垂死的人事物。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is close to death; often used to describe someone very old, frail, or dying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經行將就木，家人都喺床邊陪住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 hang4 zoeng1 zau6 muk6, gaa1 jan4 dou1 hai2 cong4 bin1 pui4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經行將就木，家人都在床邊陪伴著。
examples.english_sentence: He is near death; his family is all by his bedside.

mandarin_meaning: 擺架子；裝腔作勢；擺出一副高人一等或自以為了不起的樣子。
english_meaning: to act high and mighty; to put on airs; to behave arrogantly or pretentiously.
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容某人擺出高人一等或有權勢的姿態，態度傲慢、愛擺架子。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term describing someone who puts on an air of superiority or acts like a big shot — behaving arrogantly or pretentiously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度行尊，大家係朋友咋嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 haang4 zyun1, daai6 gaa1 hai6 pang4 jau5 zaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在這裡擺架子，大家是朋友嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act high and mighty here — we're all friends.

mandarin_meaning: 行尸走肉（比喻喪失生氣、沒有精神、形同空殼的人）
english_meaning: a walking corpse; someone who is alive but without vitality or purpose (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 原本字面指像屍體一樣行走，現常用來比喻一個人雖然活著但喪失生氣、沒有精神或沒有目標，形同空殼。
explanation_english: Literally 'walking corpse.' Used figuratively to describe a person who is alive but lacks energy, enthusiasm, or purpose — essentially a shell of themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢返工好似行屍走肉咁，冇精神又冇熱情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 faan1 gung1 hou2 ci5 haang4 si1 zau2 juk6 gam2, mou5 zing1 san4 jau6 mou5 jit6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他上班像行尸走肉一樣，沒精神也沒熱情。
examples.english_sentence: Lately he goes to work like a walking corpse — no energy and no enthusiasm.

mandarin_meaning: 爬山、徒步郊遊
english_meaning: to go hiking; hiking (walking in the hills/mountains)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中指到郊外或山上徒步、爬山或郊遊，常用來表示休閒活動。
explanation_english: A Cantonese expression meaning to hike or go trekking in the hills/mountains, commonly used to describe a recreational outdoor activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日我哋去行山，順便影吓相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 haang4 saan1, seon6 bin6 jing2 haa5 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期日我們去爬山，順便拍一下照片。
examples.english_sentence: We're going hiking on Sunday and will take some photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天係最好行山嘅季節，山上花開得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 hai6 zeoi3 hou2 haang4 saan1 ge3 gwai3 zit3, saan1 soeng6 faa1 hoi1 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天是最適合爬山的季節，山上花開得很美。
examples.english_sentence: Spring is the best season for hiking; the flowers on the mountain are very beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 登山者；健行者；愛好徒步上山、郊遊的人
english_meaning: hiker; hillwalker; someone who goes hiking
explanation_mandarin: 指喜歡在山間徒步、爬山或郊外健行的人，通常作為休閒活動參與。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who hikes or hillwalks — someone who goes into the hills or mountains for walking/trekking as a leisure activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去大帽山行山，你想唔想一齊嚟做行山客？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 daai6 mou6 saan1 haang4 saan1, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jat1 cai4 lai4 zou6 haang4 saan1 haak3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們明天去大帽山爬山，你想不想一起來當個行山客？
examples.english_sentence: We're going hiking at Tai Mo Shan tomorrow. Do you want to join as a hiker?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山客要注意裝備同埋天氣變化，唔好單獨冒險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 haak3 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 zong1 bei6 tung4 maai4 tin1 hei3 bin3 faa3, m4 hou2 daan1 duk6 mou6 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行山者要注意裝備和天氣變化，不要單獨冒險。
examples.english_sentence: Hikers should pay attention to their equipment and weather changes, and avoid going on risky solo trips.

mandarin_meaning: 登山小徑 / 步道
english_meaning: hiking trail; mountain path
explanation_mandarin: 指供人徒步、登山使用的山間小徑或步道，常用於郊外遠足或健行活動。
explanation_english: A path or trail used for hiking or walking in the hills/mountains, commonly used for outdoor hiking or trekking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日去行山，想試條新嘅行山徑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 haang4 saan1, soeng2 si3 tiu4 san1 ge3 haang4 saan1 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期日去爬山，想試一條新的登山小徑。
examples.english_sentence: We're going hiking on Sunday and want to try a new hiking trail.

mandarin_meaning: 登山杖 / 徒步登山用的手杖
english_meaning: hiking pole; trekking pole; walking stick used for hiking
explanation_mandarin: 用于徒步或登山时帮助支撑和平衡、减轻膝盖与腿部压力的杖，通常可伸缩或带防滑杖头。
explanation_english: A pole used for hiking or trekking to provide support and balance, reduce pressure on the knees and legs; often telescopic and fitted with anti-slip tips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次行山我記得帶埋行山杖，落山嘅時候膝頭冇咁痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haang4 saan1 ngo5 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 haang4 saan1 zoeng6, lok6 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6 sat1 tau4 mou5 gam2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次爬山我记得带了登山杖，下山的时候膝盖就不那么痛了。
examples.english_sentence: I remembered to bring my hiking pole on this hike; my knees hurt less when going downhill.

mandarin_meaning: 爬山機 / 踏步機（健身器材）
english_meaning: stair climber / stepper (gym exercise machine that simulates hiking or climbing stairs)
explanation_mandarin: 「行山機」是香港粵語俗稱，指健身房內模擬爬坡或踏階運動的有氧器材，常用來鍛鍊心肺和下肢肌肉。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '行山機' is a colloquial term for a gym machine (stair climber/stepper) that simulates uphill hiking or climbing stairs, used for cardio and lower-body training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣唔好，行唔到山，唯有去健身室做行山機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2, hang4 m4 dou2 saan1, wai4 jau5 heoi3 gin6 san1 sat1 zou6 hang4 saan1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天氣不好，不能去爬山，只好去健身房做爬山機。
examples.english_sentence: The weather's been bad lately so I can't go hiking; I have to go to the gym and use the stair climber.

mandarin_meaning: 登山杖 / 徒步用的手杖
english_meaning: hiking pole; trekking pole; walking stick used for hiking
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指在行山、徒步時用來支撐或穩定步伐的手杖或登山杖。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a stick or pole used during hiking to provide support and improve stability while walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去行山記得帶埋行山竹，行路會穩陣啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 hang4 saan1 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 hang4 saan1 zuk1, hang4 lou6 wui5 wan2 zan6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去爬山記得帶上登山杖，走路會比較穩當一些。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring a hiking pole when you go hiking; walking will be more stable.

mandarin_meaning: 走錯路；犯了錯；誤入歧途（成語，表示做了錯事或走上不正確的道路）
english_meaning: to make a mistake; to go astray; to take a wrong step (idiom indicating having done something wrong or having gone down the wrong path)
explanation_mandarin: 「行差踏錯」是粵語（亦見於中文成語）用語，指走錯路、犯錯或做了不應該做的事，常用來形容行為偏離正道或招致嚴重後果。
explanation_english: “行差踏錯” is a Cantonese idiom (also seen as a Chinese idiom) meaning to make a mistake, take a wrong turn, or go astray—often implying one’s actions have departed from the right path and may lead to serious consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係行差踏錯，做咗啲唔啱嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hang4 caa1 daap3 co3, zou6 zo2 di1 m4 aap3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他確實行差踏錯，做了不該做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He really made a mistake and did something wrong.

mandarin_meaning: （去世時）享年／去世時的年齡
english_meaning: to have died at the age of ... / aged (at death)
explanation_mandarin: 「行年」常用於報道或訃聞，表示某人去世時所達到的年齡，相當於書面語的「享年」。
explanation_english: Used mainly in reports or obituaries to indicate the age a person was at death; equivalent to the written term "享年" in Mandarin or "aged" in English obituaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上個禮拜過身，行年七十六歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 go3 lai5 baai3 gwo3 san1, hang4 nin4 cat1 sap6 luk6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上個禮拜去世，享年七十六歲。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away last week, aged 76.

mandarin_meaning: 行径（指人的行为、举止，常含贬义）
english_meaning: behavior; conduct; manner of acting (often with negative connotation)
explanation_mandarin: 指人的言行或舉止，常用來評價某些可議或令人不滿的作為或行為。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's actions or conduct; commonly used to criticize objectionable or blameworthy behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲行徑真係令人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 haang4 ging3 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行径真令人反感。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is really off-putting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方正調查可疑人士嘅行徑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zing3 diu6 caa4 ho2 ji4 jan4 si6 ge3 haang4 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方正在調查可疑人士的行徑。
examples.english_sentence: The police are investigating the suspect's conduct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲行徑證明佢唔值得信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 haang4 ging3 zing3 ming4 keoi5 m4 zik6 dak1 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些行徑證明他不值得信任。
examples.english_sentence: These actions prove he is not trustworthy.

jyutping: haang4 dak1 maa4 mou5 bei6 go1
mandarin_meaning: 装腔作势但没有真本事
english_meaning: All show and no substance; talks big but has no real ability
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，用來形容一個人表現得很有氣勢或愛誇口，但實際上沒有真本事或做不到所說的事情。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquialism describing someone who puts on a show or boasts but lacks real ability or follow-through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講到自己好叻，其實行得嚤冇鼻哥，做唔到啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, kei4 sat6 haang4 dak1 maa4 mou5 bei6 go1, zou6 m4 dou3 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是夸自己很厉害，其实装腔作势，做不到那些事。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks himself up, but he's all show and no substance—he can't actually do those things.

mandarin_meaning: 能夠相處 / 可行、可接受
english_meaning: to be able to get along (with someone); to be feasible or acceptable
explanation_mandarin: 「行得埋」是粵語口語用法，表示能否與某人相處得來，或某件事是否可行/能接受。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression indicating whether one can get along with someone or whether something is feasible/acceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同新同事行得埋唔？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 san1 tung4 si6 haang4 dak1 maai4 m4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能和新同事相處嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you get along with the new colleague?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果大家唔合得來，就未必行得埋做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 daai6 gaa1 m4 hap6 dak1 loi4, zau6 mei6 bat1 haang4 dak1 maai4 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果大家合不來，未必能繼續做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: If people aren't compatible, they may not be able to continue being friends.

jyutping: haang4 dak1 faai3 hou2 sai3 gaai3
mandarin_meaning: 走得快就好 / 走得快比較好（口語、帶諷刺或催促意味）
english_meaning: Literally 'walk fast, good world' — a colloquial Cantonese phrase used to urge someone to hurry or sarcastically to say someone's leaving makes things better ('good riddance').
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句粵語口語/俚語，字面意思是「走得快，世界（會更好）」。通常用來催促別人快點、趕快離開，或帶有諷刺意味地表示某人離開反而讓情況更好（相當於「走得快好過」或「走得快比較好」）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning 'walk fast, good world.' It is used to urge someone to hurry up or, sarcastically, to imply that someone's departure makes things better (similar to 'good riddance' or 'the sooner you go, the better').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲做完，行得快好世界，我哋可以早啲返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4, haang4 dak1 faai3 hou2 sai3 gaai3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zou2 di1 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点做完，走得快比較好，我們可以早点回家。
examples.english_sentence: Finish quickly — the sooner the better; we can go home earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一走，大家都話行得快好世界，大家鬆一口氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zau2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 haang4 dak1 faai3 hou2 sai3 gaai3, daai6 gaa1 sung1 jat1 hau2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一走，大家都說「走得快比較好」，大家鬆了一口氣。
examples.english_sentence: When he left, people said 'good riddance,' and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

jyutping: hang4 dak1 faai3, hou2 sai3 gaai3
mandarin_meaning: 走得快，世界會更好 / 先行者或行動迅速的人往往能獲得好處
english_meaning: If you move/act quickly, you'll be in a better position; those who act first or faster often reap benefits
explanation_mandarin: 一句粤語俗語，強調行動迅速或先行者通常能獲得好處；有時也可作玩笑或略帶諷刺的用法。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb saying that those who move or act quickly (or go first) tend to gain advantages; it can be used earnestly or humorously/ironically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗太耐，行得快，好世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 taai3 noi6, hang4 dak1 faai3, hou2 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想太久，走得快，世界會更好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think for too long—act quickly and things will turn out better.

jyutping: haang4 dak1 zing3 kei5 dak1 zing3
mandarin_meaning: 堂堂正正 / 光明磊落
english_meaning: to act uprightly and honestly; to have nothing to hide
explanation_mandarin: 表示行為正直、光明磊落，沒有可指摘或可恥之處。
explanation_english: Describes someone who behaves with integrity and uprightness, acting honestly and aboveboard with nothing to hide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋做人要行得正企得正，唔好做啲見不得光嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou6 jan4 jiu3 haang4 dak1 zing3 kei5 dak1 zing3, m4 hou2 zou6 di1 gin3 bat1 dak1 gwong1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们做人要堂堂正正，别做见不得人的事。
examples.english_sentence: We should conduct ourselves with integrity; don't do things you'd be ashamed of.

cantonese: 行得正，企得正，唔怕雷公在頭頂
jyutping: hang4 dak1 zeng3, kei5 dak1 zeng3, m4 paa3 leoi4 gung1 zoi6 tau4 deng2
mandarin_meaning: 光明正大、行事端正就不怕遭受責難或災禍
english_meaning: If you act uprightly and honestly, you have nothing to fear from accusations or misfortune.
explanation_mandarin: 這句粵語俗語表示：只要行為端正、光明磊落，就不需要害怕別人的指責或不幸的事情發生。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb meaning that if one's conduct is upright and above reproach, one need not fear blame, accusations, or bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做嘢一向講求正直，行得正，企得正，唔怕雷公在頭頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 je5 jat1 hoeng3 gong2 gau3 zeng3 zik6, hang4 dak1 zeng3, kei5 dak1 zeng3, m4 paa3 leoi4 gung1 zoi6 tau4 deng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做事一向讲求正直，光明磊落，就不怕别人的指责。
examples.english_sentence: I always act with integrity; if you're upright and honest, you don't need to fear others' accusations.

mandarin_meaning: 能走能動 / 能行走
english_meaning: able to walk and move about; mobile; ambulatory
explanation_mandarin: 表示能夠行走與活動，通常用來描述一個人的行動能力或術後、病後恢復情況，屬於粵語口語表達。
explanation_english: Indicates the ability to walk and move around; commonly used to describe someone's mobility or recovery after illness/surgery. It is a Cantonese colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家行得走得，唔使人幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 haang4 dak1 zau2 dak1, m4 sai2 jan4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在能自己走動，不需要別人幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He can walk/move around now and doesn't need help.

mandarin_meaning: 可行
english_meaning: feasible; workable; it will work
explanation_mandarin: 表示某个方法、做法或想法是可行的、能够实现或可以接受。
explanation_english: Indicates that a method, idea, or plan is feasible or will work; something is workable or viable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法唔一定行得通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 jat1 ding6 haang4 dak1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法不一定行得通。
examples.english_sentence: This method may not necessarily be feasible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果淨係咁做，可能行唔通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing6 hai6 gam2 zou6, ho2 nang4 haang4 m4 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果只是这样做，可能行不通。
examples.english_sentence: If we only do it this way, it might not work.

mandarin_meaning: 並非常見的粵語獨立詞彙；字面由「行」（走/做）和「必」（一定）組成，可能是打錯字、縮寫或片語截斷，意義不固定。
english_meaning: Not a commonly used Cantonese standalone word; literally 'walk/move' (行) + 'must/certain' (必). Likely a typo, abbreviation, or truncated phrase — not standard in Cantonese.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 非獨立詞 / 罕用短語
partOfSpeech_english: not a standalone word / rare phrase
explanation_mandarin: 「行必」本身在口語或書面粵語裡並非慣用詞。通常出現時可能是打字錯誤、從長句截取或作佔位用，若按字面理解則可表示「行動必然/一定要走（做）」，但這類用法並不通行。
explanation_english: As a sequence of characters, '行必' is not a standard Cantonese lexical item. It often appears as a typo, abbreviation, or truncated fragment. Literally it could mean 'action/movement' + 'must', but such usage is not conventional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「行必」唔係一個慣用詞，多數係打錯字或佔位用法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 「haang4 bit1」 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 gwaan3 jung6 ci4, do1 sou3 hai6 daa2 co3 zi6 waak6 zim6 wai6 jung6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「行必」不是一個慣用詞，多數是打錯字或佔位用法。
examples.english_sentence: '行必' is not a commonly used term; it's often a typo or a placeholder.

mandarin_meaning: 行情（hángqíng）：市場的價格、走勢或相關資訊
english_meaning: market conditions; market trend; the going rate or prevailing price
explanation_mandarin: 指某一商品或市場的價格走勢與供需狀況，也可泛指某件事的市場需求或現行價格，常用於金融、商品、行業等語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the prices, trends, and supply-demand situation in a market; can also mean the prevailing rate for a service or item. Commonly used in finance, commodities, and market contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家股票嘅行情唔太好，唔係買入嘅好時機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gu2 piu3 ge3 hang4 cing4 m4 taai3 hou2, m4 hai6 maai5 jap6 ge3 hou2 si4 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在股票的行情不太好，不是買入的好時機。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market's condition isn't great right now; it's not a good time to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近牛肉嘅行情好高，煮嘢嘅成本都上咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngau4 juk6 ge3 hang4 cing4 hou2 gou1, zyu2 je5 ge3 sing4 bun2 dou1 soeng5 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近牛肉的行情很高，烹飪成本也上升了。
examples.english_sentence: Beef prices have risen recently, so cooking costs have gone up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問下裝修嘅行情係點？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 haa5 zong1 sau1 ge3 hang4 cing4 hai6 dim2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你問一下裝修的行情是怎麼樣？
examples.english_sentence: Ask about the going rates for renovations.

mandarin_meaning: 没有行情／没有市场需求
english_meaning: no market; demand has dried up; no trading activity
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容某商品、股票或生意完全没有买气或交易，市场冷清、没有需求。
explanation_english: Used to describe goods, stocks, or businesses that have no buying interest or trading activity — the market is dead or demand has dried up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲貨真係冇人買，完全係行情光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 fo3 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 maai5, jyun4 cyun4 hai6 hang4 cing4 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这些货真的没人买，完全没有行情。
examples.english_sentence: Right now these goods really aren't selling — there's absolutely no market for them.

mandarin_meaning: 进行性行为/发生性关系（委婉或俚语）
english_meaning: to have sexual intercourse (euphemistic/colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「行房」是粤语中常用的委婉或口语说法，指进行性行为或发生性关系。有时也在普通话语境中使用，但带有俚语或委婉意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/euphemistic term meaning to have sexual intercourse. It can be used as a slang or polite expression and occasionally appears in Mandarin contexts with similar euphemistic sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啱啱結婚，今晚可能會行房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 aam1 aam1 git3 fan1, gam1 maan5 ho2 nang4 wui5 haang4 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们刚结婚，今晚可能会发生性关系。
examples.english_sentence: They just got married; they might have sex tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要等傷口好返先至可以行房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 dang2 soeng1 hau2 hou2 faan1 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 haang4 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要等伤口好一些之后才能进行性行为。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said to wait until the wound heals a bit before having sex.

mandarin_meaning: 行政（xíngzhèng），指政府或組織中負責管理、執行政策與處理日常事務的職能或部門。
english_meaning: administrative; administration — relating to management, implementation of policies, and routine organizational affairs.
explanation_mandarin: 指組織或政府中負責管理、執行政策與處理日常事務的職能或相關事務；作形容詞時表示與管理或行政工作有關。
explanation_english: Refers to the administrative functions or affairs within an organization or government — managing, carrying out policies, and handling routine tasks. As an adjective, it describes things related to administration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺政府做行政工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zing3 fu2 zou6 hang4 zing3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在政府做行政工作。
examples.english_sentence: He does administrative work in the government.

mandarin_meaning: 行政区划
english_meaning: administrative divisions; administrative districting
explanation_mandarin: 指國家或地方政府為便於管理和治理而劃分的各級行政區域及其邊界，如省、市、縣、鄉鎮等。
explanation_english: The divisions and boundaries established by a government for administrative purposes, such as provinces, cities, counties, and townships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃調整行政區劃，將部分地區劃入新區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 diu6 zing2 hang4 zing3 keoi1 waak6, zoeng1 bou6 fan6 dei6 keoi1 waak6 jap6 san1 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府計劃調整行政區劃，將部分地區劃入新區。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to adjust administrative divisions, incorporating some areas into a new district.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 了解一個地區嘅行政區劃對研究人口分布好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: liu5 gaai2 jat1 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 hang4 zing3 keoi1 waak6 deoi3 jin4 gau3 jan4 hau2 fan1 bou3 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 了解一個地區的行政區划對研究人口分布很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Understanding a region's administrative divisions is important for studying population distribution.

mandarin_meaning: 行政局（政府的行政部門或局級機構）
english_meaning: administrative bureau; government administrative department/agency
explanation_mandarin: 指政府內負責行政事務的部門或局級機構，用於描述執行行政職能的組織。
explanation_english: Refers to a government bureau or department responsible for administrative affairs — an organizational unit that executes administrative functions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府打算成立一個新的行政局，專責處理社區發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 daa2 syun3 sing4 laap6 jat1 go3 san1 dik1 hang4 zing3 guk6, zyun1 zak6 cyu2 lei5 se5 keoi1 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府打算成立一個新的行政局，專責處理社區發展。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to establish a new administrative bureau to take charge of community development.

mandarin_meaning: 行政拘留 (xíngzhèng jūliú)
english_meaning: administrative detention / administrative custody
explanation_mandarin: 一种行政处罚措施，由公安或行政机关对违反治安管理或其他行政法规的个人实施的短期剥夺人身自由的强制性处罚，通常期限较短（一般不超过15天），属于行政而非法院的刑事处罚。
explanation_english: An administrative punishment in which police or administrative authorities temporarily deprive a person of their liberty for minor violations of public order or administrative regulations. It is a short-term, non-criminal sanction (commonly up to 15 days) imposed by administrative organs rather than by criminal court proceedings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為鬧事俾警方行政拘留咗十四日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 naau6 si6 bei2 ging2 fong1 hang4 zing3 keoi1 lau4 zo2 sap6 sei3 jat6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為鬧事被警方行政拘留了十四天。
examples.english_sentence: He was administratively detained by the police for 14 days for causing a disturbance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你喺公共地方破壞秩序，可能會被行政拘留。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai2 gung1 gung6 dei6 fong1 po3 waai6 zat1 ceoi3，ho2 nang4 wui5 bei2 hang4 zing3 keoi1 lau4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你在公共场所破坏秩序，可能会被行政拘留。
examples.english_sentence: If you disrupt public order in a public place, you may be subject to administrative detention.

mandarin_meaning: （通常為「行政會議」的簡稱）行政會議，香港特別行政區政府的諮詢機構之一，協助行政長官決策
english_meaning: Executive Council (short for 'Executive Council meeting' in Hong Kong) — the advisory body that assists the Chief Executive in decision-making
explanation_mandarin: 「行政會」多為「行政會議」的口語或簡稱，特指香港特別行政區政府的行政會議或其會議，主要由行政長官召集，提供政策諮詢和決策建議。
explanation_english: ‘行政會’ is commonly an abbreviation of '行政會議' (Executive Council) in Hong Kong. It refers to the council or its meetings, an advisory body convened by the Chief Executive to provide policy advice and assist in decision-making.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府今日開咗行政會，討論新嘅防疫措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gam1 jat6 hoi1 zo2 hang4 zing3 wui6, tou2 leon6 san1 ge3 fong4 jik6 co3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府今天開了行政會，討論新的防疫措施。
examples.english_sentence: The government held an Executive Council meeting today to discuss new epidemic prevention measures.

mandarin_meaning: 行政會議（普通含義：政府內部討論行政事務的會議；在香港特指行政會議，即行政長官的諮詢機構）
english_meaning: Executive Council; administrative meeting — generally a government meeting for administrative matters; in Hong Kong specifically the Executive Council advising the Chief Executive.
explanation_mandarin: 指政府用以討論與決策行政事務的會議。就香港語境而言，『行政會議』特指行政長官的諮詢機構（Executive Council），負責就重要政策向行政長官提供意見及建議。
explanation_english: Refers to a government meeting for discussing and deciding administrative matters. In the Hong Kong context, '行政會議' specifically denotes the Executive Council (ExCo), the advisory body that provides opinions and recommendations to the Chief Executive on major policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府今日召開行政會議，會上討論新一輪防疫措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gam1 jat6 ziu6 hoi1 hang4 zing3 wui6 ji5, wui6 soeng6 tou2 leon6 san1 jat1 leon4 fong4 jik6 co3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府今天召开行政会议，会上讨论新一轮防疫措施。
examples.english_sentence: The government held an Executive Council meeting today to discuss a new round of epidemic-prevention measures.

mandarin_meaning: 行政机构的组织结构；政府或机构内部各部门与层级的安排（xíngzhèng jiàgòu）
english_meaning: administrative structure; the organizational arrangement of departments, roles, and hierarchy within a government or organization
explanation_mandarin: 指政府、公司或其他組織內部用以劃分職能、職責與層級的結構安排，通常包括部門設置、匯報關係與職務分工。
explanation_english: Refers to the organizational arrangement within a government, company, or other institution that defines departments, responsibilities, hierarchical relationships, and role distribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅行政架構最近改咗，要重新分配職責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 hang4 zing3 gaa3 kau3 zeoi3 gan6 goi2 zo2, jiu3 cung4 san1 fan1 pei4 zik1 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的行政架構最近改了，要重新分配職責。
examples.english_sentence: The company's administrative structure was recently changed; responsibilities need to be reassigned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新部門喺行政架構入面有好明確嘅職位同責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 bou6 mun4 hai2 hang4 zing3 gaa3 kau3 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 ming4 kok3 ge3 zik1 wai6 tung4 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新部门在行政架构中有很明确的职位和责任。
examples.english_sentence: The new department has clearly defined positions and responsibilities within the administrative structure.

mandarin_meaning: 行政总裁；公司或組織中負責行政與營運管理的高階主管，類似於首席執行官（CEO）或首席行政官（CAO）
english_meaning: Chief Executive (Officer); a senior executive in charge of administration and overall operations (similar to CEO/CAO)
explanation_mandarin: 公司或組織的高級管理職位，主要負責行政管理、日常營運以及參與重要策略決策。有時與「首席執行官」或「首席行政官」職責重疊。
explanation_english: A high-level managerial title in a company or organization responsible for administration, daily operations, and participating in major strategic decisions. Duties can overlap with CEO or CAO roles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司新任行政總裁下個月會上任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 san1 jam6 hang4 zing3 zung2 coi4 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 soeng5 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的新任行政总裁下个月会上任。
examples.english_sentence: The company's newly appointed CEO will take office next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行政總裁主要負責公司嘅日常行政同策略決策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 zing3 zung2 coi4 zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 gung1 si1 ge3 jat6 soeng4 hang4 zing3 tung4 caak3 loek6 kyut3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行政總裁主要負責公司的日常行政和策略決策。
examples.english_sentence: The chief executive is mainly responsible for the company's daily administration and strategic decisions.

mandarin_meaning: 行政长官 (行政首长；政府的最高行政领导人，如香港特区行政长官)
english_meaning: Chief Executive; the highest administrative head of a government or organization (e.g., Hong Kong's Chief Executive)
explanation_mandarin: 指地方或機構的最高行政領導職位。在香港，「行政長官」是香港特別行政區的首長，負責領導政府的行政工作，代表政府對外發言並執行相關政策。
explanation_english: Refers to the top administrative leader of a place or organization. In Hong Kong, the Chief Executive is the head of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, responsible for leading the government, representing it externally, and implementing policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅行政長官由選舉程序產生，負責領導政府。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hang4 zing3 coeng4 gwan1 jau4 syun2 geoi2 caan2 saang1, fu6 zaak3 ling5 dou6 zing3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的行政长官通过选举程序产生，负责领导政府。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's Chief Executive is produced through an election process and is responsible for leading the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行政長官今日發表咗一份聲明，回應市民關注嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 zing3 coeng4 gwan1 gam1 jat6 faat3 biu2 zo2 jat1 fan6 sing1 ming4, wui4 jing3 si5 man4 gwaan1 zyu3 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行政长官今天发表了一份声明，回应市民的关切。
examples.english_sentence: The Chief Executive issued a statement today responding to the public's concerns.

mandarin_meaning: 行文：撰寫、起草或發布公文、書面通知；也指文件的用詞與表述方式。
english_meaning: to draft/compose or issue a written document or notice; the wording and style used in a document.
explanation_mandarin: 常用於公務或正式文書，指撰寫或發出書面文件的行為，或指文件中採用的措辭與表述方式。
explanation_english: Commonly used in official or formal contexts to mean drafting or issuing a written document, or to refer to the wording and manner of expression used in a document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份通知嘅行文需要修改，措辭太生硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 tung1 zi1 ge3 hang4 man4 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 goi2, co3 ci4 taai3 saang1 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份通知的行文需要修改，措辭太生硬。
examples.english_sentence: The wording of this notice needs to be revised; the phrasing is too stiff.

mandarin_meaning: 行星 (xíngxīng)
english_meaning: planet
explanation_mandarin: 指围绕恒星运行、具有一定质量且足以形成近似球形并清除其轨道周围其他物体的天体。
explanation_english: A celestial body that orbits a star, has enough mass for a nearly round shape, and has cleared its orbital neighborhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽系有八個行星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 hai6 jau5 baat3 go3 hang4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳系有八个行星。
examples.english_sentence: There are eight planets in the solar system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家喺望遠鏡度發現咗一個新行星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 hai2 mong6 jyun5 geng3 dou6 faat3 gin3 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 hang4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家在望远镜中发现了一个新行星。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists discovered a new planet using the telescope.

mandarin_meaning: 行书 (xíngshū)
english_meaning: running script / semi-cursive script (Chinese calligraphy)
explanation_mandarin: 中文書法的一種書體，介於楷書與草書之間，筆畫較為連貫流暢，但仍保持較高的可辨識性。
explanation_english: A style of Chinese calligraphy (running or semi-cursive script) between regular script and cursive; strokes are connected and flowing while remaining fairly legible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅字係用行書寫嘅，筆勢好流暢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 zi6 hai6 jung6 hang4 syu1 se2 ge3, bat1 sai3 hou2 lau4 coeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅字是用行书写的，笔势很流畅。
examples.english_sentence: This piece was written in running script; the brushwork is very fluent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意學行書，想提高字體嘅自然感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hok6 hang4 syu1, soeng2 tai4 gou1 zi6 tai2 ge3 zi6 jin4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢学习行书，想提高字形的自然感。
examples.english_sentence: I like studying running script and want to improve the natural flow of my characters.

mandarin_meaning: 行会（指同一行业或手工艺人组成的组织，尤指中世纪或传统的行业协会）
english_meaning: guild; trade association (an organization of people in the same trade or craft, especially historically)
explanation_mandarin: 指由同一職業或行業的人組成的組織，通常管理行業規範、培訓徒弟及維護成員利益，常見於中世紀或傳統社會。
explanation_english: An organization of people in the same trade or craft that often regulated standards, trained apprentices, and protected members' interests; commonly refers to medieval or traditional guilds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中世紀嘅歐洲有好多手工匠人嘅行會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 sai3 gei2 ge3 au1 zau1 jau5 hou2 do1 sau2 gung1 zoeng6 jan4 ge3 hong4 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中世纪的欧洲有许多手工业者的行会。
examples.english_sentence: In medieval Europe there were many guilds of artisans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間行會規定會員要繳年費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hong4 wui6 kwai1 ding6 wui6 jyun4 jiu3 gaau2 nin4 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间行会规定会员要缴年费。
examples.english_sentence: This guild requires members to pay an annual fee.

mandarin_meaning: 有餘力（如果有額外的精力或能力，便可以做更多的事或幫忙）
english_meaning: to have spare energy/capacity (to do additional tasks or help others)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在完成本分或主要事情之後，若還有多餘的精力或能力，就可以用來做額外的事或幫助別人。
explanation_english: Expresses that after finishing one's main duties, if one still has extra energy or capacity, it can be used to take on additional tasks or help others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家做完本份工作，如果行有餘力，我會幫手做啲額外嘅任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zou6 jyun4 bun2 fan6 gung1 zok3, jyu4 gwo2 haang4 jau5 jyu4 lik6, ngo5 wui5 bong1 sau2 zou6 di1 ngaak6 ngoi6 ge3 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在本職工作做完，如果有餘力，我會幫忙做一些額外的任務。
examples.english_sentence: Now that I've finished my main duties, if I have spare energy I'll help with some extra tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯，如果行有餘力，佢仲會幫手洗碗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6, jyu4 gwo2 haang4 jau5 jyu4 lik6, keoi5 zung6 wui5 bong1 sau2 sai2 wun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完飯，如果有餘力，他還會幫忙洗碗。
examples.english_sentence: After eating, if he has extra energy, he'll still help wash the dishes.

mandarin_meaning: 行李 (xínglǐ)
english_meaning: luggage; baggage
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛放衣物和個人物品以便旅行或搬運的箱包、袋子等；在比喻用法上，也可指心理或情感上的負擔（如「心裡的行李」）。
explanation_english: Refers to suitcases, bags and other items used to carry clothing and personal belongings when traveling or moving; figuratively, it can mean emotional or psychological burdens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔好遲到，記得拎好你嘅行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 ci4 dou3, gei3 dak1 ling1 hou2 nei5 ge3 haang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们别迟到，记得把行李拿好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be late; remember to keep your luggage safe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲背住好多過去嘅行李，未準備好放低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 bui3 zyu6 hou2 do1 gwo3 heoi3 ge3 haang4 lei5, mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 fong3 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仍然背负着很多过去的包袱，还没准备好放下。
examples.english_sentence: He still carries a lot of baggage from the past and isn't ready to let it go.

mandarin_meaning: 行李箱
english_meaning: suitcase; luggage case
explanation_mandarin: 用來裝衣物和其他隨身物品的箱子，常用於旅行或搬運。
explanation_english: A case used to store clothes and personal items for travel or transport; a suitcase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲行李箱好重，搬唔到上樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 hang4 lei5 soeng1 hou2 zung6, bun1 m4 dou3 soeng5 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的行李箱很重，搬不上樓。
examples.english_sentence: My suitcase is very heavy; I can't carry it upstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門記得鎖好行李箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 so2 hou2 hang4 lei5 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門記得把行李箱鎖好。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to lock your suitcase when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場規定行李箱唔可以超重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 gwai1 ding6 hang4 lei5 soeng1 m4 ho2 ji5 ciu1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 機場規定行李箱不能超重。
examples.english_sentence: The airport rules say suitcases cannot be overweight.

mandarin_meaning: 行业
english_meaning: industry; trade; profession
explanation_mandarin: 指特定的产业、职业或商业领域，例如金融、医疗、教育等。
explanation_english: Refers to a particular industry, trade, or line of work—for example finance, healthcare, or education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺金融行業做咗十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam1 jung4 hong4 jip6 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在金融行业工作了十年。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked in the finance industry for ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行業競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 ging3 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行业竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: This industry is highly competitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入行之前，你要了解呢個行業嘅前景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 hong4 zi1 cin4, nei5 jiu3 liu5 gaai2 ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 ge3 cin4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在进入这个行业之前，你要了解它的前景。
examples.english_sentence: Before entering this industry, you should understand its prospects.

mandarin_meaning: 擺檔；擺地攤做小販生意
english_meaning: to run a stall; to hawk/operate a street stall (be a vendor)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指在街市、路邊或市集中擺檔賣東西，當小販做生意。
explanation_english: Colloquial term meaning to set up and operate a stall (usually in a market or on the street) to sell goods as a vendor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日話唔好喺路邊行檔，危險又冇保障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 waa6 m4 hou2 hai2 lou6 bin1 haang4 dong3, ngai4 him2 jau6 mou5 bou2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈常说不要在路边摆摊，危险又没有保障。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always says not to set up a stall by the roadside; it's dangerous and offers no protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小販喺週末會喺公園行檔，賣手工飾物同小食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 faan6 hai2 zau1 mut6 wui5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 haang4 dong3, maai6 sau2 gung1 sik1 mat6 tung4 siu2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小贩在周末会在公园摆摊，卖手工饰品和小吃。
examples.english_sentence: Vendors set up stalls in the park on weekends, selling handmade accessories and snacks.

mandarin_meaning: 做陪酒、陪客的工作（通常指在酒吧、夜總會等場所以陪侍顧客為職業）
english_meaning: To work as a hostess/companion in bars/nightclubs — to entertain or accompany customers for pay (often implies paid companionship and sometimes has sexual connotations depending on context).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指在酒吧、夜總會等場所以陪酒、陪客為職業，或以陪伴顧客賺取報酬。有時含有性交易的暗示，但不一定等同於賣淫。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to work as a hostess or paid companion in establishments like bars or nightclubs — entertaining or accompanying patrons for money. It can imply sex work in some contexts but is not always equivalent to prostitution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗還債去行檯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 waan4 zaap6 heoi3 haang4 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她為了還債去當陪酒小姐。
examples.english_sentence: She went to work as a hostess to pay off her debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為行檯好賺，實情好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai6 haang4 toi4 hou2 zaan6, sat6 cing4 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以為做陪酒小姐很賺，其實很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume being a hostess is very lucrative; the reality is often very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲酒吧會請女仔去行檯陪客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 zau2 baa1 wui5 ceng2 neoi5 zai2 heoi3 haang4 toi4 pui4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些酒吧會請女孩去當陪客/陪酒。
examples.english_sentence: Some bars hire girls to work as hostesses and accompany customers.

jyutping: hang4 bou6 lou6 dou1 daa2 dou2 teoi3
mandarin_meaning: 累到連走路都會倒下／虛弱到走路也會跌倒（口語、誇張）
english_meaning: So exhausted or weak that one could collapse even while walking (colloquial/exaggerated).
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容非常疲累或虛弱，以至於連走路也會跌倒或撐不住，多為口語或誇張說法。
explanation_english: Describes extreme tiredness or physical weakness to the point of collapsing even when walking. Mainly a colloquial or hyperbolic expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁虛弱，行步路都打倒褪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 heoi1 joek6, hang4 bou6 lou6 dou1 daa2 dou2 teoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這麼虛弱，走路都會倒下。
examples.english_sentence: He's so weak that he collapses even when walking.

mandarin_meaning: 行氣（中醫術語：疏通、促進氣的運行）
english_meaning: to move/regulate qi (TCM term: promote circulation of vital energy)
explanation_mandarin: 中醫術語，指透過藥物、針灸或其他治療方法疏通、促進氣的運行，以解除氣滯引起的胸脹、腹脹、嗳氣或消化不良等症狀。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese medicine term meaning to move or regulate qi (vital energy). It refers to using herbs, acupuncture, or other treatments to relieve qi stagnation and related symptoms such as bloating, chest oppression, belching, or indigestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話呢個方劑可以行氣化濕，改善腹脹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 ni1 go3 fong1 zai3 ho2 ji5 hang4 hei3 faa3 sap1, goi2 sin6 fuk1 zong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中醫說這個方劑可以行氣化濕，改善腹脹。
examples.english_sentence: The TCM practitioner said this formula can move qi and transform dampness, improving abdominal bloating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲陳皮茶可以行氣，幫手消滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 can4 pei4 caa4 ho2 ji5 hang4 hei3, bong1 sau2 siu1 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝陳皮茶可以行氣，幫助消滯。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking tangerine-peel tea can move qi and help with indigestion.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）去嫖妓、發生性行為（粗俗用法）；（字面）讓水流、放水（較少單獨使用）
english_meaning: Slang: to visit a prostitute / to have (casual) sex (vulgar); literally: to run water or let water flow (literal, less common)
explanation_mandarin: 「行水」在香港粵語中常作俚語，指去嫖妓或與人發生性關係，語氣粗俗；也可從字面理解為「讓水流／放水」，但作此義時須看上下文，較少單獨用。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "行水" is commonly used as slang meaning to visit a prostitute or to have sexual intercourse (vulgar). Literally it can mean "to run water" or "let water flow," but this literal sense is less commonly used on its own and depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢噚晚去行水，今朝返嚟精神唔係幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 maan5 heoi3 hang4 seoi2, gam1 ziu1 faan1 lai4 zing1 san4 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天晚上去嫖妓，今天早上回來精神不是很好。
