explanation_english: In Cantonese, "難為" is commonly used as a verb meaning to embarrass or put someone in a difficult position. It is also used colloquially to express sympathy or to thank someone (e.g., "難為你").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好難為佢，佢已經做得好好喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 naan4 wai4 keoi5, keoi5 ji5 ging1 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別為難他，他已經做得很好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make things difficult for him; he's already done very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫手，真係難為晒你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 sau2, zan1 hai6 naan4 wai4 saai3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝你幫忙，真是麻煩你了。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for your help — I'm really putting you out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆唔好難為新員工，俾啲時間佢適應吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 m4 hou2 naan4 wai4 san1 jyun4 gung1, bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 keoi5 sik1 jing3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不要為難新員工，給他些時間適應一下。
examples.english_sentence: Boss, don't be hard on the new employee; give them some time to adjust.

mandarin_meaning: 难为情
english_meaning: embarrassed; feeling awkward or shy
explanation_mandarin: 表示感到不好意思、尴尬或羞愧，常用來形容面對他人時感到局促或難堪的情緒。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of embarrassment, awkwardness, or shyness—being uncomfortable or self-conscious in front of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁講，我真係覺得好難為情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 hou2 naan4 wai4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他那样说，我真的觉得很难为情。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that, I really felt embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔識答人嘅問題，面都紅晒，好難為情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sik1 daap3 jan4 ge3 man6 tai4, min6 dou1 hung4 saai3, hou2 naan4 wai4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不会回答别人的问题，脸都红了，很难为情。
examples.english_sentence: He couldn't answer the other's question; his face turned red—very embarrassed.

mandarin_meaning: 为难；使为难；使尴尬；（口语）可怜、同情
english_meaning: to make someone feel embarrassed or put someone in a difficult position; to trouble someone; (colloquially) to feel sorry for someone
explanation_mandarin: 表示使別人感到尷尬或處於難處、為難；口語中也可表示對某人感到可憐或惋惜。
explanation_english: Used to say that someone is made to feel embarrassed or put in a difficult position; colloquially can also express feeling sorry for someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好難爲佢啦，佢已經盡力喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 naan4 wai4 keoi5 laa3, keoi5 ji5 ging1 zeon6 lik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別為難他了，他已經盡力了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make things difficult for him; he's already done his best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講會令人難爲，唔好再提啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 wui5 ling6 jan4 naan4 wai4, m4 hou2 zoi3 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說會讓人感到為難，別再提了。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that will embarrass people — don't bring it up again.

mandarin_meaning: 難為情（感到害羞、不好意思或尷尬）
english_meaning: embarrassed; shy; feeling awkward
explanation_mandarin: 表示因害羞、窘迫或覺得不好意思而感到尷尬或不自在的心情。
explanation_english: Indicates feeling embarrassed, shy, or awkward in a social situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁難爲情，大家都明白你嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam2 naan4 wai4 cing4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不需要這麼難為情，大家都明白你的意思。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be so embarrassed; everyone understands what you mean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到老朋友，佢有啲難爲情，唔知點開口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 lou5 pang4 jau5, keoi5 jau5 di1 naan4 wai4 cing4, m4 zi1 dim2 hoi1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 見到老朋友，他有點不好意思，不知道怎麼開口。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw his old friend, he felt a bit embarrassed and didn't know how to start the conversation.

mandarin_meaning: 難產
english_meaning: difficult labor; dystocia; (figuratively) something that is hard to complete or make progress on
explanation_mandarin: 指分娩過程中出現困難，嬰兒無法順利產出；也可比喻事情進展困難，難以完成。
explanation_english: Refers to difficulty during childbirth when the baby cannot be delivered normally; figuratively used for a project or process that is stalled or hard to complete.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢生細路嗰陣難產，最後要剖腹產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saang1 sai3 lou6 go2 zan6 naan4 caan2, zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 pou2 fuk1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她生孩子時難產，最後要剖腹產。
examples.english_sentence: She had a difficult labor and eventually needed a cesarean section.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個項目一路難產，開會講咗幾年都冇成果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hong6 muk6 jat1 lou6 naan4 caan2, hoi1 wui2 gong2 zo2 gei2 nin4 dou1 mou5 sing4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個項目進展一直很困難，開會討論了好幾年都沒有成果。
examples.english_sentence: The project has been struggling to make progress; they've been talking about it in meetings for years with no results.

jyutping: naan4 dang1 daai6 ngaa5 zi1 tong4
mandarin_meaning: 難以進入高雅的場合；不配在高尚場合出現
english_meaning: Not fit for refined company; unworthy of elegant or highbrow occasions
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某事物或言行粗鄙、不夠高雅，配不上高尚或講究品味的場合。
explanation_english: Used to describe something or someone's words/actions as vulgar or unrefined, unsuitable for elegant or highbrow settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲笑話好低俗，真係難登大雅之堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 siu3waa6 hou2 dai1suk6, zan1hai6 naan4 dang1 daai6 ngaa5 zi1 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑話很低俗，真是難登大雅之堂。
examples.english_sentence: His jokes are very vulgar; they're really not fit for polite company.

mandarin_meaning: 难相处；不好相处
english_meaning: hard to get along with; difficult to deal with
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人性格或態度使人難以相處、相處起來不容易，常用來形容人難以溝通或合作。
explanation_english: Describes a person whose personality or attitude makes them difficult to get along with or deal with; often used when someone is hard to communicate or cooperate with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個性好古怪，真係難相與。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sing3 hou2 gu2 gwaai3, zan1 hai6 naan4 soeng1 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格很古怪，真的很难相处。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is strange; he's really hard to get along with.

mandarin_meaning: 难看 (nánkàn)：难看、不好看，也可指言行令人尴尬或不体面
english_meaning: ugly; unsightly; unpleasant to look at; awkward or embarrassing (of behaviour or remarks)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容外表或事物不好看，也可用來形容言行讓人尷尬、不體面或不合適。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that is unattractive in appearance; can also describe remarks or actions that are awkward, embarrassing, or inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好難看。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 naan4 hon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很难看。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is very ugly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講真係幾難看，會傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 hon3, wui5 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你那样说真的有点难看，会伤人。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is kind of hurtful/embarrassing and will hurt people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日個樣好難看，可能唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 go3 joeng6 hou2 naan4 hon3, ho2 nang4 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天样子很难看，可能不高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He looks bad today; maybe he's unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 难看；令人尴尬、难以观看
english_meaning: ugly; unattractive; hard or unpleasant to watch; embarrassing/cringe-worthy
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語/俚語，表示外觀難看、不好看；也可用來形容某事令人尷尬、難堪或難以繼續觀看（例如無聊或令人尷尬的表演）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term meaning 'hard to look at.' It describes something or someone that looks unattractive or ugly, and can also describe something that is awkward, embarrassing, or unbearable to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫好難睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 hou2 naan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她的衣服很難看。
examples.english_sentence: His/Her clothes look really ugly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲真係好悶，好難睇，我睇唔落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 mun6, hou2 naan4 tai2, ngo5 tai2 m4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部片真的是又無聊又難看，我看不下去。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is really boring and hard to watch; I couldn't keep watching it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲嘢好難睇，大家都唔知點回應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 je5 hou2 naan4 tai2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 wui4 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她說那些話很難堪，大家都不知道怎麼回應。
examples.english_sentence: What he/she said was embarrassing; everyone didn't know how to respond.

mandarin_meaning: 難以約見／難以安排（見面或預約）
english_meaning: hard to arrange (a meeting/reservation); difficult to make plans with
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（用於描述人或事物難以安排約見或預約）
explanation_mandarin: 「難約」用來形容某人或某事很難約到時間見面或預約到位置，通常表示對方沒空或名額緊張。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that is difficult to schedule or make an appointment with — e.g., someone who's often unavailable or a place that's hard to get a reservation at.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢好難約，成日唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 hou2 naan4 joek3, sing4 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很難約到他，他總是沒空。
examples.english_sentence: He's been hard to make plans with lately; he's always busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 周末嗰間餐廳好難約，要好早預約先有位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau1 mut6 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 naan4 joek3, jiu3 hou2 zou2 jyu6 joek3 sin1 jau5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐廳週末很難訂位，需要很早預約才有位子。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant is hard to get a reservation at on weekends; you need to book very early to get a table.

mandarin_meaning: 难缠（指人或问题不好应付，棘手）
english_meaning: Hard to deal with; troublesome; difficult to handle
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或事情不好應付、麻煩且難以解決或說服。
explanation_english: Describes a person or matter that is difficult to handle, troublesome, or hard to resolve or persuade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個客人好難纏，成日投訴我哋嘅服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haak3 jan4 hou2 naan4 cin4, sing4 jat6 tau4 sou3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个顾客很难缠，总是投诉我们的服务。
examples.english_sentence: This customer is difficult to deal with and keeps complaining about our service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條問題好難纏，要花多啲時間先至解決到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 man6 tai4 hou2 naan4 cin4, jiu3 faa1 do1 di1 si4 gaan1 sin1 zi3 gaai2 kyut3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很棘手，需要花更多时间才能解决。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is tricky and will take more time to solve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家真係幾難纏，唔肯聽人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 cin4, m4 hang2 teng1 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在真的很难缠，不肯听别人的话。
examples.english_sentence: He's really being difficult now and refuses to listen to others.

mandarin_meaning: 难闻（指气味难闻；令人不愉快的气味）
english_meaning: unpleasant-smelling; foul-smelling
explanation_mandarin: 指氣味令人不舒服、刺鼻或臭的情況。也可在較少見的情況下用來形容言語或消息讓人難以接受或聽起來不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes an unpleasant or offensive smell. Less commonly, it can be used figuratively to describe speech or news that is unpleasant to hear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個房間好難聞，可能係有霉味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong4 gaan1 hou2 naan4 man4, ho2 nang4 hai6 jau5 mui4 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个房间很难闻，可能有霉味。
examples.english_sentence: This room smells bad; it might have a moldy odor.

mandarin_meaning: 難聽（聲音刺耳或話語粗魯、冒犯）
english_meaning: harsh-sounding; unpleasant to hear; rude or offensive (when describing remarks)
explanation_mandarin: 「難聽」可指聲音不好聽、刺耳，也可用來形容別人說話粗魯、不中聽或冒犯別人。
explanation_english: Used to describe a sound that is unpleasant or harsh to the ear. It can also describe remarks that are rude, offensive, or hurtful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講真係好難聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說真的很難聽。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is really unpleasant/rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌好難聽，我唔想聽第二次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hou2 naan4 teng1, ngo5 m4 soeng2 teng1 dai6 ji6 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這首歌很難聽，我不想再聽第二遍。
examples.english_sentence: This song is really unpleasant; I don't want to listen to it again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我講嘅話好難聽，我好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 gong2 ge3 waa6 hou2 naan4 teng1, ngo5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對我說的話很難聽，我很不開心。
examples.english_sentence: The things he said to me were hurtful; I'm really upset.

mandarin_meaning: 比粗口還難聽；比骂髒話更刺耳或更侮辱
english_meaning: worse than swearing; harsher or more offensive than curse words
explanation_mandarin: 口語俗語，用來形容說話或字眼非常刺耳、難以接受，甚至比一般的粗口更侮辱或傷人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe speech or words that are extremely unpleasant or offensive—so bad they are considered worse than ordinary swear words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲說話真係難聽過粗口，聽到我好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 syut3 waa6 zan1 hai6 naan4 teng1 gwo3 cou1 hau2, teng1 dou3 ngo5 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的話真的比粗口還難聽，聽得我很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was worse than swearing — it made me feel really uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 难能可贵 (nán néng kě guì)：罕见而值得称赞，难得且可贵
english_meaning: Admirable; rare and worthy of praise; praiseworthy
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情或品質難得，值得稱讚或珍惜。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is rare and deserving of praise or appreciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺咁忙都會抽時間幫人，真係難能可貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam2 mong4 dou1 wui5 cau1 si4 gaan3 bong1 jan4, zan1 hai6 naan4 nang4 ho2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么忙还会抽时间帮助别人，真是难能可贵。
examples.english_sentence: He is so busy yet still finds time to help others; truly admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種誠意喺而家社會真係好難得，難能可貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 sing4 ji3 hai2 ji4 gaa1 se5 wui6 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 dak1, naan4 nang4 ho2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种诚意在现在社会真的很难得，难能可贵。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of sincerity is truly rare in today's society and commendable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢成績唔係最好，但肯承認錯誤同改進，好難能可貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 sing4 zik1 m4 hai6 zeoi3 hou2, daan6 hang2 sing4 jing6 co3 ng6 tung4 goi2 zeon3, hou2 naan4 nang4 ho2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他成绩不是最好，但肯承认错误并改进，很难能可贵。
examples.english_sentence: Although his grades aren't the best, it's commendable that he admits mistakes and improves.

mandarin_meaning: 難以言說的隱情；難以啟齒的私事
english_meaning: a private or sensitive matter that is hard to express; something one cannot easily talk about
explanation_mandarin: 指難以用言語說清楚或不方便向人提起的隱情或私事，常用來婉轉表示有不便透露的原因或困難。
explanation_english: Refers to a hidden or sensitive issue that is difficult to put into words or awkward to mention; often used to politely indicate there are reasons one cannot disclose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企有啲難言之隱，所以唔想多講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 jau5 di1 naan4 jin4 zi1 jan2, so2 ji5 m4 soeng2 do1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家裡有一些難言之隱，所以不想多說。
examples.english_sentence: There are some matters at home he can't talk about, so he doesn't want to say much.

mandarin_meaning: 难说 / 很难确定
english_meaning: hard to say; difficult to determine; not easy to answer
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事不好确定或无法明确回答，难以断定或下定论。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not easy to determine or answer; it is difficult to give a definite response or conclusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年啲天氣咁奇怪，幾時會返暖就真係難講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 di1 tin1 hei3 gam3 kei4 gwaai3, gei2 si4 wui5 faan1 nyun5 zau6 zan1 hai6 naan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的天气很奇怪，什么时候会回暖真的是很难说。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been so strange this year; when it will warm up is really hard to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問佢會唔會嚟幫手？而家我覺得好難講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 keoi5 wui5 m4 wui5 lei4 bong1 sau2? ji4 gaa1 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 naan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你问他会不会来帮忙？现在我觉得很难说。
examples.english_sentence: You ask if he'll come to help? Right now I think it's hard to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於呢單嘢，佢會點做就難講喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 daan1 je5, keoi5 wui5 dim2 zou6 zau6 naan4 gong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 关于这件事，他会怎么做就难说了。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding this matter, how he'll handle it is hard to say.

mandarin_meaning: 难以推卸其过失/责任
english_meaning: cannot avoid blame; hard to shirk responsibility
explanation_mandarin: 表示無法推卸責任或逃避過失，多用於指出某人或某方應對不良後果負責。
explanation_english: Indicates that one cannot escape blame or shirk responsibility; often used to point out that someone or some party must be held accountable for negative outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事由你負責，所以你難辭其咎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jau4 nei5 fu6 zaak3, so2 ji5 nei5 naan4 ci4 kei4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事由你負責，所以你難辭其咎。
examples.english_sentence: You were in charge of this matter, so you cannot escape the blame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然公司有疏失，但作為主管，他難辭其咎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gung1 si1 jau5 so1 sat1, daan6 zok3 wai4 zyu2 gun2, taa1 naan4 ci4 kei4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然公司有疏失，但作為主管，他難辭其咎。
examples.english_sentence: Although the company made mistakes, as a manager he cannot escape blame.

mandarin_meaning: 難以逃脫災難或禍害；終難逃避相同命運
english_meaning: unable to escape a disaster or misfortune; inevitably suffer the same fate/consequences
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示無論如何都難以避免遭遇不好的結果或災難，常用於描述罪行、過錯或不幸最終會有報應或後果。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that one cannot avoid suffering a misfortune or consequence; often used to describe that wrongdoing or mistakes will eventually lead to inevitable punishment or bad outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷咗公司嘅錢，遲早難逃一劫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 cin2, ci4 zou2 naan4 tou4 jat1 gip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷了公司的錢，遲早難逃一劫。
examples.english_sentence: He stole from the company; sooner or later he won't escape the consequences.

mandarin_meaning: 雨势（雨的强弱、降雨的强度）
english_meaning: rain intensity; the strength or severity of rainfall
explanation_mandarin: 表示降雨的強弱或大小，常用於描述下雨的程度或天氣預報中。
explanation_english: Refers to how strong or heavy the rain is; commonly used to describe the degree of rainfall or in weather reports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨喇，雨勢好大，記得帶埋雨傘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 laa3, jyu5 sai3 hou2 daai6, gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 jyu5 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨了，雨势很大，记得带上雨伞。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining and the rain is heavy — remember to take an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台話今晚會落大雨，要留意雨勢變化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 waa6 gam1 maan5 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5, jiu3 lau4 ji3 jyu5 sai3 bin3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 气象台说今晚会下大雨，要注意雨势变化。
examples.english_sentence: The observatory says there will be heavy rain tonight; pay attention to changes in the rain intensity.

mandarin_meaning: 雨天 / 下雨的日子
english_meaning: rainy day
explanation_mandarin: 指下雨的天氣，常用作時間或天氣的名詞。
explanation_english: Refers to a day or period when it is raining; used as a noun to describe weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係雨天，我哋唔好出去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 jyu5 tin1, ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 ceot1 heoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是雨天，我們別出門了。
examples.english_sentence: It's a rainy day today; let's not go out.

mandarin_meaning: 雨天的操场
english_meaning: playground on a rainy day (a wet/slippery playground)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是下雨時的操場，通常指因下雨而濕滑或暫時不能使用的操場。
explanation_english: Literally 'playground on a rainy day'; refers to a playground that is wet and often slippery or unusable because of rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落大雨，雨天操場濕晒，唔好畀小朋友去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, jyu5 tin1 cou1 coeng4 sap1 saai3, m4 hou2 bei2 siu2 pang4 jau5 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下大雨，雨天操场全都湿了，别让小朋友去玩。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining heavily today; the playground is all wet — don't let the children play there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校通知話雨天操場唔可以踢波，要去禮堂練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 tung1 zi1 waa6 jyu5 tin1 cou1 coeng4 m4 ho2 ji5 tek3 bo1, jiu3 heoi3 lai5 tong4 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校通知说雨天操场不能踢足球，要去礼堂练习。
examples.english_sentence: The school announced that on rainy days the playground can't be used for soccer; practice will be in the auditorium.

mandarin_meaning: 雨季 (yǔjì)
english_meaning: rainy season; monsoon season
explanation_mandarin: 一年中降雨较多的季节，常出现在夏季或受季风影响的地区。
explanation_english: The period of the year when rainfall is frequent or heavy; commonly occurs in summer or in regions affected by monsoons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雨季開始，落大雨嘅日子會增多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 gwai3 hoi1 ci2, lok6 daai6 jyu5 ge3 jat6 zi2 wui5 zang1 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雨季开始，大雨的日子会增多。
examples.english_sentence: The rainy season has begun; there will be more days with heavy rain.

mandarin_meaning: 雨带（气象学术语，指带状分布的降水区）
english_meaning: rain band (a band-shaped region of precipitation)
explanation_mandarin: 在气象学中，雨带指沿一定方向延伸、呈带状分布的降水区，通常与锋面、低压槽或季风槽等系统有关，经过时可能出现持续性或集中的降雨。
explanation_english: In meteorology, a rain band is a band-shaped region of precipitation that extends along a line, often associated with fronts, troughs, or monsoon features; its passage can bring sustained or concentrated rainfall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台話今晚會有雨帶掠過，可能會落大雨，出門記得帶傘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 waa6 gam1 maan5 wui5 jau5 jyu5 daai3 loek6 gwo3, ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5, ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台说今晚会有雨带掠过，可能会下大雨，出门记得带伞。
examples.english_sentence: The observatory said a rain band will pass tonight, and heavy rain is possible; remember to take an umbrella when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 雨后春笋 (yǔ hòu chūn sǔn) — 形容事物大量且迅速地出現
english_meaning: to spring up like bamboo shoots after the rain; to appear rapidly in great numbers
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在短時間內大量湧現或迅速增加，常用來形容新事物或新事業大量出現。
explanation_english: A metaphor describing things that emerge or proliferate rapidly in large numbers over a short period; often used for new businesses, trends, or openings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排呢區新開嘅咖啡店就似雨後春筍，成條街都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 ni1 keoi1 san1 hoi1 ge3 gaa3 fe1 dim3 zau6 ci5 jyu5 hau6 ceon1 seon2, sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近這區新開的咖啡店如雨后春笋，整條街都是。
examples.english_sentence: Lately the new cafes in this area have been popping up like bamboo shoots after the rain; the whole street is full of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排科技初創公司雨後春筍，投資者要小心揀選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 fo1 gei6 co1 cong3 gung1 si1 jyu5 hau6 ceon1 seon2, tau4 zi1 ze2 jiu3 siu2 sam1 gaan2 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近科技初創公司如雨后春笋出現，投資者要小心選擇。
examples.english_sentence: Tech startups have been springing up like bamboo shoots after the rain recently; investors need to choose carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 被雨弄濕的頭髮（口語）
english_meaning: rain-soaked hair; hair wet from rain (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語或地區性用語，字面是「雨」+「毛」，通常用來形容頭髮或毛髮被雨淋濕、顯得濕漉或蓬亂的樣子。
explanation_english: A colloquial/regional term literally meaning 'rain + hair/fur.' It describes hair (or fur) that has been wetted by rain — i.e., damp, soaked, or disheveled after being caught in the rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日落雨冇帶遮，返到屋企成頭都係雨毛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 mou5 daai3 ze2 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 sing4 tau4 dou1 hai6 jyu5 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天下雨沒帶傘，回到家頭髮全都被雨弄濕了。
examples.english_sentence: It rained today and I didn't bring an umbrella; when I got home my hair was completely soaked.

mandarin_meaning: 雨水 (yǔshuǐ) — 雨水；亦可指二十四节气中的“雨水”
english_meaning: rainwater; precipitation; also the 'Rain Water' solar term in the traditional Chinese calendar
explanation_mandarin: 指從天而降的雨水，即積存在地面或容器中的水；在農曆節氣中，『雨水』是二十四節氣之一，表示降雨開始增多、氣溫回升。
explanation_english: Refers to water from rainfall — water that accumulates on the ground or in containers after rain. In the traditional lunar solar terms, 'Rain Water' is one of the 24 solar terms indicating increased precipitation and rising temperatures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落咗成日嘅雨，院子入面積滿咗雨水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 zo2 seng4 jat6 ge3 jyu5, jyun2 zi2 jap6 min6 zik1 mun5 zo2 jyu5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下了整天的雨，院子里积满了雨水。
examples.english_sentence: It rained all day; the yard filled up with rainwater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係二十四節氣嘅雨水，農民開始準備春耕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 ji6 sap6 sei3 zit3 hei3 ge3 jyu5 seoi2, nung4 man4 hoi1 ci2 zeon2 bei6 ceon1 gang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是二十四节气中的雨水，农民开始准备春耕。
examples.english_sentence: Today is the Rain Water solar term; farmers begin preparing for spring plowing.

mandarin_meaning: 下雨的日子 / 多雨的天气
english_meaning: rainy days; wet/rainy weather
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指經常下雨或潮濕的日子，常用來描述連續下雨或多雨的季節或天氣狀況。
explanation_english: A colloquial term referring to days of rain or generally wet, rainy weather; used to describe periods or days with frequent rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今排成日落雨，成日係雨水天，出街記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 paai4 sing4 jat6 lok6 jyu5, sing4 jat6 hai6 jyu5 seoi2 tin1, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近经常下雨，一直都是雨水天，出门记得带伞。
examples.english_sentence: It has been raining a lot lately — it's been rainy days; remember to bring an umbrella when going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天多雨，農夫歡迎雨水天，因為田地需要水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 do1 jyu5, nung4 fu1 fun1 jing4 jyu5 seoi2 tin1, jan1 wai6 tin4 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天多雨，农夫欢迎雨水天，因为田地需要水。
examples.english_sentence: Spring is rainy; farmers welcome rainy days because the fields need water.

mandarin_meaning: 細雨、毛毛雨（罕用、書面或詩意用法）
english_meaning: a fine drizzle; light rain (rare/literary/poetic usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「雨溦」為罕見或書面用詞，指細小的雨、毛毛雨。現代口語中較少使用，常見於詩歌或古文筆調中用來描寫微細的雨勢。
explanation_english: “雨溦” is a rare or literary term referring to a fine drizzle or light rain. It is uncommon in everyday speech and is more likely to appear in poetic or written contexts to describe a gentle, fine rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝有少少雨溦，出門記得帶把遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 jau5 siu2 siu2 jyu5 wai1, ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai3 baa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上有細雨，出門記得帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: This morning there's a light drizzle; remember to bring an umbrella.

mandarin_meaning: 細雨綿綿／毛毛雨
english_meaning: a light, persistent drizzle; drizzling continuously
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 擬聲詞（可作副詞或形容詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「雨溦溦」是粵語的擬聲詞，用來形容細細的、連綿不斷的雨，帶有輕柔、綿綿的感覺，常用來描寫天氣或營造氛圍。
explanation_english: “雨溦溦” is a Cantonese onomatopoeic expression describing a fine, continuous drizzle. It conveys a soft, lingering rain and is often used to describe weather or set a mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日溦溦地下細雨，好有詩意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 wai4 wai4 dei6 haa6 sai3 jyu5, hou2 jau5 si1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下著綿綿細雨，很有詩意。
examples.english_sentence: It's drizzling lightly today; it's very poetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門要帶遮，外面溦溦地下緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 jiu3 daai3 ze1, ngoi6 min6 wai4 wai4 dei6 haa6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門要帶傘，外面正在下毛毛雨。
examples.english_sentence: Take an umbrella when you go out; it's drizzling outside.

mandarin_meaning: 斗笠（用來遮雨或遮陽的圓錐形草編帽）
english_meaning: conical straw rain hat; rain hat
explanation_mandarin: 粵語中指用以遮雨或遮陽的笠狀帽子，與普通話的「斗笠」相近，常見於漁民或農村地區。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, a hat shaped like a cone used to shield from rain or sun, similar to the Mandarin term 'dǒulì' (conical straw hat). Commonly seen among fishermen and rural workers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨唔想濕頭，佢就戴返個雨笠出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 m4 soeng2 sap1 tau4, keoi5 zau6 daai3 faan1 go3 jyu5 laap3 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨不想頭髮濕，他便戴上雨笠出門。
examples.english_sentence: When it's raining and he doesn't want his head to get wet, he puts on a rain hat before going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 漁民成日戴住雨笠出海捕魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 man4 sing4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 jyu5 laap3 ceot1 hoi2 bou2 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 漁民常常戴著斗笠出海捕魚。
examples.english_sentence: Fishermen often wear conical straw hats when they go out to sea to fish.

mandarin_meaning: （對藝人）Rain 的粉絲；非正式稱呼
english_meaning: a fan of the singer Rain (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「雨粉」為非正式、口語化的稱呼，通常指韓國歌手 Rain（藝名 Rain/비）的粉絲。字面上兩字為「雨」和「粉」，此處「粉」等同「粉絲」。多見於網路或年輕人口語中。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term used to refer to fans of the Korean singer Rain (stage name Rain/비). Literally 'rain' + 'fan', where 'fan' means follower/supporter. Commonly used online and in casual speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係Rain嘅雨粉，成日上網睇佢嘅MV。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 Rain ge3 jyu5 fan2, sing4 jat6 soeng5 mong5 tai2 keoi5 ge3 MV.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是Rain的雨粉，經常上網看他的MV。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is a fan of Rain, often watches his MV online.

jyutping: jyu5 fan1 fan1 (常見非正式寫法，標準字為「雨紛紛」，亦可讀作 jyu5 fan1 fan1)
mandarin_meaning: （下着）细雨绵绵；绵绵细雨
english_meaning: light, continuous drizzle; drizzling rain
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 副詞（用來描述天氣）
explanation_mandarin: 俗語/口語說法，描述連續不斷、輕微的細雨。書面上通常寫作「雨紛紛」，在香港口語或網絡語境有時以「雨粉粉」的諧寫出現。
explanation_english: A colloquial/poetic expression describing light, continuous rain (a drizzle). The standard written form is "雨紛紛"; "雨粉粉" is an informal or playful variant sometimes seen in Hong Kong speech or online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家落緊雨粉粉，出門記得帶把遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 lok6 gan2 jyu5 fan1 fan1, ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai3 baa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在下着绵绵细雨，出门记得带把伞。
examples.english_sentence: It's drizzling right now; remember to bring an umbrella when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 雨衣 (yǔyī)
english_meaning: raincoat; waterproof coat
explanation_mandarin: 用于下雨时穿的防水外套，用来遮风挡雨。可指不同材质（塑料、尼龙等）。
explanation_english: A waterproof coat worn to protect from rain; used to shield from wind and rain. Can be made from materials like plastic or nylon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝落大雨，記得著雨衣先出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 lok6 daai6 jyu5, gei3 dak1 zoek3 jyu5 ji1 sin1 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上下大雨，出门前记得穿雨衣。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining heavily this morning; remember to put on your raincoat before going out.

mandarin_meaning: 雨衣
english_meaning: raincoat; waterproof jacket
explanation_mandarin: 一種防水的外衣，用來在下雨時保護身體不被淋濕。
explanation_english: A waterproof outer garment worn to protect the body from getting wet in the rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前記得帶雨褸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 gei3 dak1 daai3 jyu5 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门前记得带雨衣。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring a raincoat before you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：雨衣男子（穿或賣雨衣的人）。口語/俚語：可指在街頭擺檔、常穿雨衣的小販；有時帶貶義，用來形容衣著邋遢或行為可疑的人。
english_meaning: Literal: 'raincoat man' — a man who wears or sells raincoats. Colloquially/slang: a street vendor who often wears a raincoat; sometimes used derogatorily for a shabby or suspicious-looking person.
explanation_mandarin: 「雨褸佬」原指賣或穿雨褸的人。口語中亦可用來稱呼在街頭擺檔的小販，或作貶義形容衣著破爛或行為可疑的人。
explanation_english: Originally refers to someone who sells or wears a raincoat. In colloquial use it can refer to a street vendor who wears a raincoat, or derogatorily to someone shabby or suspicious-looking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個雨褸佬成日喺街角擺檔賣雨衣，見到路過就招呼人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 jyu5 leot6 lou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 gok3 baai2 daan1 maai6 jyu5 ji1, gin3 dou3 lou6 gwo3 zau6 ziu1 fu1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個賣雨衣的人常常在街角擺攤，看到路人就招呼。
examples.english_sentence: That raincoat seller often sets up a stall on the corner and calls out to passersby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著住件破爛嘅雨褸，街坊都叫佢「雨褸佬」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 po3 laan6 ge3 jyu5 leot6, gaai1 fong1 dou1 giu3 keoi5 'jyu5 leot6 lou2'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是穿著破舊的雨衣，街坊都叫他「雨褸佬」。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears a tattered raincoat; the neighbors call him 'raincoat man'.

mandarin_meaning: 雨过天晴（字面：雨停天空放晴；引申：困難過去，情況好轉）
english_meaning: After the rain clears (literally); metaphorically, troubles have passed and things are improving
explanation_mandarin: 字面指雨停天晴；常用作比喻，表示經歷過困難或不順之後，情況好轉或心情變好。
explanation_english: Literally describes the sky clearing after rain; commonly used metaphorically to mean that difficulties have passed and the situation or mood has improved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落咗成日雨，依家終於雨過天晴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 zo2 sing4 jat6 jyu5, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 jyu5 gwo3 tin1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下了一整天的雨，現在終於雨過天晴。
examples.english_sentence: It rained all day; now the rain has passed and the sky has cleared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試完咗，依家終於雨過天晴，我可以出街玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 jyun4 zo2, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 jyu5 gwo3 tin1 cing4, ngo5 ho2 ji5 ceot1 gaai1 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試結束了，現在終於雨過天晴，我可以出門玩了。
examples.english_sentence: The exams are over; now it's like after the rain — things are finally looking up, and I can go out and have fun.

mandarin_meaning: 雨伞；雨篷（遮雨的物品或遮蓋）
english_meaning: umbrella; awning/canopy (rain cover)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，通常指雨傘，也可指商舖或建築外牆伸出的遮雨遮蓋（即雨篷）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term that usually means an umbrella; it can also refer to an awning/canopy attached to a building or shop used to shelter from rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門記得帶雨遮，聽日可能落大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai3 jyu5 ze1, ting1 jat6 ho2 nang4 lok6 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門记得带雨伞，明天可能会下大雨。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring an umbrella when you go out; it may rain heavily tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舖頭門口裝左個雨遮，遮住晒陽光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou3 tau4 mun4 hau2 zong1 zo2 go3 jyu5 ze1, ze1 zyu6 saai3 joeng4 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 店門口装了一个雨篷，挡住了阳光。
examples.english_sentence: The shop put up an awning at the entrance that blocks the sunlight.

mandarin_meaning: 雨靴（yǔxuē），防水靴，通常由橡膠或其他防水材料製成，用於雨天或潮濕環境。
english_meaning: rain boots; waterproof boots (e.g., rubber boots, wellingtons) worn to keep feet dry in wet conditions
explanation_mandarin: 一種防水的靴子，常用於下雨、涉水或泥濘的情況，以保護雙腳不被弄濕或弄髒。
explanation_english: A type of waterproof boot, typically made of rubber or similar materials, worn in rainy, muddy, or wet conditions to protect the feet from getting wet or dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街落雨，記得着雨靴啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 lok6 jyu5, gei3 dak1 zoek3 jyu5 hyut3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門下雨，記得穿雨靴。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining outside; remember to wear your rain boots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對雨靴好防水，行泥地都冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 jyu5 hyut3 hou2 fong4 seoi2, haang4 nai4 dei6 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双雨靴很防水，走泥地也没问题。
examples.english_sentence: These rain boots are very waterproof; walking in mud is no problem.

mandarin_meaning: 雨点 / 雨滴 (yǔdiǎn / yǔdī)
english_meaning: raindrop; raindrops
explanation_mandarin: 指从云层落下的水滴，也可泛指细小的雨量或零散微小的事物。
explanation_english: Refers to water droplets that fall from clouds; can also mean light raindrops or be used metaphorically for small, scattered bits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天開始落雨，雨點好細，唔使開遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hoi1 ci2 lok6 jyu5, jyu5 dim2 hou2 sai3, m4 sai2 hoi1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天开始下雨，雨点很小，不用打伞。
examples.english_sentence: It started to rain; the raindrops are very small, no need to open an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 窗外雨點打喺玻璃上，好有節奏感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng1 ngoi6 jyu5 dim2 daa2 hai2 bo1 lei4 soeng6, hou2 jau5 zit3 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 窗外的雨点打在玻璃上，很有节奏感。
examples.english_sentence: The raindrops outside the window hit the glass with a rhythmic sound.

mandarin_meaning: 雪 (xuě)
english_meaning: snow
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词；也可作动词（表示下雪）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used as verb in some constructions: to snow)
explanation_mandarin: 指大氣中從雲中降落的冰晶體或結晶聚合體，常用於表示降雪或雪景。
explanation_english: Refers to ice crystals or aggregated crystals that fall from clouds; commonly used to denote snowfall or snowy scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落雪喇，真靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 syut3 laa3, zan1 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下雪了，真漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: It's snowing today — it's really pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山頂覆滿咗雪，好靚景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 deng2 fuk1 mun5 zo2 syut3, hou2 leng3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山顶被雪覆盖了，很漂亮的景色。
examples.english_sentence: The mountaintop is covered in snow — a beautiful view.

mandarin_meaning: 在原本已經不好的情況上又使情況更糟（雪上添霜）
english_meaning: to make an already bad situation worse; to add insult to injury
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在原本已經不好的情況上，再加上新的禍害或麻煩，使情況更加惡化。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to worsen an already bad situation by adding further misfortune or trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱遲到，之後仲要俾罰款，真係雪上加霜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 ci4 dou3, zi1 hau6 zung6 jiu3 bei2 fat6 fun2, zan1 hai6 syut3 soeng6 gaa1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛遲到了，之後還要付罰款，真是雪上加霜。
examples.english_sentence: I was already late, and then I had to pay a fine — it really made things worse.

mandarin_meaning: 雪中送炭（在別人最需要幫助的時候給予援助）
english_meaning: To provide timely help in someone's hour of need; to offer assistance when it is most needed.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在別人最困難、最需要幫助的時候給予實際的援助。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to give practical help to someone when they are in the greatest need; to offer timely assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺我最困難嘅時候雪中送炭，幫我付咗房租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngo5 zeoi3 kwan3 naan6 ge3 si4 hau6 syut3 zung1 sung3 taan3, bong1 ngo5 fu6 zo2 fong4 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在我最困难的时候雪中送炭，帮我付了房租。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me in my time of need by paying my rent.

mandarin_meaning: 形容光亮或比喻眼睛、視力或判斷力非常敏銳、清楚（普通話讀作「雪亮」 xiěliàng）
english_meaning: very bright; sharp; clear; keen-sighted; obvious
explanation_mandarin: 既可指物件光亮，也常用作比喻，形容眼睛明亮有精神、觀察力或判斷力敏銳，或事情一目了然。
explanation_english: Literally 'snow-bright'; describes something very bright or, metaphorically, someone who is sharp-sighted or clear-sighted. Can also mean that something is obvious or plain to see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻眼好雪亮，乜嘢都睇得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 ngaan5 hou2 syut3 loeng6, mat1 je5 dou1 tai2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼睛很雪亮，什麼都看得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: His eyes are very sharp; he can see everything clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭腦好雪亮，辯論時回答得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 nou5 hou2 syut3 loeng6, bin6 leon6 si4 daap3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他頭腦很清晰，辯論時回答很犀利。
examples.english_sentence: He has a sharp mind and answers very incisively during debates.

mandarin_meaning: 雪人
english_meaning: snowman
explanation_mandarin: 由雪堆砌成的人形，通常有頭、身、手等部分並用胡蘿蔔、樹枝等作裝飾，常見於下雪的冬季活動或節日佈置。
explanation_english: A human-shaped figure made of snow, typically formed by stacking snowballs and decorated with items like a carrot for the nose or branches for arms; commonly associated with winter activities and holiday decorations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落大雪，我哋一齊整咗個雪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 daai6 syut3, ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zing2 zo2 go3 syut3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下大雪，我们一起堆了一个雪人。
examples.english_sentence: It snowed heavily; we built a snowman together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場出咗個巨型雪人裝飾，好多人嚟影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 ceot1 zo2 go3 geoi6 jing4 syut3 jan4 zong1 sik1, hou2 do1 jan4 lei4 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商场摆了一个巨型雪人装饰，很多人来拍照。
examples.english_sentence: The mall put up a giant snowman decoration; many people came to take photos.

mandarin_meaning: 手淫；打飛機（粗俗用語，指以手刺激男性生殖器）
english_meaning: Masturbate (male) — vulgar slang for manually stimulating the genitals
explanation_mandarin: 俗語/粗口俚語，用來指男性用手刺激生殖器以獲得性快感。屬於非正式且粗俗的表達，通常在熟人或粗俗語境中出現。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese slang term referring to a male masturbating by manually stimulating his genitals. Informal and coarse; typically used in familiar or crude contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺房間度自己雪卵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong4 gaan1 dou6 zi6 gei2 syut3 lyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房間裡自己手淫／打飛機。
examples.english_sentence: He's masturbating alone in his room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔想俾人見到，就唔好喺公共地方雪卵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 gin3 dou3, zau6 m4 hou2 hai2 gung1 gung6 dei6 fong1 syut3 lyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不想被人看到，就不要在公共場所手淫／打飛機。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to be seen, don't masturbate in public.

mandarin_meaning: 西裝和領帶；指穿著正式西裝打領帶（香港粵語借詞）
english_meaning: suit and tie; wearing a suit and necktie (formal attire, colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「雪呔」是香港粵語的口語用法，來自英語 suit（雪）和 tie（呔）的音譯，指西裝與領帶，常用以表示正式的著裝或需穿正式服裝的場合。
explanation_english: ‘雪呔’ is a colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese phrase, a loanblend from English 'suit' (雪) and 'tie' (呔). It refers to a suit and necktie — formal/business attire — or the act of dressing formally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日要去面試，我要著雪呔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 min6 si3, ngo5 jiu3 zoek3 syut3 taai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天要去面試，我要穿西裝打領帶。
examples.english_sentence: I have an interview today; I need to wear a suit and tie.

mandarin_meaning: 雪屐（古代用於雪地或冰雪環境的鞋子，類似雪鞋或防滑的木屐），現今少見
english_meaning: snow clogs; an archaic type of footwear for walking on snow (similar to snowshoes or cleated wooden clogs)
explanation_mandarin: 「雪屐」指的是古代或傳統用以在雪地上行走的鞋子，常具有防滑或增大接觸面的設計，現代常以「雪鞋」等詞替代，此詞較為罕用或出現在文獻、詩詞中。
explanation_english: “雪屐” refers to an old-fashioned type of footwear used for traveling on snow, often designed for grip or a larger surface area; nowadays it is rare and commonly referred to by terms like 'snowshoes'. The term appears mainly in historical texts or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時候，啲人落雪嘅時候會穿雪屐出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 hau6, di1 jan4 lok6 syut3 ge3 si4 hau6 wui5 cyun1 syut3 gei1 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时候，人们下雪时会穿雪屐出门。
examples.english_sentence: In olden times, people would wear snow clogs when going out in the snow.

mandarin_meaning: 雪山（xuěshān）：被雪覆盖的山，通常指海拔较高、终年或季节性积雪的山峰。
english_meaning: snow mountain; a mountain covered with snow, typically a high-altitude peak that is snow-capped
explanation_mandarin: 指被雪覆盖的山体，可以指季节性积雪的山峰，也可指常年积雪的高山。
explanation_english: Refers to a mountain covered in snow. Can denote mountains with seasonal snow or high peaks that remain snow-capped year-round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜去爬雪山，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 paa4 syut3 saan1, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个礼拜去爬雪山，好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go climb a snow mountain next week?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座雪山終年積雪，非常壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 syut3 saan1 zung1 nin4 zik1 syut3, fei1 soeng4 zong3 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座雪山终年积雪，非常壮观。
examples.english_sentence: That snow-capped mountain is snow-covered year-round and very spectacular.

mandarin_meaning: 雪崩；比喻性的突然崩潰或大規模快速下跌
english_meaning: avalanche; (figurative) a sudden collapse or large-scale rapid decline
explanation_mandarin: 指山坡或積雪突然大量滑落的自然現象，也常用作比喻，形容系統、股價或情勢迅速崩潰或連鎖反應。
explanation_english: Refers to the natural phenomenon of a large mass of snow rapidly sliding down a slope; also used figuratively to describe a rapid collapse or chain-reaction decline (e.g., prices, systems, events).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 登山嗰陣遇到雪崩，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 saan1 go2 zan6 jyu6 dou3 syut3 bang1, hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 登山的時候遇到雪崩，很危險。
examples.english_sentence: Encountering an avalanche while mountaineering is very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司股價發生雪崩式下跌，員工好慌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gu2 gaa3 faat3 saang1 syut3 bang1 sik1 haa6 dit3, jyun4 gung1 hou2 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司股價發生雪崩式下跌，員工很慌張。
examples.english_sentence: The company's stock price experienced an avalanche-like drop; employees are very panicked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個消息一出就引發雪崩效應，大家紛紛轉發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 jat1 ceot1 zau6 jan5 faat3 syut3 bang1 haau6 jing3, daai6 gaa1 fan1 fan1 zyun2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個消息一出就引發雪崩效應，大家紛紛轉發。
examples.english_sentence: Once the news came out it triggered an avalanche effect; everyone started sharing it.

mandarin_meaning: 雪帽（可指山顶覆盖的积雪，也可指保暖的帽子，如毛线帽）
english_meaning: snow cap / snow-covered summit; knitted winter hat (snow hat)
explanation_mandarin: “雪帽”可指山頂或物体頂端覆蓋的白色積雪（如山頂的雪帽），也可口語指在寒冷天氣戴的保暖帽子（如毛線帽）。
explanation_english: “雪帽” can mean a snow cap — the layer of snow covering a mountain peak — or, colloquially, a winter hat/knitted beanie worn for warmth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣好凍，出街記得戴個雪帽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 hou2 dung3, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 go3 syut3 mou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气很冷，出门记得戴上你的雪帽。
examples.english_sentence: It's very cold; remember to wear your snow hat when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 高山頂有一層雪帽，望落好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gou1 saan1 ding2 jau5 jat1 cang4 syut3 mou2, mong6 lok6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 高山顶上覆盖着一层雪帽，看起来很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The mountain peak is capped with snow — it looks beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 雪耻（洗刷耻辱、挽回颜面）
english_meaning: to redeem one's honor; to wipe away humiliation; to avenge a disgrace
explanation_mandarin: 指洗刷或挽回因失敗或侮辱而受到的恥辱，為自己或集體討回顏面，常用作動詞。
explanation_english: To erase or avenge humiliation by restoring one's honor or reputation; commonly used as a verb indicating an action to regain face or dignity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場比賽贏咗，總算可以雪恥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 jing4 zo2, zung2 syun3 ho2 ji5 syut3 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛赢了，总算可以雪耻。
examples.english_sentence: We won this match, so we can finally redeem our honor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想借今次機會雪恥，所以加倍努力練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ze3 gam1 ci3 gei1 wui6 syut3 ci2, so2 ji5 gaa1 bui3 nou5 lik6 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想借这次机会雪耻，所以加倍努力练习。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to use this opportunity to redeem his honor, so he practiced twice as hard.

mandarin_meaning: 冷庫；冰窖；冷藏室
english_meaning: cold room; icehouse; walk-in freezer; cold storage
explanation_mandarin: 指用來存放冰塊或需要低溫保存的食物、海鮮等的房間或倉庫，類似冷庫、冰庫或冷藏室。
explanation_english: A room or storage space used to keep ice or perishable goods at low temperatures—essentially a cold storage, icehouse, or walk-in freezer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲海鮮擺喺雪房入面保持新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hoi2 sin1 baai2 hai2 syut3 fong4 jap6 min6 bou2 ci4 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海鮮放在冷庫裡保持新鮮。
examples.english_sentence: The seafood is kept in the cold room to stay fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 粤语粗口，侮辱性称呼，常指被认为淫乱或放荡的女性（相当于“荡妇/婊子/贱人”）
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese insult directed at a woman, implying she is promiscuous or morally loose (roughly 'slut'/'bitch'/'whore')
explanation_mandarin: 俗語、粗口用詞，多為貶義，常用來辱罵女性的性行為或人格，帶有強烈冒犯性。
explanation_english: A coarse Cantonese slang term used as an insulting label for women, implying promiscuity or loose morals. Highly offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同啲男仔搞到咁，啲人就話佢係雪批。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tung4 di1 naam4 zai2 gaau2 dou3 gam2, di1 jan4 zau6 waa6 keoi5 hai6 syut3 pei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她總是和男生搞得很亂，大家就說她是“雪批”（粵語粗口，侮辱女性，意為蕩婦/賤人）。
examples.english_sentence: She's always hooking up with the guys; people call her a 'syut pei' (a Cantonese vulgar insult meaning a promiscuous woman).

mandarin_meaning: 雪景（被雪覆盖的景色；下雪时的风景）
english_meaning: snow scene; snowy scenery; landscape covered in snow
explanation_mandarin: 指被雪覆盖的景色，或下雪时看到的自然风景，常用来形容雪后或下雪时的美丽景致。
explanation_english: Refers to scenery covered with snow or the view during/after snowfall; commonly used to describe the beautiful appearance of landscapes in snow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝落大雪，啲雪景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 lok6 daai6 syut3, di1 syut3 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下大雪，雪景很美。
examples.english_sentence: It snowed heavily this morning; the snowy scenery is beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去山上睇雪景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 saan1 soeng6 tai2 syut3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去山上看雪景。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go up the mountain to see the snowy scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲雪景相好有氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 syut3 ging2 soeng2 hou2 jau5 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些雪景照片很有氛圍。
examples.english_sentence: Those photos of the snowy scenery are very atmospheric.

mandarin_meaning: 被放鴿子、被爽約（俚語）
english_meaning: to be stood up / to be ghosted (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語口語/俚語，常用來形容約會或約定被對方放鴿子、爽約或無故不出現。
explanation_english: Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe being stood up or ghosted—when someone fails to show up for an appointment or cancels without notice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我約佢食飯，結果俾雪格，等咗成個鐘都無人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 joek3 keoi5 sik6 faan6, git3 gwo2 bei2 syut3 gaak3, dang2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 dou1 mou5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我約他吃飯，結果被放了鴿子，等了整整一個小時也沒人來。
examples.english_sentence: I arranged to eat with him, but I got stood up; I waited a whole hour and nobody showed.

mandarin_meaning: 冰棍 / 冰棒 / 雪糕棒
english_meaning: popsicle; ice lolly; ice pop
explanation_mandarin: 指用木棍或塑膠棒固定、冷凍成形的甜味或水果味冷食（俗稱冰棍或冰棒），在香港常用的稱呼。
explanation_english: A frozen sweet treat on a stick (commonly called a popsicle or ice lolly); the Hong Kong Cantonese term for an ice pop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天食雪條最舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 sik6 syut3 tiu4 zeoi3 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天吃雪糕（冰棍）最舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Eating a popsicle in summer is the most refreshing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽買咗幾支雪條畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 maai5 zo2 gei2 zi1 syut3 tiu4 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽買了幾根冰棍給我。
examples.english_sentence: My mom bought me a few popsicles.

mandarin_meaning: 雪梨（白梨、水梨的一種）
english_meaning: snow pear; Chinese white pear
explanation_mandarin: 一種常見的梨，果肉偏白、汁多、口感清脆或軟綿，常用作食用或入菜、入藥（潤肺止咳）。
explanation_english: A type of pear (snow pear or Chinese white pear) with light-colored flesh, juicy and crisp or tender. Commonly eaten, used in cooking, and sometimes in traditional remedies (e.g., for coughs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲雪梨返嚟，等陣切黎食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 syut3 lei4 faan1 lai4, dang2 zan6 cit3 lei4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一些雪梨回來，等一下切來吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some snow pears and brought them back; I'll cut them up to eat in a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個雪梨好甜，好適合現成食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 syut3 lei4 hou2 tim4, hou2 sik1 hap6 jin6 sing4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個雪梨很甜，很適合直接食用。
examples.english_sentence: This snow pear is very sweet and perfect to eat fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 雪橇 (xuěqiāo) — 用於在雪地上滑行的工具
english_meaning: sled; sledge — a vehicle or device for sliding over snow
explanation_mandarin: 指一種在雪地上滑行的器具，通常由木頭、金屬或塑膠製成，用於娛樂或短程運送人或物。
explanation_english: A device used to slide over snow, often made of wood, metal, or plastic, used for recreation or short-distance transport on snowy surfaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今個冬天去雪山玩雪橇，真係好好玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 dung1 tin1 heoi3 syut3 saan1 waan2 syut3 kiu4, zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們這個冬天去雪山玩雪橇，真是很好玩。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the snowy mountains this winter to go sledding; it's really fun.

mandarin_meaning: 冰箱 / 冰柜
english_meaning: refrigerator; fridge
explanation_mandarin: 粵語常用詞，指用來冷藏食物或飲品的家用電器，字面上可理解為「雪（冷）櫃（櫃子）」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term for the household appliance used to keep food and drinks cold; literally "snow cabinet."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲牛奶放喺雪櫃度啦，會壞嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ngau4 naai5 fong3 hai2 syut3 gwai6 dou6 laa1, wui5 waai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牛奶放在冰箱裡吧，會壞的。
examples.english_sentence: Put the milk in the fridge; it will go bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企部雪櫃壞咗，要買部新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 bou6 syut3 gwai6 waai6 zo2, jiu3 maai5 bou6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們家的冰箱壞了，要買一台新的。
examples.english_sentence: Our fridge at home is broken; we need to buy a new one.

mandarin_meaning: 回扣 / 賄賂（私下收取的錢）
english_meaning: under-the-table payment; kickback; bribe (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 「雪水」在香港粵語中作俚語使用，指私下收取的酬金、回扣或賄賂，通常為非法或不公開的利益。字面上亦可指融化的雪所形成的水（雪水）。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "雪水" is slang for illicit or under-the-table payments such as kickbacks, commissions, or bribes. Literally it can also mean meltwater from snow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人話有啲官員收雪水，依家警方調查緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 waa6 jau5 di1 gun1 jyun4 sau1 syut3 seoi2, ji1 gaa1 ging2 fong1 diu6 caa4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說有些官員收受雪水，現在警方正在調查。
examples.english_sentence: People say some officials took "xueshui" (bribes); the police are investigating now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山頂啲雪化咗，變做雪水流落山腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 ding2 di1 syut3 faa3 zo2, bin3 zou6 syut3 seoi2 lau4 lok6 saan1 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山頂的雪化了，變成雪水流到山腳。
examples.english_sentence: The snow on the mountaintop melted into meltwater and flowed down to the foothills.

mandarin_meaning: 放鴿子；爽約；失約
english_meaning: to stand someone up; to bail on plans; to ghost someone
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，表示答應了見面或約定但沒有出現、爽約或突然失聯（放鴿子）。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang meaning to fail to show up for an appointment or to bail on arrangements — i.e., to stand someone up or ghost someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚七點見，佢又雪油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 cat1 dim2 gin3, keoi5 jau6 syut3 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚七点见，他又放我鸽子了。
examples.english_sentence: We were meeting at 7 tonight; he stood me up again.

mandarin_meaning: （罕見/口語）雪或冰的小顆粒；有時亦用於形容冷飲裡像冰粒的小配料
english_meaning: (rare/colloquial) small pellets of snow or ice; occasionally used to describe small ice-like toppings in cold drinks
explanation_mandarin: 「雪珠」並非標準或常用詞，字面上可理解為「雪的顆粒」。在口語或地方用法中，可能用來形容細小的雪粒、冰粒或冷飲裡像冰珠的小配料。用法較少見，視語境可理解為自然現象或食物配料。
explanation_english: "雪珠" is not a common standard term. Literally "snow beads", it can refer to tiny pellets of snow or ice. In colloquial/local usage it may also describe small ice-like toppings in cold drinks. Usage is relatively rare and context-dependent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁凍，落緊細細粒嘅雪珠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam2 dung3, lok6 gan2 sai3 sai3 lap1 ge3 syut3 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气这么冷，正在下细小的雪珠。
examples.english_sentence: It's so cold; small snow beads are falling.

mandarin_meaning: 雪球（字面：由雪捏成的球）；比喻事物越滚越大、呈指数式增长（如“雪球效应”）
english_meaning: snowball (literal: a ball of snow); figurative: something that grows larger and larger or accelerates as it accumulates (snowball effect)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 动词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: “雪球”原指用雪捏成的球。引申义常用来形容某事物随着积累越来越大或越滚越猛（如“雪球效应”），也可作动词“滚雪球”。
explanation_english: Literally a ball made of snow. Figuratively used to describe a process that grows increasingly large or accelerates as it accumulates (the 'snowball effect'). Can also be used as a verb meaning 'to snowball' or 'to grow progressively'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友喺雪地堆咗個好大嘅雪球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 syut3 dei6 deoi1 zo2 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 syut3 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友在雪地堆了一个很大的雪球。
examples.english_sentence: The kids made a very big snowball in the snow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅投資靠複利，資產好似雪球咁愈滾愈大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tau4 zi1 kaau3 fuk6 lei6, zi1 caan2 hou2 ci5 syut3 kau4 gam2 jyu6 gwan2 jyu6 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的投资靠复利，资产像雪球一样越滚越大。
examples.english_sentence: His investments rely on compound interest; his assets snowball like a snowball, growing larger and larger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔及早處理，呢個問題會出現雪球效應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gap6 zou2 cyu2 lei5, ni1 go3 man6 tai4 wui5 ceot1 jin6 syut3 kau4 haau6 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不及早处理，这个问题会出现雪球效应。
examples.english_sentence: If not dealt with early, this problem will produce a snowball effect.

mandarin_meaning: 雪白；潔白，如雪般白皙（也可比喻純潔無瑕）
english_meaning: snow-white; pure white; (figuratively) pure or spotless
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容顏色像雪一樣潔白，也可引申指純潔、無汙點。
explanation_english: Describes a color as being as white as snow; can also be used figuratively to mean pure or without blemish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲牙齒好雪白，笑起上嚟好吸引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ngaa4 ci2 hou2 syut3 baak6, siu3 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 kap1 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的牙齒很雪白，笑起來很吸引。
examples.english_sentence: His/Her teeth are very snow-white; the smile is very attractive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚落咗場雪，山頭即刻變得雪白一片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok6 maan5 lok6 zo2 coeng4 syut3, saan1 tau4 zik1 hak1 bin3 dak1 syut3 baak6 jat1 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚下了一場雪，山頭立刻變得一片雪白。
examples.english_sentence: It snowed last night, and the mountaintops immediately turned snow-white.

mandarin_meaning: 雪碧（汽水品牌，檸檬青檸味碳酸飲料）
english_meaning: Sprite (lemon-lime flavored carbonated soft drink)
explanation_mandarin: 雪碧是可口可樂公司生產的一種檸檬青檸味碳酸軟飲料。口語中可用來指該品牌飲品，或泛指類似風味的汽水。
explanation_english: Sprite is a lemon-lime flavored carbonated soft drink produced by The Coca-Cola Company. In everyday speech it can refer to the brand or to similar lemon-lime sodas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好熱，買咗罐雪碧飲先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6, maai5 zo2 gun3 syut3 bik1 jam2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很热，先买了一罐雪碧喝。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really hot today; I bought a can of Sprite to drink first.

mandarin_meaning: 可卡因；白色粉狀毒品（俚語）
english_meaning: Cocaine; white powdered illicit drug (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「雪種」是香港粵語的俚語，通常用來指稱可卡因或其他白色粉末狀的非法毒品。屬於非正式用語，常見於口語或黑話中。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term typically used to refer to cocaine or other white powdered illicit drugs. It is informal language often found in colloquial speech or underworld slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽講未？阿強畀警察捉到有雪種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teng1 gong2 mei6? aa3 koeng4 bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 dou3 jau5 syut3 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你听说了吗？阿强被警察抓到带有雪种。
examples.english_sentence: Did you hear? Ah Keung was caught by the police with cocaine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢試過吸雪種，話成個人好精神，但之後好難訓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 gwo3 kap1 syut3 zung2, waa6 sing4 go3 jan4 hou2 zing1 san4, daan6 zi1 hau6 hou2 naan4 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他试过吸食雪种，说整个人很有精神，但之后很难入睡。
examples.english_sentence: He tried using cocaine; he said he felt very energized but later had trouble sleeping.

mandarin_meaning: 冰淇淋
english_meaning: ice cream
explanation_mandarin: 指用牛奶、奶油、糖等冷冻制成的甜点，通常作为冷食，可做成雪糕筒、杯装或雪條等不同形式。
explanation_english: A sweet frozen dessert made from milk, cream, sugar, etc., typically served cold; it can come in cones, cups, or as popsicles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食雪糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 syut3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃冰淇淋。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat ice cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天食雪糕最舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 sik6 syut3 gou1 zeoi3 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天吃冰淇淋最舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Eating ice cream in summer feels the best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友最鍾意雪糕筒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 syut3 gou1 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子最喜欢雪糕筒。
examples.english_sentence: Children like ice cream cones the most.

mandarin_meaning: 雪糕三明治 / 冰淇淋三明治
english_meaning: ice cream sandwich
explanation_mandarin: 一種把雪糕夾在兩片吐司、餅乾或威化之間的點心或小吃。在香港常見的街頭或老店小食，常以手工或傳統方式製作。
explanation_english: A dessert/snack consisting of ice cream sandwiched between two slices of bread, cookies, or wafers. Commonly found as a street or shop snack in Hong Kong, often made in a traditional or handmade style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個最鍾意食雪糕三文治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 syut3 gou1 saam1 man4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候最喜欢吃雪糕三明治。
examples.english_sentence: I loved eating ice cream sandwiches when I was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間老字號店賣緊傳統手製嘅雪糕三文治，好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 lou5 zi6 hou6 dim3 maai6 gan2 cyun4 tung2 sau2 zai3 ge3 syut3 gou1 saam1 man4 zi6, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间老字号店在卖传统手工制作的雪糕三明治，很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: This longstanding shop is selling traditional handmade ice cream sandwiches and many people are queuing.

mandarin_meaning: 小雪糕；雪糕棒（冰淇淋的一種）
english_meaning: small ice cream; popsicle/ice-lolly
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，通常指小支的雪糕或雪條（如雪糕棒），常在香港用來稱呼給小朋友吃的冰品。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a small ice cream or popsicle (often the single-stick type); commonly used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天我成日買雪糕仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ngo5 sing4 jat6 maai5 syut3 gou1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天我经常买雪糕吃。
examples.english_sentence: I often buy popsicles in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 賣雪糕的人；推雪糕車的小販
english_meaning: ice cream vendor; ice cream man (street seller who pushes an ice cream cart)
explanation_mandarin: 口語/廣東話用法，通常指在街上推雪糕車或售賣雪糕、雪條的小販或攤販。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term referring to a person who sells ice cream (often pushing an ice cream cart) on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天嗰陣，公園度有個雪糕佬推住車，成日有小朋友圍埋去買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 go2 zan6, gung1 jyun4 dou6 jau5 go3 syut3 gou1 lou2 teoi1 zyu6 ce1, sing4 jat6 jau5 siu2 pang4 jau5 wai4 maai4 heoi3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天的時候，公園裡有位賣雪糕的人推著車子，常常有小朋友圍著他去買。
examples.english_sentence: In summer, there's an ice cream vendor pushing his cart in the park; kids often gather around to buy from him.

mandarin_meaning: 冰淇淋筒 / 雪糕筒
english_meaning: ice cream cone
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指裝在脆筒或圓筒裡的雪糕（即冰淇淋筒）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for an ice cream cone — ice cream served in a wafer cone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買一個雪糕批，朱古力味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 go3 syut3 gou1 pai1, zyu1 gu2 lik6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一个雪糕筒，巧克力味。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy an ice cream cone, chocolate flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天食雪糕批最啱啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 sik6 syut3 gou1 pai1 zeoi3 ngaam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天吃雪糕筒最合適了。
examples.english_sentence: Eating ice cream cones is best in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 冰淇淋月饼
english_meaning: ice cream mooncake; a mooncake made with or filled with ice cream, served frozen
explanation_mandarin: 一种在中秋节期间流行的冷冻月饼，内馅或以冰淇淋为主，需冷藏食用，适合气候较热地区作为应节的清凉甜点。
explanation_english: A frozen version of the traditional mooncake, typically filled with ice cream or made as an ice-cream sandwich. Popular as a cool seasonal treat during the Mid-Autumn Festival in warmer regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中秋節嗰陣，啲舖頭會賣雪糕月餅，好多人都買嚟試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 cau1 zit3 go2 zan6, di1 pou3 tau2 wui5 maai6 syut3 gou1 jyut6 beng2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 maai5 lai4 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中秋节的时候，店里会卖冰淇淋月饼，很多人都会买来尝试。
examples.english_sentence: During Mid-Autumn Festival, shops sell ice cream mooncakes; many people buy them to try.

mandarin_meaning: 冰淇淋筒 / 冰淇淋蛋筒
english_meaning: ice cream cone (wafer cone)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛放冰淇淋的脆皮筒（通常是蛋卷形的餅乾筒）。
explanation_english: A crispy wafer (often cone-shaped) used to hold ice cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買個雪糕筒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 go3 syut3 gou1 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一个雪糕筒。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy an ice cream cone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意食乜口味嘅雪糕筒？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 sik6 mat1 hau2 mei6 ge3 syut3 gou1 tung2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢吃什么口味的雪糕筒？
examples.english_sentence: Which flavor of ice cream cone do you like?

mandarin_meaning: 雪纺（xuěfǎng）：一种轻薄、半透明的织物，常用于制作礼服、衬衫、裙子等。
english_meaning: chiffon: a lightweight, sheer fabric often used for dresses, blouses, and skirts.
explanation_mandarin: 雪紡是一種纖維製織物，手感輕柔、垂感好且通常半透明，常見於服裝和飾品材質。
explanation_english: Chiffon is a fabric made from natural or synthetic fibers; it is lightweight, soft, has good drape and is often semi-transparent, commonly used in garments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條裙係雪紡做嘅，好輕盈同飄逸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 hai6 syut3 fong2 zou6 ge3, hou2 hing1 jing4 tung4 piu1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子是用雪纺做的，很轻盈、飘逸。
examples.english_sentence: This skirt is made of chiffon; it's very light and flowing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天著雪紡衫會比較涼快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 zoek3 syut3 fong2 saam1 wui5 bei2 gaau3 loeng4 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天穿雪纺衫会比较凉快。
examples.english_sentence: Wearing chiffon shirts in summer is relatively cool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雪紡衣料要用冷水手洗，唔好用機洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syut3 fong2 ji1 liu6 jiu3 jung6 laang5 seoi2 sau2 sai2, m4 hou2 jung6 gei1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雪纺衣料要用冷水手洗，不要用机洗。
examples.english_sentence: Chiffon garments should be hand-washed in cold water; don't machine-wash.

mandarin_meaning: 银耳（也稱雪耳或白木耳），一種可食用兼具藥用價值的菌類，常用於煲湯或甜品。
english_meaning: Snow fungus (also called white fungus or silver ear fungus), an edible and medicinal fungus (Tremella fuciformis) commonly used in soups and desserts.
explanation_mandarin: 雪耳是一種白色膠質的食用菌，口感滑嫩，常見於中式糖水或滋補湯品中，亦有滋陰潤肺的藥用說法。
explanation_english: Snow fungus is a white, gelatinous edible fungus with a slippery texture, commonly found in Chinese sweet soups and nourishing broths; traditionally regarded as having moistening and health-promoting properties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽咪今晚煲咗雪耳蓮子糖水，好滋潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa1 mi4 gam1 maan5 bou1 zo2 syut3 ji5 lin4 zi2 tong4 seoi2, hou2 zi1 jeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽今晚煲了雪耳蓮子糖水，很滋潤。
examples.english_sentence: Mom made snow-fungus and lotus-seed sweet soup tonight; it's very nourishing.

mandarin_meaning: 雪恥 / 雪耻 (xiěchǐ)：洗刷、挽回羞辱，恢復名譽或尊嚴
english_meaning: to wipe out or avenge humiliation; to restore one's honor or redeem one's reputation
explanation_mandarin: 表示通过行动或胜利洗刷过去的耻辱、恢复名誉或尊严。常用于体育比赛、竞争场合或受到侮辱后想挽回面子的情形。
explanation_english: Expresses restoring honor or erasing past humiliation through actions or a victory. Commonly used in contexts like sports, competitions, or when someone seeks to redeem their reputation after a loss or insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想幫香港隊雪耻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 bong1 hoeng1 gong2 deoi6 syut3 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想帮香港队雪耻。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to help the Hong Kong team avenge/erase their humiliation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次輸咗畀對手，今次要落場打足全場，徹底雪耻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 syu1 zo2 bei2 deoi3 sau2, gam1 ci3 jiu3 lok6 coeng4 daa2 zuk1 cyun4 coeng4, cit3 dai2 syut3 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次输给对手，这次要上场好好表现，彻底雪耻。
examples.english_sentence: They lost to the opponent last time; this time they must perform well and completely wipe out the shame.

mandarin_meaning: 雪花 (xuěhuā)
english_meaning: snowflake; snow
explanation_mandarin: 指從天空飄落的雪的結晶（雪花），也可泛指雪。
explanation_english: Refers to the crystalline flakes of snow that fall from the sky (snowflakes); can also be used more generally to refer to snow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚會落雪，出面已經開始有雪花飄落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 wui5 lok6 syut3, ceot1 min6 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 jau5 syut3 faa1 piu1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚會下雪，外面已經開始飄著雪花。
examples.english_sentence: It's going to snow tonight; there are already snowflakes falling outside.

mandarin_meaning: 雪花膏
english_meaning: Snow Flower Cream (a traditional moisturizing/cold cream popular in Hong Kong and China)
explanation_mandarin: 一种传统的膏状护肤品，外观通常为白色或乳白色，质地较稠，用于保湿、护手或护脸。过去在香港和华南地区非常常见，具有一定的怀旧文化意义，也常以配方或品牌名的形式出现。
explanation_english: A traditional ointment-like skincare product (often white or off-white) used for moisturizing hands and face. It was widely used in Hong Kong and southern China and carries nostalgic cultural associations; it can refer to specific brands or the general product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，媽媽成日叫我搽雪花膏保濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, maa4 maa1 sing4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 caat3 syut3 faa1 gou1 bou2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，妈妈经常叫我擦雪花膏保湿。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mom often told me to apply Snow Flower Cream to moisturize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雪花膏嘅香味好有香港懷舊感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syut3 faa1 gou1 ge3 hoeng1 mei6 hou2 jau5 hoeng1 gong2 waai4 gau6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雪花膏的香味很有香港怀旧感。
examples.english_sentence: The scent of Snow Flower Cream feels very nostalgic of Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 雪茄 (xuějiā)
english_meaning: cigar
explanation_mandarin: 一種由煙葉捲成、用來吸食（抽）的煙草製品，通常比香菸大、燃燒時間較長，常在社交或慶祝場合看到。
explanation_english: A tobacco product made by rolling processed tobacco leaves into a cylinder and smoked; larger than cigarettes and burns longer, often used in social or celebratory contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚喺樓頂抽緊支雪茄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 hai6 lau4 ding2 cau1 gan2 zi1 syut3 gaa1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚在楼顶抽着一根雪茄。
examples.english_sentence: He's smoking a cigar on the rooftop tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 雪茄的屁股；比喻快用完、沒價值或被視為可丟棄、沒用的剩餘物或人
english_meaning: cigar butt (literally); figuratively, something nearly used up or worthless, or a person/things treated as a disposable leftover
explanation_mandarin: 字面指雪茄的末端（抽剩的部分）。在廣東話俗語中，常用來形容物品或人已經沒用了、價值很低或被當作可丟棄的剩餘。
explanation_english: Literally the stub of a cigar. In Cantonese slang it describes something nearly used up or worthless, or a person/thing treated as disposable or insignificant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部舊電話已經係雪茄屁股，冇人想用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 ji5 ging1 hai6 syut3 gaa1 pei3 gu2, mou5 jan4 soeng2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部舊電話已經是雪茄屁股，沒有人想用它。
examples.english_sentence: That old phone is already a 'cigar butt' — nobody wants to use it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔好成日當員工係雪茄屁股，要尊重啲人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 dong3 jyun4 gung1 hai6 syut3 gaa1 pei3 gu2, jiu3 zyun1 zung6 di1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不要總是把員工當成雪茄屁股，要尊重他們。
examples.english_sentence: The company shouldn't always treat employees like 'cigar butts'; they should respect them.

mandarin_meaning: 雪菜（醃製的芥菜或芥菜類蔬菜）
english_meaning: pickled mustard greens; preserved vegetables (used as a condiment/ingredient)
explanation_mandarin: 指經過醃製的芥菜或類似的葉菜，常作配料或調味使用，味道帶鹹、微酸，用於湯、麵或炒菜中以增加風味。
explanation_english: Refers to mustard greens (or similar leafy vegetables) that have been pickled/preserved. Commonly used as an ingredient or condiment in Chinese cooking, with a salty and slightly sour flavor, added to soups, noodles, or stir-fries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽通常喺湯度落少少雪菜，湯會更香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 tung1 soeng4 hai2 tong1 dou6 lok6 siu2 siu2 syut3 coi3, tong1 wui5 gang3 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈通常在汤里放一点雪菜，汤会更香。
examples.english_sentence: My mom usually adds a bit of pickled mustard greens to the soup; it makes it more fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市有雪菜賣，可以買嚟加喺麵或者炒飯入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 jau5 syut3 coi3 maai6, ho2 ji5 maai5 lei4 gaa1 hai2 min6 waak6 ze2 caau2 faan6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜市场有雪菜卖，可以买来加在面里或炒饭里。
examples.english_sentence: The market sells pickled mustard greens; you can buy some to put in noodles or fried rice.

mandarin_meaning: 雪葩（雪酪／sorbet）
english_meaning: sorbet (a frozen fruit-based dessert)
explanation_mandarin: 一种用水果汁或果泥加糖冷冻并搅拌成的清爽冰品，常作为饭后或解腻的甜点。
explanation_english: A frozen dessert made from fruit juice or purée and sugar, churned to a smooth, icy texture; commonly served as a light, refreshing dessert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 餐廳嘅柚子雪葩好好味，食落好清新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan1 teng1 ge3 jau4 zi2 syut3 paa1 hou2 hou2 mei6, sik6 lok6 hou2 cing1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐厅的柚子雪葩很好吃，吃起来很清爽。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant's pomelo sorbet is really tasty; it tastes very refreshing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天食雪葩剛剛好，唔會太膩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 sik6 syut3 paa1 gong1 gong1 hou2, m4 wui5 taai3 nei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天吃雪葩正好，不会太腻。
examples.english_sentence: Eating sorbet in summer is perfect; it's not too heavy.

mandarin_meaning: 把（計劃、作品、人物等）暫時擱置或封存；也可指冷藏、藏匿
english_meaning: to shelve/put on ice; to bench; to keep in cold storage; to suppress or hide something
explanation_mandarin: 「雪藏」常用來表示把某個計劃、作品或人暫時停擱、不公開或封存。也可字面指放入冷藏。不同語境下可指公司擱置計劃，或藝人被公司冷處理（被雪藏）。
explanation_english: Commonly used to mean shelving or putting a project, work, or person into cold storage — temporarily halting, suppressing, or hiding it. Literally can mean to place in cold storage. In context it may refer to a company shelving a plan or 'benching' an artist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定將呢個計劃雪藏，暫時唔會執行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 syut3 cong4, zaam6 si4 m4 wui5 zap1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司決定把這個計劃雪藏，暫時不會執行。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to shelve this project and won't carry it out for the time being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位歌手話佢啲歌被公司雪藏咗，遲遲唔出碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 go1 sau2 waa6 keoi5 di1 go1 bei6 gung1 si1 syut3 cong4 zo2, ci4 ci4 m4 ceot1 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位歌手說他的歌被公司雪藏了，遲遲不發行唱片。
examples.english_sentence: The singer said his songs were shelved by the company and the album still hasn't been released.

mandarin_meaning: 被雪藏的藝人/品牌/項目（被公司暫時停推或擱置）
english_meaning: a shelved act/brand/project — someone or something a company has put on ice (withheld from promotion or use)
explanation_mandarin: 「雪藏牌」是香港粵語口語用法，指藝人、商品或計劃被公司或機構暫時撤下、停止推廣或擱置，不再公開活動或推廣。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "雪藏牌" refers to an artist, product, or project that a company has "put on ice" — removed from promotion or active use and effectively shelved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間唱片公司將佢當成雪藏牌，冇再推佢上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 coeng3 pin3 gung1 si1 zoeng1 keoi5 dong3 sing4 syut3 cong4 paai4, mou5 zoi3 teoi1 keoi5 soeng5 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家唱片公司把他當作雪藏牌，不再力推他出位。
examples.english_sentence: The record company treated him as a shelved act and stopped promoting him.

mandarin_meaning: 雪蛤（xuěhá）：俗稱雪蛤膏或哈士蟆油，是由某些蛙類的脂肪或生殖腺組織製成的滋補食材，常用於中式甜品或燉品。
english_meaning: Hasma (snow frog fatty tissue): the dried fatty or glandular tissue from certain frogs, used as a nourishing ingredient in Chinese desserts and tonic soups.
explanation_mandarin: 雪蛤是來自部分蛙類的脂肪/生殖腺組織，經乾製或加工後用作食材。傳統上常被認為有滋陰潤肺、養顏的功效，常加入甜湯或燉品中食用。
explanation_english: Hasma is the processed fatty or glandular tissue from certain frogs, used as an ingredient in Chinese cuisine. It is traditionally believed to nourish yin, moisten the lungs, and benefit the skin, and is commonly added to sweet soups or tonic dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意食雪蛤，話有益皮膚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 sik6 syut3 haa4, waa6 jau5 jik1 pei4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她喜欢吃雪蛤，说对皮肤有好处。
examples.english_sentence: She likes eating hasma and says it's good for the skin.

mandarin_meaning: 雪蛤膏（xuě há gāo）：以雪蛤（俗稱蛤蟆脂或雪蛤油）為主要原料製成的膏狀或甜品，常作滋補、美容的中式補品。
english_meaning: Hasma paste/cream: a dessert or tonic made from hasma (the fatty tissue of certain frogs/toads), consumed in Chinese cuisine as a nourishing and beauty-promoting food.
explanation_mandarin: 雪蛤膏是用雪蛤等材料煮成的膏狀或甜品，常見於廣東、香港等地，作為滋補、養顏或潤肺的食療食品。
explanation_english: A gelatinous paste or dessert made from hasma, commonly eaten in Guangdong and Hong Kong as a nourishing food believed to improve skin complexion and support respiratory health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食碗雪蛤膏，聽講可以補身同靚樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 wun2 syut3 haap6 gou1, teng1 gong2 ho2 ji5 bou2 san1 tung4 leng3 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃碗雪蛤膏，听说可以补身体又美容。
examples.english_sentence: I want a bowl of hasma paste tonight; I heard it's nourishing and good for the skin.

mandarin_meaning: 羽绒服 / 厚外套（粤语称法）
english_meaning: winter coat; down jacket; heavy coat
explanation_mandarin: 「雪褸」是廣東話常用詞，指厚重的外套或羽絨服，通常在寒冷天氣穿用，香港日常用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term for a heavy coat or down jacket worn in cold weather. Commonly used in Hong Kong to refer to winter coats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚好凍，記得著返你件雪褸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hou2 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 faan1 nei5 gin6 syut3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚很冷，记得穿上你的羽绒服（大衣）。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold tonight; remember to put on your winter coat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗件新雪褸，好暖呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 san1 syut3 lou2, hou2 nyun5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了件新的羽绒服，很暖和。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new winter coat; it's very warm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出面落緊雨又凍，要唔要我借你件雪褸？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 min6 lok6 gan2 jyu5 jau6 dung3, jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 ze3 nei5 gin6 syut3 lou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外面正在下雨又冷，要不要我借你我的羽绒服（大衣）？
examples.english_sentence: It's raining and cold outside—do you want me to lend you my coat?

mandarin_meaning: 雪豹
english_meaning: snow leopard
explanation_mandarin: 一种大型猫科动物，主要分布在中亚、喜马拉雅及高山地区，毛色灰白带斑，尾巴粗长以保持平衡。也常被用作部队、隊伍或品牌的名稱。
explanation_english: A large wild cat native to mountain ranges of Central and South Asia, characterized by thick pale fur with dark rosettes and a long bushy tail for balance. The term is also used as a name for military/police units and some brands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山上嘅雪豹好難見到，佢哋好少會落嚟附近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 soeng6 ge3 syut3 baau3 hou2 naan4 gin3 dou3, keoi5 dei6 hou2 siu2 wui5 lok6 lai4 fan6 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山上的雪豹很難看見，它們很少會下來附近。
examples.english_sentence: Snow leopards in the mountains are hard to spot; they rarely come down nearby.

mandarin_meaning: 指一種在寒冷山區或極地生活、冬季羽毛會轉白以便伪裝的山雞類鳥（如雷鳥、白山雞）
english_meaning: Ptarmigan — a grouse-like bird found in cold, mountainous or Arctic regions that molts to white plumage in winter for camouflage
explanation_mandarin: 雪雞是指數種生活在高山或北方寒冷地帶的山雞類鳥，冬季羽色轉為白色以便在雪中隱蔽。中文中亦可用作動物名稱直接稱呼該鳥類。
explanation_english: Refers to several species of grouse-like birds (ptarmigans) that inhabit cold, mountainous or Arctic areas and turn white in winter to blend into snowy environments. Used as the common name for these birds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日喺山頭見到幾隻雪雞，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai2 saan1 tau4 gin3 dou2 gei2 zek3 syut3 gai1, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天在山頂看到幾隻雪雞，很開心。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a few ptarmigans on the mountaintop today; I was very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 模仿輕脆或沙沙聲的擬聲詞（類似“沙沙聲”或“咔嚓咔嚓聲”）
english_meaning: An onomatopoeic expression imitating a light crisp/crunching or rustling sound (similar to 'saa-saa' or 'crackle').
explanation_mandarin: 「雪雪聲」是粵語口語裡的擬聲詞，用來形容輕微、脆響或沙沙的聲音，常用於踩落葉、咬脆餅等情境。有時屬口語/俚語用法，並非正式書面語。
explanation_english: “雪雪聲” is a colloquial Cantonese onomatopoeia used to describe a light, crisp, or rustling sound — e.g., stepping on dry leaves or biting something crunchy. It is informal and mainly spoken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落葉畀人踩嗰陣會發出雪雪聲。
