explanation_english: Refers to electricity or electric-related things; commonly appears in compounds (e.g., telephone, movie). In Cantonese it can be used as a verb meaning 'to call' (e.g., 電你), or to electrocuted/shock or figuratively to electrify/excite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日停電好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 jat6 ting4 din6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经常停电很烦。
examples.english_sentence: Frequent power outages are annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你到時電我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou3 si4 din6 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你到时候给我打电话吧。
examples.english_sentence: Call me then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影好好笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 hou2 hou2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很好笑。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is very funny.

mandarin_meaning: 電光火石（成語），形容瞬間或非常短促的時間；也可指事態發展迅速
english_meaning: An idiom meaning a very brief instant; happening extremely quickly or in the blink of an eye
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作形容詞或副詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「電光火石」原意指電光和火花互相閃爍，後引申為瞬息、一瞬間或事態發展極快，常用於描述時間短暫或變化急速的情況。
explanation_english: Originally referring to flashes of electricity and sparks, the idiom describes something happening in an instant or very rapidly; used to depict extremely short time intervals or swift changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽最後幾秒，電光火石之間就分出勝負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 zeoi3 hau6 gei2 miu5, din6 gwong1 fo2 sek6 zi1 gaan1 zau6 fan1 ceot1 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽最後幾秒，電光火石之間就分出勝負。
examples.english_sentence: In the last few seconds of the match, the outcome was decided in the blink of an eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩人一交手，電光火石之間就決定勝負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 jan4 jat1 gaau1 sau2, din6 gwong1 fo2 sek6 zi1 gaan1 zau6 kyut3 ding6 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩人一交手，電光火石之間就決定勝負。
examples.english_sentence: When the two clashed, the winner was decided in an instant.

mandarin_meaning: 電光石火（diàn guāng shí huǒ）：形容非常迅速、短暫，像電光和火花一樣一閃即逝
english_meaning: in a flash; lightning-fast; extremely brief or sudden
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 常用作副詞或形容詞
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容動作或事情發生得極快、時間很短，像電光或石火一樣一閃即逝。常用來表示瞬間完成或發生。
explanation_english: Describes an action or event that happens extremely quickly or briefly, like a flash of lightning or a spark. Often used to indicate something done in an instant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢電光石火咁完成咗件事，冇俾人有時間反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 din6 gwong1 sek6 fo2 gam2 jyun4 sing4 zo2 gin6 si6, mou5 bei2 jan4 jau5 si4 gaan3 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他電光石火地完成了那件事，沒給別人反應的時間。
examples.english_sentence: He finished the task in a flash, not giving anyone time to react.

mandarin_meaning: 电刑（以电致死的刑罚或因触电致死）
english_meaning: Electrocution (execution or death caused by electric current)
explanation_mandarin: 指以電流作為刑罰進行處決（例如電椅），或泛指因觸電而致死的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to execution by electric shock (e.g. electric chair) or more generally death caused by electric current.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為犯咗重罪，被判處電刑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 faan6 zo2 zung6 zeoi6, bei6 pun3 cyu3 din6 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為犯了重罪，被判處以電刑。
examples.english_sentence: He was sentenced to death by electrocution for committing a serious crime.

mandarin_meaning: 电力 / 电能
english_meaning: electric power; electrical energy; electricity (supply)
explanation_mandarin: 指電的能量或電力系統的供應與分配，常用於發電、輸電、用電量與電力設施等語境。
explanation_english: Refers to electric power or electrical energy, and the supply/distribution of electricity; commonly used in contexts of generation, transmission, consumption, and power infrastructure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家發電廠出咗事，成個城市可能會停電，因為電力唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 faat3 din6 cong2 ceot1 zo2 si6, seng4 go3 seng4 si5 ho2 nang4 wui5 ting4 din6, jan1 wai6 din6 lik6 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在發電廠出了問題，整個城市可能會停電，因為電力不足。
examples.english_sentence: The power plant had a problem, the whole city might lose power because of an electricity shortage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃投資更新電力基礎設施，改善供電穩定性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 tau4 zi1 gang1 san1 din6 lik6 gei1 co2 cit3 si1, goi2 sin6 gung1 din6 wan2 ding6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府計劃投資更新電力基礎設施，改善供電穩定性。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to invest in upgrading electrical infrastructure to improve the stability of power supply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅電力消耗好大，電費都幾貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 din6 lik6 siu1 hou6 hou2 daai6, din6 fai3 dou1 gei2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間房子的用電量很大，電費也相當貴。
examples.english_sentence: This house consumes a lot of electricity; the power bill is quite expensive.

mandarin_meaning: 电动（由电力驱动）
english_meaning: electric; powered by electricity
explanation_mandarin: 表示由電力驅動的，通常用作形容詞或構成複合詞，指機器或裝置靠電力運作。
explanation_english: Indicates something powered by electricity; commonly used as an adjective or in compound nouns to describe devices or machines driven by electric power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車係電動嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 hai6 din6 dung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车是电动的。
examples.english_sentence: This car is electric.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一枝電動牙刷，刷得乾淨啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 zi1 din6 dung6 ngaa4 seot1, saat3 dak1 gon1 zeng6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一支电动牙刷，刷得更干净。
examples.english_sentence: I bought an electric toothbrush; it cleans better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裝修嘅時候用電動工具會快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong1 sau1 ge3 si4 hau6 jung6 din6 dung6 gung1 geoi6 wui5 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 装修的时候用电动工具会快一些。
examples.english_sentence: Using power tools during renovations is faster.

mandarin_meaning: 电动牙刷 (diàndòng yáshuā)，用电力驱动的牙刷
english_meaning: electric toothbrush
explanation_mandarin: 一种靠电力或充电马达驱动的牙刷，通常有可更换的刷头，能提高清洁效果。
explanation_english: A toothbrush powered by electricity or a rechargeable motor, usually with replaceable brush heads to improve cleaning effectiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買部電動牙刷，但唔知邊隻好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bou6 din6 dung6 ngaa4 caat3, daan6 m4 zi1 bin1 zek3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一把电动牙刷，但不知道哪一款好。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy an electric toothbrush, but I don't know which model is good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得幫你部電動牙刷換個刷頭，建議每三個月換一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 bong1 nei5 bou6 din6 dung6 ngaa4 caat3 wun6 go3 caat3 tau4, gin3 ji5 mui5 saam1 go3 jyut6 wun6 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得帮你的电动牙刷换刷头，建议每三个月换一次。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to replace the brush head of your electric toothbrush; it's recommended to change it every three months.

mandarin_meaning: 电动车
english_meaning: electric vehicle / electric car / e-bike
explanation_mandarin: 指以電力驅動的車輛，範圍包括電動汽車、電動單車（電動自行車）或電動滑板車等，常用於短途出行或代替傳統燃油車。
explanation_english: Refers to vehicles powered by electricity, including electric cars, electric bicycles/scooters, and other electric personal vehicles. Often used for short-distance travel or as alternatives to conventional fuel vehicles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買部電動車，但唔知邊款好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bou6 din6 dung6 ce1, daan6 m4 zi1 bin1 fun2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買一輛電動車，但不知道哪款好。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy an electric vehicle, but I don't know which model is good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電動車喺市區行得方便，但要注意停車位同充電問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 dung6 ce1 hai2 si5 keoi1 hang4 dak1 fong1 bin6, daan6 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 ting4 ce1 wai2 tung4 cung1 din6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电动车在市区行驶很方便，但要注意停车位和充电问题。
examples.english_sentence: Electric vehicles are convenient for getting around the city, but you need to watch out for parking spaces and charging issues.

mandarin_meaning: 电势（电位）；表示单位电荷在某一点具有的电势能，常用于讨论电压和电场。
english_meaning: electric potential; the electric potential energy per unit charge at a point, often discussed in terms of voltage or potential difference.
explanation_mandarin: 电势描述在电场中某一点上单位电荷所具有的电势能大小。两点之間的電勢差決定了電流和電位能的變化。
explanation_english: Electric potential describes the amount of potential energy per unit charge at a point in an electric field. The potential difference between two points determines current flow and changes in electric potential energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電池嘅電勢好高，唔好亂拎佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 ci4 ge3 din6 sai3 hou2 gou1, m4 hou2 lyun6 ling1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电池的电势很高，别随便拿它。
examples.english_sentence: This battery has a high electric potential; don't pick it up carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺電路入面，電勢差會決定電流嘅方向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 din6 lou6 jap6 min6, din6 sai3 caa1 wui5 kyut3 ding6 din6 lau4 ge3 fong1 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在电路中，电势差会决定电流的方向。
examples.english_sentence: In a circuit, the potential difference determines the direction of current.

mandarin_meaning: 电汇
english_meaning: telegraphic transfer; wire transfer; bank transfer
explanation_mandarin: 透過銀行或金融機構以電訊方式將款項從一個賬戶轉到另一個賬戶的付款方式，常用於國際或跨行匯款。
explanation_english: A method of transferring money electronically through banks or financial institutions (wire transfer), commonly used for domestic interbank transfers and international payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經用銀行電匯咗嗰筆款項畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 jung6 ngan4 hong4 din6 wai6 zo2 go2 bat1 fun2 hong6 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经用银行电汇了那笔款项给他。
examples.english_sentence: I already wired that payment to him via bank transfer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要求所有外國供應商用電匯收款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 so2 jau5 ngoi6 gwok3 gung1 jing3 soeng1 jung6 din6 wai6 sau1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求所有外国供应商用电汇收款。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires all foreign suppliers to receive payments by wire transfer.

mandarin_meaning: 电台
english_meaning: radio station; radio (transmitter/equipment)
explanation_mandarin: 指以無線電波或其他方式向公眾廣播聲音節目或信號的機構或頻道；有時也指發射或接收電磁波的設備或台站。
explanation_english: An organization or channel that broadcasts audio programs to the public using radio waves; can also refer to a radio transmitter, station, or related equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日朝早都會聽一個電台節目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 wui5 teng1 jat1 go3 din6 toi4 zit3 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天早上都會聽一個電台節目。
examples.english_sentence: I listen to a radio program every morning.

mandarin_meaning: 電子商務
english_meaning: e-commerce; electronic commerce
explanation_mandarin: 「電商」是「電子商務」的縮寫，指通過互聯網進行商品或服務的買賣、交易及相關商業活動。
explanation_english: Abbreviation of "electronic commerce"; refers to buying and selling goods or services and related commercial activities carried out over the internet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多小公司都做緊電商，因為咁樣可以慳成本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 siu2 gung1 si1 dou1 zou6 gan2 din6 soeng1, jan1 wai6 gam2 joeng6 ho2 ji5 haan2 sing4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多小公司都在做電商，因為這樣可以節省成本。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many small companies run e-commerce because it can save costs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇做過電商平台嘅推廣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 din6 soeng1 ping4 toi4 ge3 teoi1 gwong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有做過電商平台的推廣？
examples.english_sentence: Have you ever done marketing for an e-commerce platform?

mandarin_meaning: 摩托车
english_meaning: motorcycle / motorbike
explanation_mandarin: 指以電力或內燃機為動力的兩輪或三輪機動車輛，常用於短途代步。
explanation_english: A motorized two- or three-wheeled vehicle powered by electricity or an internal combustion engine, commonly used for short-distance transport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買部電單車，返工就方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bou6 din6 daan1 ce1, faan1 gung1 zau6 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一部摩托车，上下班就方便多了。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a motorcycle; commuting to work will be much more convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰架電單車係唔係你嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaa3 din6 daan1 ce1 hai6 m4 hai6 nei5 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆摩托车是不是你的？
examples.english_sentence: Is that motorcycle yours?

mandarin_meaning: 电器 (diànqì)
english_meaning: electrical appliance; electrical device
explanation_mandarin: 使用电力的器具或设备，例如电视、冰箱、洗衣机等家用或工业用电器。
explanation_english: Devices or appliances that operate using electricity, such as televisions, refrigerators, washing machines, and other household or industrial electrical equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企啲電器差唔多要更新喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 di1 din6 hei3 caa1 m4 do1 jiu3 gang1 san1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的電器差不多要更新了。
examples.english_sentence: The electrical appliances at home almost need to be replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖專門賣廚房電器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 zyun1 mun4 maai6 cyu4 fong4 din6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店專門賣廚房電器。
examples.english_sentence: This shop specializes in selling kitchen appliances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買電器記得留意保養期同埋能源標籤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 din6 hei3 gei3 dak1 lau4 ji3 bou2 joeng5 kei4 tung4 maai4 nang4 jyun4 biu1 cim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買電器記得注意保養期和能源標籤。
examples.english_sentence: When buying electrical appliances, remember to pay attention to the warranty and the energy label.

mandarin_meaning: 电器店；家电店
english_meaning: electronics shop; electrical appliance store
explanation_mandarin: 指出售家用或商用电器（如电視、冰箱、微波炉、電飯煲等）的零售商店，香港常見的街舖或商場店鋪用語。
explanation_english: A retail shop that sells electrical appliances (e.g., TVs, refrigerators, microwaves, rice cookers); commonly used in Hong Kong to refer to street shops or mall stores selling household electronics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺旺角搵到間好平嘅電器舖，買咗部微波爐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 wong6 gok3 wan2 dou3 gaan1 hou2 peng4 ge3 din6 hei3 pou3, maai5 zo2 bou6 mei4 bo1 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在旺角找到一家很便宜的电器店，買了一台微波炉。
examples.english_sentence: I found a cheap electronics shop in Mong Kok and bought a microwave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間電器舖專賣廚房電器同小家電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 din6 hei3 pou3 zyun1 maai6 cyu4 fong4 din6 hei3 tung4 siu2 gaa1 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家电器店专门卖厨房电器和小家电。
examples.english_sentence: This electronics shop specializes in kitchen appliances and small household appliances.

mandarin_meaning: 電報（diànbào）
english_meaning: telegram; telegraph message
explanation_mandarin: 電報是通過電報系統傳送的書面消息，過去常用於長距離、緊急或正式通知，隨著電話與網路普及而逐漸少用。
explanation_english: A telegram is a written message transmitted via the telegraph system, historically used for long-distance, urgent, or formal notifications; its use declined with the advent of telephone and internet communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺郵局寄咗封電報畀阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 hai2 jau4 guk6 gei3 zo2 fung1 din6 bou3 bei2 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在郵局寄了一封電報給媽媽。
examples.english_sentence: I just sent a telegram to my mom at the post office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時人哋結婚或者喪禮會用電報通知親友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 jan4 dei6 git3 fan1 waak6 ze2 song1 lai5 wui5 jung6 din6 bou3 tung1 zi1 can1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人們在結婚或喪禮時會用電報通知親友。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people used telegrams to inform relatives and friends about weddings or funerals.

mandarin_meaning: 电报机
english_meaning: telegraph machine; teleprinter
explanation_mandarin: 用于发送电报或摩斯电码的机器，过去用于远距离文字通信，现大多被电话、传真和电子邮件等替代。
explanation_english: A machine used to send telegraphs or Morse code for long-distance text communication; largely obsolete today and replaced by telephone, fax, email, and digital messaging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 博物館入面展出一部舊式電報機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 zin2 ceot1 jat1 bou6 gau6 sik1 din6 bou3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 博物馆里展出一台旧式电报机。
examples.english_sentence: The museum has an old-fashioned telegraph machine on display.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經淘汰電報機，全部改用電郵同即時通訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 tou4 taai3 din6 bou3 gei1, cyun4 bou6 goi2 jung6 din6 jau4 tung4 zik1 si4 tung1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已经淘汰电报机，全部改用电邮和即时通讯。
examples.english_sentence: The company has phased out telegraph machines and now uses email and instant messaging.

mandarin_meaning: 电场（物理学）
english_meaning: electric field
explanation_mandarin: 指电荷在空间中产生的电力作用区域，用来描述电力对单位正电荷所产生的力。常用于物理学和电磁学的讨论与计算中。
explanation_english: The region of space around electric charges where electric forces can be felt; it describes the force exerted per unit positive charge at a point. Commonly used in physics and electromagnetism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個實驗入面，我哋要量度電場嘅強度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 loeng4 dou6 din6 coeng4 ge3 koeng4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个实验中，我们需要测量电场的强度。
examples.english_sentence: In this experiment, we need to measure the strength of the electric field.

mandarin_meaning: 电压
english_meaning: voltage
explanation_mandarin: 指兩點之間的電位差，決定電流的驅動力，單位通常為伏特（V）。
explanation_english: The electric potential difference between two points, which drives electric current; measured in volts (V).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電器需要高電壓先可以運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 hei3 seoi1 jiu3 gou1 din6 ngaat3 sin1 ho2 ji5 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台電器需要高電壓才能運作。
examples.english_sentence: This appliance requires high voltage to operate.

mandarin_meaning: 电子 (diànzǐ)：指物理學上的電子（基本帶負電的粒子），或作為前綴/形容詞表示「電子的、以電子方式的」，如電子郵件、電子產品。
english_meaning: electron; electronic — refers to the subatomic particle or used as an adjective/prefix meaning 'electronic' (e.g. electronic mail, electronic device).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞(作前綴)
explanation_mandarin: 「電子」可以指一種帶負電的基本粒子（電子），也常用來表示以電子技術或以電腦/網絡形式存在的事物，如電子郵件、電子產品、電子支付等。
explanation_english: “電子” can mean the negatively charged elementary particle (electron), and is commonly used as a descriptor/prefix meaning things that are electronic or exist in electronic/digital form, such as email, electronic devices, or e-payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱收到一封電子郵件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sau1 dou3 jat1 fung1 din6 zi2 jau4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚收到一封电子邮件。
examples.english_sentence: I just received an email.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部係最新嘅電子產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hai6 zeoi3 san1 ge3 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部是最新的电子产品。
examples.english_sentence: This is the latest electronic product.

mandarin_meaning: 电子烟的吸嘴/一次性电子烟（俗称）
english_meaning: e-cigarette mouthpiece / disposable vape (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俚語，通常指電子煙的吸嘴或整支一次性電子煙，特別是外形或使用方式像「奶嘴」的那類產品，也可泛指電子煙裝置。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term referring to the mouthpiece of an e-cigarette or the whole disposable vape device (especially those resembling a 'nipple' or pod). It is used colloquially to mean a vape or vape mouthpiece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家用緊電子奶咀定係傳統香煙？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 jung6 gan2 din6 zi2 naai5 zeoi2 ding6 hai6 cyun4 tung2 hoeng1 jin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在用的是电子奶嘴还是传统香烟？
examples.english_sentence: Are you using a vape (e-cigarette mouthpiece) now or a regular cigarette?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲一次性電子奶咀好方便用，但唔環保。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 jat1 ci3 sing3 din6 zi2 naai5 zeoi2 hou2 fong1 bin6 jung6, daan6 m4 waan4 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些一次性电子奶嘴很方便用，但不环保。
examples.english_sentence: Those disposable vapes are very convenient to use, but they're not environmentally friendly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺佢袋入面搵到幾支電子奶咀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 keoi5 doi6 jap6 min6 wan2 dou3 gei2 zi1 din6 zi2 naai5 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在他包里发现了几支电子奶嘴。
examples.english_sentence: The police found several vapes in his bag.

mandarin_meaning: 电子奶嘴
english_meaning: electronic pacifier; (figurative) a digital device used to soothe or pacify (e.g. phones/tablets as 'digital pacifiers')
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面意思：帶有電子功能、用以安撫嬰兒的奶嘴或類似裝置。2) 引申義（口語/隱喻）：指智能手機、平板或其他數碼設備，被用來安撫或分散注意力（尤其是給小孩或用作情緒慰藉）。
explanation_english: 1) Literal: an electronic pacifier — a pacifier or similar device with electronic functions. 2) Figurative (colloquial/metaphor): a digital device (e.g. smartphone, tablet) used to soothe or pacify someone, especially as a way to distract children or serve as emotional comfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多家長用手機當電子奶嘴，畀細路成日睇片就冇咁煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gaa1 zoeng2 jung6 sau2 gei1 dong3 din6 zi2 naai5 zeoi2, bei2 sai3 lou6 seng4 jat6 tai2 pin2 zau6 mou5 gam2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多家长把手机当作电子奶嘴，让孩子一直看视频就没那么麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many parents use phones as electronic pacifiers, letting kids watch videos all the time so there's less fuss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院引入一款電子奶嘴，可以模擬心跳聲幫BB安睡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 jan5 jap6 jat1 fun2 din6 zi2 naai5 zeoi2, ho2 ji5 mo4 ji6 sam1 tiu3 seng1 bong1 BB on1 seoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院引入了一款电子奶嘴，可以模拟心跳声帮助宝宝入睡。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital introduced a type of electronic pacifier that can mimic heartbeat sounds to help babies sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話智能裝置係現代嘅電子奶嘴，令到人愈嚟愈冇耐性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zan3 nang4 zong1 zi1 hai6 jin6 doi6 ge3 din6 zi2 naai5 zeoi2, ling6 dou3 jan4 jyu6 lai4 jyu6 mou5 noi6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說智能裝置是現代的电子奶嘴，讓人越來越缺乏耐性。
examples.english_sentence: He said smart devices are modern electronic pacifiers, making people increasingly less patient.

mandarin_meaning: 电子层（原子中电子围绕原子核分布的层次）
english_meaning: electron shell; layers of electrons around an atomic nucleus (also can refer to layered electron distributions in materials)
explanation_mandarin: 指原子或分子中电子围绕原子核分布的不同能級或层次；在材料科学或電子結構中，也可指電子的層狀分布。
explanation_english: Refers to the different energy levels or layers of electrons surrounding an atomic nucleus; in materials science or electronic structures it can also mean layered distributions of electrons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 物理老師喺課堂上講原子嘅電子層。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mat6 lei5 lou5 si1 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng6 gong2 jyun4 zi2 ge3 din6 zi2 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 物理老师在课堂上讲原子的电子层。
examples.english_sentence: The physics teacher talked about the electron shells of atoms in class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個半導體材料有額外嘅電子層，影響佢嘅導電性能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bun3 dou6 tai2 coi4 liu2 jau5 ngaak6 ngoi6 ge3 din6 zi2 cang4, jing2 hoeng2 keoi5 ge3 dou6 din6 sing3 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个半导体材料有额外的电子层，影响它的导电性能。
examples.english_sentence: This semiconductor material has additional electron layers, affecting its electrical conductivity.

mandarin_meaning: 电子工程 (diànzǐ gōngchéng)
english_meaning: electronic engineering; the branch of engineering dealing with electronic circuits, devices and systems
explanation_mandarin: 以設計、研發和應用電子電路、半導體裝置、嵌入式系統和通信技術為主的工程學科。
explanation_english: An engineering discipline focused on the design, development, and application of electronic circuits, semiconductor devices, embedded systems, and communication technologies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學修讀電子工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 sau1 duk6 din6 zi2 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大学学习电子工程。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying electronic engineering at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目需要電子工程方面嘅專業知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 seoi1 jiu3 din6 zi2 gung1 cing4 fong1 min6 ge3 zyun1 jip6 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目需要电子工程方面的专业知识。
examples.english_sentence: This project requires professional knowledge in electronic engineering.

mandarin_meaning: 電子書
english_meaning: electronic book; e-book
explanation_mandarin: 以電子格式儲存，可在電子設備（如平板、手機、電子閱讀器）上閱讀的書籍或出版物。
explanation_english: A book stored in electronic format that can be read on electronic devices (e.g., tablets, phones, e-readers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家習慣用電子書睇小說，唔使帶好多紙本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zaap6 gwan3 jung6 din6 zi2 syu1 tai2 siu2 seot3, m4 sai2 daai3 hou2 do1 zi2 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在習慣用電子書看小說，不用帶很多紙本。
examples.english_sentence: I now prefer to read novels as e-books; I don't have to carry many physical books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司買咗啲電子書俾我哋學習新系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 maai5 zo2 di1 din6 zi2 syu1 bei2 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6 san1 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司買了些電子書給我們學習新系統。
examples.english_sentence: The company bought some e-books for us to learn the new system.

mandarin_meaning: 电子烟
english_meaning: electronic cigarette; e-cigarette; vape
explanation_mandarin: 指透過加熱含尼古丁或其他成分的煙油，產生霧化氣溶膠供吸入的裝置或產品。常被稱為電子煙或VAPE，雖有人宣稱可作減害替代，但仍存在健康風險和監管爭議。
explanation_english: A device or product that heats a liquid (often containing nicotine, flavorings, and solvents) to create an aerosol for inhalation. Also called an e-cigarette or vape. Marketed by some as a harm-reduction alternative, but it carries health risks and regulatory concerns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人開始改用電子煙，話係較少刺激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 hoi1 ci2 goi2 jung6 din6 zi2 jin1, waa6 hai6 gaau3 siu2 zik1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人开始改用电子烟，說是刺激性較小。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many people have started switching to e-cigarettes, saying they are less harsh.

mandarin_meaning: 电子产品 (diànzǐ chǎnpǐn)
english_meaning: electronic products; electronics
explanation_mandarin: 指使用電子學或半導體技術製造的各類產品，例如手機、電腦、平板、相機等消費性或工業用電子設備。
explanation_english: Refers to products made using electronics or semiconductor technology, such as mobile phones, computers, tablets, cameras, and other consumer or industrial electronic devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係最新嘅電子產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 zeoi3 san1 ge3 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是最新的电子产品。
examples.english_sentence: These are the latest electronic products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買一件電子產品，但想先睇下評價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 gin6 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2, daan6 soeng2 sin1 tai2 haa5 ping4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一件电子产品，但想先看看评价。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy an electronic product, but I want to check the reviews first.

mandarin_meaning: 电子秤 (diànzǐ chèng)
english_meaning: electronic scale; digital scale
explanation_mandarin: 用電子感應器或電子元件測量重量的秤。常見於超市、廚房、郵局等，用來精確稱重。
explanation_english: A scale that uses electronic sensors or components to measure weight. Commonly found in supermarkets, kitchens, and post offices for accurate weighing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市嗰部電子磅好準，唔使再叫人幫手估重量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 go2 bou6 din6 zi2 bong6 hou2 zeon2, m4 sai2 zoi3 giu3 jan4 bong1 sau2 gu2 zung6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市那台電子秤很準，不用再請人幫忙估重量。
examples.english_sentence: The electronic scale at the supermarket is very accurate; you don't have to ask someone to estimate the weight anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 電子計算機 (diànzǐ jìsuànjī)
english_meaning: electronic computer
explanation_mandarin: 指使用電子元件進行計算、資料處理和運算的機器。這是較正式的稱呼，日常生活中常簡稱為「電腦」。
explanation_english: Refers to a machine that uses electronic components to perform calculations, data processing, and computation. This is a formal term; in daily usage it is commonly shortened to "computer."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啱啱買咗部電子計算機用嚟做數據分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ngaam1 ngaam1 maai5 zo2 bou6 din6 zi2 gai3 syun3 gei1 jung6 lai4 zou6 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司剛剛買了一臺電子計算機用來做數據分析。
examples.english_sentence: The company just bought an electronic computer to do data analysis.

mandarin_meaning: 电子货币（以电子形式存在并用于交易的货币）
english_meaning: electronic currency; digital currency
explanation_mandarin: 以电子或数字形式存储和传输、用于支付与交易的货币类型，包括电子钱包中的电子现金、央行数字货币和加密货币等。
explanation_english: Currency that exists and is transferred electronically or digitally for payments and transactions; includes e-money in digital wallets, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), and cryptocurrencies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多商店都接受電子貨幣付款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 soeng1 dim3 dou1 zip3 sau6 din6 zi2 fo3 bai6 fuk6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多商店都接受电子货币付款。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many shops accept electronic currency payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇用過電子貨幣比錢買嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 gwo3 din6 zi2 fo3 bai6 bei2 cin2 maai5 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有用过电子货币付款买东西？
examples.english_sentence: Have you ever used electronic currency to pay for something?

mandarin_meaning: 电子邮件（电邮、电子信件）
english_meaning: email; e-mail
explanation_mandarin: 通過網際網路發送或接收的電子訊息或信件，常用於工作或私人溝通。
explanation_english: A message sent or received electronically over the Internet; commonly used for work or personal communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經寄咗電子郵件俾你，記得睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gei3 zo2 din6 zi2 jau4 gin6 bei2 nei5, gei3 dak1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经把电子邮件寄给你了，记得看。
examples.english_sentence: I already sent you an email; remember to check it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有冇人收到嗰封電子郵件？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 mou5 jan4 sau1 dou3 go2 fung1 din6 zi2 jau4 gin6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有没有人收到那封电子邮件？
examples.english_sentence: Did anyone receive that email?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司通常用電子郵件傳送文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tung1 soeng4 jung6 din6 zi2 jau4 gin6 cyun4 sung3 man4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司通常用电子邮件传送文件。
examples.english_sentence: Companies usually use e-mail to send documents.

mandarin_meaning: 电子锁
english_meaning: electronic lock; smart lock
explanation_mandarin: 安裝在門上的以電子技術控制的鎖具，可以通過密碼、卡片、手機、指紋或其他生物識別方式解鎖和管理，常用於住宅和商業場所以提升安全性與便利性。
explanation_english: A lock installed on a door that is controlled electronically; it can be unlocked or managed via codes, cards, smartphones, fingerprints, or other biometric methods. Commonly used in homes and businesses for added security and convenience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企換咗電子鎖，出街唔使拎鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 wun6 zo2 din6 zi2 so2, ceot1 gaai1 m4 sai2 ling1 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家換了電子鎖，出門不用帶鑰匙。
examples.english_sentence: I changed my home's lock to an electronic lock, so I don't need to carry keys when I go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電子鎖可以用指紋或者手機APP解鎖，好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 zi2 so2 ho2 ji5 jung6 zi2 man4 waak6 ze2 sau2 gei1 APP gaai2 so2, hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個電子鎖可以用指紋或者手機APP解鎖，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This electronic lock can be unlocked with a fingerprint or a smartphone app, which is very convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 电子宠物；掌上虚拟宠物（如Tamagotchi）
english_meaning: electronic pet; handheld virtual pet (e.g., Tamagotchi)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種手掌大小的電子玩具，內含虛擬寵物，需要餵食、清潔和照顧。香港常用語，源自90年代流行的Tamagotchi。
explanation_english: Refers to a handheld electronic toy containing a virtual pet that requires feeding, cleaning and care. Common term in Hong Kong, originating from the popular 1990s Tamagotchi devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲記得細個嗰陣玩電子雞嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 gei3 dak1 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 waan2 din6 zi2 gai1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还记得小时候玩电子鸡吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you still remember playing Tamagotchi when you were a kid?

mandarin_meaning: 口語用法，可能指電子煙（電子香煙）或指電蚊香／電子驅蚊器，需視語境而定。
english_meaning: Colloquial term that can refer to an electronic cigarette (e-cigarette) or to an electric mosquito-repellent device; meaning depends on context.
explanation_mandarin: 「電子香」並非正式詞彙，廣東話口語中有人用來稱呼電子煙，有時也被誤用或借稱電蚊香（電驅蚊器）。理解時要看上下文判斷指哪一種物品。
explanation_english: “電子香” is not a formal term. In Cantonese colloquial use it may be used to mean an e-cigarette, and sometimes is (mis)used to mean an electric mosquito-repellent device. Context determines the intended meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街度吸電子香，我都覺得唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 kap1 din6 zi2 hoeng1, ngo5 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上抽電子香，我也覺得不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He was vaping an e-cigarette on the street; I also felt uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個夏天好熱，屋企要開電子香先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haa6 tin1 hou2 jit6, uk1 kei2 jiu3 hoi1 din6 zi2 hoeng1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個夏天很熱，家裡要開電子香才行。
examples.english_sentence: It's hot this summer; we need to use the electric mosquito-repellent at home.

mandarin_meaning: 電子寵物（例如 Tamagotchi）
english_meaning: electronic/virtual pet (e.g., Tamagotchi)
explanation_mandarin: 「電子鷄」指的是一種手持式的電子寵物裝置（如 Tamagotchi），玩家需要餵養、照顧虛擬寵物。這是香港粵語中的俗稱，亦可寫作「電子雞」或「電子寵物」。
explanation_english: “電子鷄” refers to a handheld electronic virtual pet device (e.g., Tamagotchi). The user needs to feed and take care of the virtual pet. It's a Cantonese colloquial term, also written as "電子雞" or "電子寵物."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我成日帶住部電子鷄去學校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 sing4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 bou6 din6 zi2 gai1 heoi3 hok6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候我經常帶著電子寵物去學校。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little I often brought my Tamagotchi to school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家個小朋友成日顧住部電子鷄，唔肯做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 sing4 jat6 gu3 zyu6 bou6 din6 zi2 gai1, m4 hang2 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在小朋友整天顧著電子寵物，不肯做功課。
examples.english_sentence: Now the kid is glued to the virtual pet all day and won't do homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電子鷄係九十年代好流行嘅電子寵物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 zi2 gai1 hai6 gau2 sap6 nin4 doi6 hou2 lau4 hang4 ge3 din6 zi2 cung5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電子寵物是九十年代很流行的電子玩具。
examples.english_sentence: The Tamagotchi was a popular electronic pet toy in the 1990s.

mandarin_meaning: 电容（指电容器或电容值）
english_meaning: capacitance; capacitor
explanation_mandarin: 電容可以指儲存電荷的能力（電容量），或指用來儲存電荷的元件（電容器）。在電子電路中常見，用以濾波、耦合或儲能。
explanation_english: Refers to capacitance (the ability to store electric charge) or a capacitor (the component that stores charge). Common in electronic circuits for filtering, coupling, and energy storage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電路入面嘅電容要換。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 lou6 jap6 min6 ge3 din6 jung4 jiu3 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电路里面的电容要换。
examples.english_sentence: The capacitor in this circuit needs to be replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要計算電容值，要用公式 C = Q / V。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gai3 syun3 din6 jung4 zik6, jiu3 jung6 gung1 sik1 C = Q / V.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要计算电容值，要用公式 C = Q / V。
examples.english_sentence: To calculate capacitance, use the formula C = Q / V.

mandarin_meaning: 电容器（電容元件）
english_meaning: capacitor
explanation_mandarin: 一種電子元件，用於儲存電荷並在電路中釋放或平衡能量，常用於濾波、耦合、去耦和儲能。電容量的單位為法拉（F）。
explanation_english: An electronic component that stores electrical charge and can release or balance energy in a circuit. Commonly used for filtering, coupling, decoupling, and energy storage. Capacitance is measured in farads (F).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電容器壞咗，要換一個先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 jung4 hei3 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电容器坏了，要先换一个。
examples.english_sentence: This capacitor is broken; we need to replace it first.

mandarin_meaning: 电工（從事電力設備安裝、維修的技術人員）
english_meaning: electrician
explanation_mandarin: 從事電力設備、電線、配電系統等安裝、維修和檢查的技術人員。
explanation_english: A tradesperson who installs, inspects, repairs, and maintains electrical systems, wiring, and electrical equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企部電視壞咗，我搵咗個電工嚟修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 bou6 din6 si6 waai6 zo2, ngo5 wan2 zo2 go3 din6 gung1 lai4 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的電視壞了，我找了一個電工來修理。
examples.english_sentence: The TV at home broke; I got an electrician to come and fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓上突然停電，我哋叫咗電工上嚟睇下電箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 soeng6 dat6 jin4 ting4 din6, ngo5 dei6 giu3 zo2 din6 gung1 soeng5 lai4 tai2 haa5 din6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 樓上突然停電，我們叫了電工上來檢查配電箱。
examples.english_sentence: There was a sudden power outage upstairs; we called an electrician to come check the distribution box.

mandarin_meaning: 电弧 (diànhú)
english_meaning: electric arc; arc discharge
explanation_mandarin: 指在两极之间通过电离气体而形成的弧形放电通道，通常呈明亮的光弧。常见于焊接（电弧焊）、弧光灯以及电力设备短路或故障时；会产生高温并具有危险性。
explanation_english: A luminous arc-shaped electrical discharge formed through ionized gas between electrodes. Common in welding (arc welding), arc lamps, and during electrical faults; it generates high temperatures and can be hazardous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電弧喺焊接時好常見，但控制唔好會好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 wu4 hai2 hon6 zip3 si4 hou2 soeng4 gin3, daan6 hung3 zai3 m4 hou2 wui5 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电弧在焊接时很常见，但控制不好会很危险。
examples.english_sentence: Electric arcs are common during welding, but if not properly controlled they can be very dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 风趣
english_meaning: witty; humorous; amusing
explanation_mandarin: 有幽默感，言談或行為風趣，能使人發笑或覺得有趣。
explanation_english: Having a witty or humorous manner; amusing and able to make people laugh or find something interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好風趣，成日都講笑，令大家開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 fung1 ceoi3, seng4 jat6 dou1 gong2 siu3, ling6 daai6 gaa1 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很风趣，总是说笑话，让大家开心。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very witty, always telling jokes and making everyone happy.

mandarin_meaning: 食物链（指生物間以捕食關係連成的能量與物質傳遞結構）
english_meaning: food chain (the transfer of energy and matter through feeding relationships among organisms)
explanation_mandarin: 指生態系統中不同生物之間以捕食或取食關係為基礎，能量與物質從一級傳到下一級的關係結構。
explanation_english: Refers to the structure in an ecosystem where organisms are linked by feeding relationships and energy/matter is transferred from one level to the next.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海洋污染會破壞食物錬，毒素喺魚身上積聚，最後會返到我哋餐桌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 joeng4 wu1 jim6 wui5 po3 waai6 sik6 mat6 lin2, duk6 seon3 hai2 jyu4 san1 soeng6 zik1 zeoi6, zeoi6 hau6 wui5 faan1 dou3 ngo5 dei6 caan1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海洋污染会破坏食物链，毒素在鱼体內累積，最终回到我们的餐桌上。
examples.english_sentence: Marine pollution can disrupt the food chain; toxins accumulate in fish and eventually reach our dinner table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺生態系統入面，食物錬嘅每一級都好重要，如果某一級消失會影響整個生態平衡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 saang1 taai3 hai6 tung2 jap6 min6, sik6 mat6 lin2 ge3 mui5 jat1 kap1 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3, jyu4 gwo2 mau5 jat1 kap1 siu1 sat1 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 zeng2 go3 saang1 taai3 ping4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在生态系统里，食物链的每一层都很重要，如果某一层消失会影响整个生态平衡。
examples.english_sentence: In an ecosystem, every level of the food chain is important; if one level disappears it affects the whole ecological balance.

mandarin_meaning: （罕見香港俚語）通常作為貶義綽號，指行為笨拙或傻氣的人（詞源不詳）
english_meaning: (rare Hong Kong slang) a derogatory nickname for someone clumsy or silly (obscure origin)
explanation_mandarin: 「鴨朴」為香港粵語的罕見俚語或綽號，非正式用法。通常用來戲稱或貶低某人笨拙、傻氣或做事不靈光。詞源不明，可能借用「鴨」的形象作為比喻，實際使用範圍有限且帶有負面意味。
explanation_english: "Ngaap pok" (鴨朴) is a rare Cantonese slang term from Hong Kong, used informally as a nickname or mild insult for someone perceived as clumsy, foolish, or slow. The origin is unclear; it likely borrows duck imagery. Usage is limited and carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做鴨朴啦，講清楚先做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 ngaap3 pok3 laa1, gong2 cing1 cou2 sin1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當鴨朴，先把話說清楚再做事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act like a 'ngaap pok' — explain clearly before you do it.

jyutping: gai1 bei2 daa2 jan4 ngaa4 gaau1 jyun5
mandarin_meaning: 用暴力或恃勢欺凌、恐吓别人（粤语俚语）
english_meaning: To bully or intimidate someone with force; lit. 'a chicken thigh hits someone's tooth-sockets soft' — a Cantonese slang for overpowering or terrifying someone
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句廣東話俚語，字面意思是『用雞髀打人，連牙骹都軟』，用來形容以強力、暴力或恃勢欺負、恐嚇別人，或形容某人很兇惡、好欺負別人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning 'a chicken thigh hits someone's tooth-sockets soft.' It describes bullying, intimidating, or overpowering someone—often by brute force or by taking advantage of one's position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲黑社會喺度鷄髀打人牙骹軟，啲人驚到唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 hak1 se5 wui5 hai2 dou6 gai1 bei2 daa2 jan4 ngaa4 gaau1 jyun5, di1 jan4 ging1 dou3 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些黑社会在那里欺凌人，其他人害怕得不敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: Some triad members were bullying people there; others were too scared to make a sound.

mandarin_meaning: 妈妈（口語、愛稱）
english_meaning: mommy; mum; affectionate term for mother
explanation_mandarin: 「麻米」是香港口語/非正式寫法，常用作對母親的愛稱或幼兒對母親的稱呼。正字通常為「媽咪」或「媽媽」，但日常對話或社交媒體上有人寫作「麻米」。語氣親昵、非正式。
explanation_english: "麻米" is an informal Cantonese term used as an affectionate way to address or refer to one's mother (equivalent to "mommy" or "mum"). The standard writing is usually 媽咪 or 媽媽, but 麻米 appears as a colloquial spelling in everyday speech and social media. It is intimate and informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔話佢要見麻米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 gin3 maa1 mi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩說他要見媽媽。
examples.english_sentence: The child said he wants to see mommy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚返屋企記得同麻米講一聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 faan1 uk1 kei2 gei3 dak1 tung4 maa1 mi1 gong2 jat1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚回家記得跟媽媽說一聲。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to tell mom when you get home tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 傳呼機；在口語中也可泛指用來接打電話的裝置（如手機），或指經常打電話的人（俚語）
english_meaning: Pager; colloquially can mean a device for receiving/making calls (e.g. a mobile phone) or, informally, a person who makes a lot of calls
explanation_mandarin: 「CALL機」由英語 call 與中文「機」結合而成，原指傳呼機／呼機。隨著通訊設備改變，口語上有時也用來指手機或強調某人常打電話的特徵。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term formed from the English word 'call' plus the character '機' (device). It originally referred to a pager; in everyday speech it can also refer to a phone (device) or jokingly to someone who frequently makes calls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前醫生會用CALL機召喚值班醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ji1 sang1 wui5 jung6 call1 gei1 ziu1 wun6 zik6 baan1 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前医生会用传呼机召唤值班医生。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, doctors would use pagers to call the on‑call doctors.

mandarin_meaning: 在網路上玩（球類）遊戲；口語化指線上進行的球類娛樂（尤其指線上足球或模擬球類遊戲）
english_meaning: To play ball/sports games online; a slang term for playing online sports or ball-type games (especially online football/soccer or simulated ball games).
explanation_mandarin: 「NET波」是香港粵語的口語說法，結合英文「net」（網路）與中文「波」（球），用來描述在網路上進行球類遊戲或以球類為主題的線上娛樂活動。多用於非正式語境。
explanation_english: "NET波" is Hong Kong Cantonese slang combining English "net" (Internet) and Cantonese "bo" (ball). It refers to playing ball/sports games online or engaging in online ball-related entertainment. Used informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日淨係喺屋企上NET波，唔出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zing6 hai6 uk1 kei2 soeng5 net3 bo1, m4 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常只在家裡上網玩（球類）遊戲，不出門。
examples.english_sentence: He always just stays at home playing ball games online and doesn't go out.

mandarin_meaning: 麵包車司機；駕駛小型貨車從事送貨或搬運工作的人
english_meaning: a van driver; a person who drives a small van (often a delivery or moving worker)
explanation_mandarin: 「VAN仔」是香港粵語的俚語，用來指駕駛小型貨車／麵包車從事送貨、搬運或相關工作的司機或年輕男子。語氣口語化，視語境可帶中性或略帶輕視色彩。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term for someone who drives a small van (panel/box/mini truck) — typically a delivery or moving worker. Informal term used in logistics/delivery contexts; can be neutral or slightly pejorative depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個VAN仔喺街度送貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 van1 zai2 hai2 gaai1 dou6 sung3 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位麵包車司機正在街上送貨。
examples.english_sentence: The van driver is delivering goods on the street.

mandarin_meaning: （表示）開始/突然開始（做某事或出現某狀態）
english_meaning: indicates starting or suddenly beginning an action or state (equivalent to "start to..." or "burst into...")
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語（語態/補語結構）
explanation_mandarin: 「起上嚟」常接在動詞或形容詞後，表示動作或狀態的開始、突然出現或朝說話者/向上方向的變化，是口語廣東話中的語態補語或結果補語用法。
explanation_english: Used after a verb or adjective to mark the beginning or sudden onset of an action/state (often with a sense of coming on or upward/toward-speaker). It's a colloquial Cantonese aspect/resultative construction meaning "to start to..." or "to burst into...".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到消息就喊起上嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 siu1 sik1 zau6 haam3 hei2 soeng5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一聽到消息就哭起來。
examples.english_sentence: He burst into tears as soon as he heard the news.

synonyms: V 起身（口語中有類似「開始/起來」的意思）

mandarin_meaning: （不確定）此詞為廣東話罕見或地區性俚語，字面上可理解為“被燙/煮過的雞”；在口語中可能用來形容遭遇尷尬、吃虧或被整得很慘，但缺乏權威詞典的確認。
english_meaning: (uncertain) A rare/regional Cantonese slang phrase. Literally “a chicken that has been scalded/cooked”; colloquially it may be used to describe being badly embarrassed, taken advantage of, or having had a rough/bad experience. This usage is not well documented.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語（不確定 / 口語俚語）
explanation_mandarin: 此詞在公開詞典中非常罕見或無明確記錄。從字面上看為“被燙/煮過的雞”，但在某些粵語口語語境可能用作俚語，形容某人遭遇不幸、吃虧或被弄得很慘。由於缺乏可靠來源，以上解釋屬推測性、需要當地語料驗證。
explanation_english: This expression is very rare or regional and not documented in major references. Literally it reads as “a chicken that has been scalded/cooked,” but in some Cantonese colloquial contexts it may function as slang meaning someone who has been badly embarrassed, cheated, or had a rough time. Because authoritative sources are lacking, this explanation is tentative and should be verified with local usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事搞到佢好似㷫过焫鸡咁，面都紅晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: UNKNOWN
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事把他弄得很糟，臉都紅了。
examples.english_sentence: This whole thing left him looking like a scalded chicken — totally embarrassed.

mandarin_meaning: 轻轻地扒下（衣物或覆盖物）
english_meaning: gently pull off/peel off (something, e.g. clothing or a cover)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示以輕柔的方式把某物（通常指衣物或覆蓋物）扒下、脫下，多用作提醒或指示動作要溫和。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase instructing someone to remove or pull something off gently (usually clothing or a cover). Commonly used to tell someone to be soft and not use force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 换衫嘅时候要下扒轻轻，唔好太用力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun6 saam1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 haa6 paa4 hing1 hing1, m4 hou2 taai3 jung6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 换衣服的时候要轻轻地扒下，不要太用力。
examples.english_sentence: When changing clothes, pull them off gently; don't use too much force.

mandarin_meaning: 下流、下贱、卑鄙無恥（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: vulgar, low-class and despicable; an insult for someone behaving shamelessly or dishonorably
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（口語，貶義），有時可作名詞指人
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (pejorative); sometimes used as a noun (insult)
explanation_mandarin: “下流贱格”是粵語口語貶義說法，用來形容一個人言行下流、下賤、無恥或卑鄙，常用來罵人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese pejorative phrase describing someone as vulgar, lowly, despicable or shameless. Commonly used as an insult toward a person's behavior or character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係下流賤格，走佬唔理人哋！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 haa6 lau4 zin6 gaak3, zau2 lou2 m4 lei5 jan4 dei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是又下流又下贱，溜走不管别人！
examples.english_sentence: You're such a low-class, despicable person, running off and not caring about others!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日做啲好下流賤格嘅嘢，大家都唔想同佢合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zou6 di1 hou2 haa6 lau4 zin6 gaak3 ge3 je5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 hop6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是做些很下流下贱的事，大家都不想跟他合作。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps doing very low-class, despicable things; nobody wants to work with him.

jyutping: dung1 gaa1 m4 daa2 daa2 sai1 gaa1
mandarin_meaning: 把怒氣或挫折遷移到無辜的人身上；遷怒於人
english_meaning: To take out one's anger or frustration on innocent bystanders; to vent on someone else when the real target isn't available
explanation_mandarin: 表示當真正的目標或責任人無法發洩時，把情緒、責任或怒氣轉向其他無關或無辜的人。
explanation_english: Used to describe shifting one's anger or frustration onto unrelated or innocent people when the real target is unavailable; essentially 'taking it out on someone else.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿榮喺公司俾老細鬧完，返到屋企就東家唔打打西家，連無辜嘅鄰居都俾佢鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 wing4 hai2 gung1 si1 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 jyun4, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 zau6 dung1 gaa1 m4 daa2 daa2 sai1 gaa1, lin4 mou4 gu1 ge3 leon4 geoi1 dou1 bei2 keoi5 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿榮在公司被老闆罵完，回到家就把氣出在別人身上，連無辜的鄰居也被他罵了。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Wing got scolded by his boss at work; when he got home he took it out on others — even innocent neighbors got yelled at.

jyutping: dung1 gun2 lou2 caai1 mui4, saam1 (saang1) go3 sei2 (sei3) go3
mandarin_meaning: （俚語）形容結果很靠運氣、難以預料，帶有無奈或戲謔的語氣。
english_meaning: A slang expression saying the outcome is down to luck and unpredictable — often used with a resigned or humorous tone.
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是「東莞佬猜枚（猜硬幣）」，後半句用「三（生）個、四（死）個」的反差來強調結果隨機且風險大。常用於描述成敗全靠運氣、難以預測或輸贏懸殊的情況。
explanation_english: Literally 'a Dongguan guy flips a coin — three (lives) one, four (dies) one.' The phrase emphasizes that the result is random and risky. It's used conversationally to describe situations where success or failure is largely a matter of luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投標真係東莞佬猜枚，三生個四死個，唔好太靠運氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 biu1 zan1 hai6 dung1 gun1 lou2 caai1 mui4, saam1 (saang1) go3 sei2 (sei3) go3, m4 hou2 taai3 kaau3 wan6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次投標真的很靠運氣，結果難以預料。
examples.english_sentence: This bid is really down to luck — the outcome is unpredictable.

jyutping: dung1 gun2 lou2 coi1 mui4, hoi1 (hoi6) saai3
mandarin_meaning: （俚語）形容某些人說話或行為誇張、愛吹噓、亂來；字面上提到「東莞佬猜枚」，帶有地域和戲謔意味，後半句「開（害）晒」表示非常誇張或麻煩/惹事
english_meaning: (slang) A colloquial/joking remark implying someone (stereotypically a Dongguan fellow) is boastful, reckless or making a fuss; literally 'Dongguan guys guessing coins, so dramatic/causing trouble'
explanation_mandarin: 這句話帶有濃厚的口語和地域色彩，常用來諷刺或調侃別人愛誇張、亂說或惹事。『猜枚』在此可理解為隨意猜測、打賭或亂講的行為；『開（害）晒』則強調程度，意為『太誇張了』或『惹出很多麻煩』。使用時有時帶貶義或戲謔意味，需注意語境與對象。
explanation_english: This is an informal, regionally colored Cantonese slang used to tease or criticize someone for being flashy, boastful, reckless, or making a fuss. '猜枚' can be understood here as guessing, gambling or talking recklessly; '開(害)晒' intensifies the sense — 'so extreme' or 'causing a lot of trouble.' It can be derogatory or jocular depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講大話，真係東莞佬猜枚，開（害）晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 dung1 gun2 lou2 coi1 mui4, hoi1 (hoi6) saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天說大話，真是東莞佬猜枚，開（害）晒。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps bragging — truly 'Dongguan-lad guessing coins, so over the top.'

mandarin_meaning: 东莞腊肠（广东东莞一带风味的腊肠）
english_meaning: Dongguan-style lap cheong (Chinese cured sausage) — a regional variety of Cantonese sausage from Dongguan, Guangdong
explanation_mandarin: 指一种源自广东东莞地区的腊肠（臘腸），属于腌制、风干的猪肉香肠，通常味道偏甜并带有酱香，用于煲仔饭、蒸饭或炒菜中。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of lap cheong (Chinese cured sausage) associated with Dongguan in Guangdong. It's a cured, dried pork sausage with a sweet-salty flavor and savory aroma, commonly used in claypot rice, steamed rice, or stir-fries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有賣正宗东莞腊肠，好香呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei1 dou6 jau5 maai6 zing3 zung1 dung1 gun2 laap6 coeng4 , hou2 hoeng1 aa3 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有卖正宗的东莞腊肠，很香。
examples.english_sentence: They sell authentic Dongguan lap cheong here — it smells great.

cantonese: 东边鱼肚白，晾衫竹晒坼
jyutping: dung1 bin1 jyu4 tou5 baak6, loeng6 saam1 zuk1 saai3 cek3
mandarin_meaning: 早晨东方出现鱼肚白，预示当天放晴且阳光强烈（晾衣的竹竿可能被晒裂）
english_meaning: If the eastern sky shows a 'fish-belly white' at dawn, a bright/hot sunny day is coming (sun strong enough to crack bamboo used for drying clothes).
explanation_mandarin: 一句粤语的民间谚语。所谓“鱼肚白”指清晨东方呈现的淡白光，民间以此判断当天会晴朗且阳光强烈，因此晒衣服的竹竿可能会被晒裂。
explanation_english: A Cantonese folk proverb. "Fish-belly white" refers to the pale light in the eastern sky at dawn; traditionally this signals a clear, sunny (often hot) day — strong sun that can even crack bamboo poles used for drying clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到東邊魚肚白，晾衫竹晒坼，今日應該會好天，快啲拎衫出嚟晾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 dung1 bin1 jyu4 tou5 baak6, loeng6 saam1 zuk1 saai3 cek3, gam1 jat6 jing1 goi1 wui5 hou2 tin1, faai3 di1 ling1 saam1 ceot1 lai4 loeng6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到东边鱼肚白，晾衣用的竹竿会被晒裂，今天应该会是晴天，把衣服快点拿出来晾吧。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the fish-belly white in the eastern sky — the clothes-drying bamboo will crack from the sun — it should be a sunny day today; hurry and put the laundry out to dry.

cantonese: ‌东风雨怕西风，西风晴怕雷公
jyutping: dung1 fung1 jyu5 paa3 sai1 fung1, sai1 fung1 cing4 paa3 leoi4 gung1
mandarin_meaning: 东风带来雨，但遇到西风可能就会停止降雨；西风带来晴朗，但遇到雷雨又会改变天气。比喻事物容易变化、无常，或每种情形都有它的对立或克制力量。
english_meaning: A weather proverb: when the east wind brings rain it fears the west wind; when the west wind brings clear skies it fears thunder. Metaphorically, situations are changeable and every condition has something that can counteract it.
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句民間諺語，用風向與天氣的變化來說明世事無常、情況易變，或暗示每種有利的情況都有其相克的因素。
explanation_english: A folk proverb using wind and weather to illustrate the impermanence and variability of situations, or to suggest that every favorable condition has something that can counter it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老一輩成日話：東風雨怕西風，西風晴怕雷公，話俾你聽世事無常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jat1 bui3 sing4 jat6 waa6: dung1 fung1 jyu5 paa3 sai1 fung1, sai1 fung1 cing4 paa3 leoi4 gung1, waa6 bei2 nei5 teng1 sai3 si6 mou4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老一辈常说：东风雨怕西风，西风晴怕雷公，意思是说世事无常。
examples.english_sentence: The older generation often says: 'When the east wind brings rain it fears the west wind; when the west wind brings clear skies it fears thunder' — meaning that things are changeable.

mandarin_meaning: 抛媚眼；使眼色
english_meaning: to give a flirtatious or knowing look; to signal with one's eyes
explanation_mandarin: 用眼角或眼神向別人示意、打暗號或抛媚眼，通常是非語言的暗示或挑逗動作。
explanation_english: To use one's eyes (a glance, wink, or corner-of-the-eye look) to signal, hint, or flirt with someone; a nonverbal cue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都鍾意向人丢眼角，搞到大家都唔知佢諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zung1 ji3 hoeng3 jan4 diu1 ngaan5 gok3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是喜欢向别人抛媚眼，让大家都不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to give people flirtatious looks, leaving everyone unsure what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到老細向我丢眼角，我知佢想我快啲開始做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 lou5 sai3 hoeng3 ngo5 diu1 ngaan5 gok3, ngo5 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 ngo5 faai3 di1 hoi1 ci2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到老板向我使眼色，我知道他想让我快点开始做。
examples.english_sentence: When I saw the boss give me a look, I knew he wanted me to start quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 令人討厭；討人厭
english_meaning: annoying; hateful; obnoxious; causes people to dislike someone or something
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事令人討厭、可惡或讓人厭煩，多用於廣東話口語，用來形容討人厭的人或行為。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone or something that provokes dislike or annoyance; used to label a person or behavior as irritating or obnoxious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日吹牛，真係乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ceoi1 ngau4, zan1 hai6 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是吹牛，真讓人討厭。
examples.english_sentence: He's always bragging — really annoying.

jyutping: hat1 ji4 m4 lau4 gaak3 je6 mai5
mandarin_meaning: 乞丐不會把米留到隔夜（比喻貪便宜或急需的人不會把好處留到以後）
english_meaning: Literally 'a beggar won't keep rice overnight.' Figuratively, someone in need or eager for a bargain won't save benefits for later — they take advantage immediately.
explanation_mandarin: 本句原指乞丐不會把吃剩的米飯留到隔夜，延伸為形容遇到便宜或機會時會立刻把握，不會留待以後的人或行為；亦可指迫切需要者不會節省以待他日。
explanation_english: Originally describing how a beggar would not save rice for the next day, it is used figuratively to describe people who seize immediate opportunities or who, being in immediate need, do not save for later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今朝去打折區掃貨，真係乞兒唔留隔夜米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ziu1 heoi3 daa2 zit3 keoi1 sou3 fo3, zan1 hai6 hat1 ji4 m4 lau4 gaak3 je6 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天早上去折扣區掃貨，真是乞丐不留隔夜飯。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the sale section this morning and cleared out the stock — truly, a beggar won't keep rice overnight.

jyutping: hat1 ji4 zyu2 zuk1, m4 dang2 suk6
mandarin_meaning: 比喻做事急躁，不耐心，未等完成或结果就放弃（类似“心急吃不了热豆腐/欲速不达/半途而废”）
english_meaning: A proverb describing impatience — giving up or acting hastily before something is finished (similar to 'haste makes waste' or 'don't give up halfway').
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事太急或沒耐性，未等事情成熟或完成就放棄或倉促行事，可能導致失敗或效果不佳。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is impatient or acts prematurely — not waiting for things to be ready or finished, often causing poor results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢唔好做乞儿煮粥，唔等熟就放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 m4 hou2 zou6 hat1 ji4 zyu2 zuk1, m4 dang2 suk6 zau6 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事不要急躁，别在还没完成就放弃。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be impatient at work — don't give up before something is finished.

mandarin_meaning: 完了 / 到此为止 / 没得救
english_meaning: that's it; it's over; finished; (informal) game over / no way out
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語或俚語，表示事情結束、完蛋或已無翻身的機會。也可作感嘆用，強調「到此為止」「完了」。根據語境可能帶有消極或戲謔的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression meaning that something is finished, over, or hopeless («game over»). It can be used as an exclamation to emphasize that there's no going back or that the situation is done. Tone varies with context (serious, joking, or resigned).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你再遲到，老闆知道就交吉啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zoi3 ci4 dou3, lou5 baan2 zi1 dou3 zau6 gaau1 gat1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你再迟到，老板知道就完了。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep being late, once the boss finds out it's over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今次做錯，已經交吉，冇得救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 zou6 co3, ji5 ging1 gaau1 gat1, mou5 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这次做错了，已经完了，没得救。
examples.english_sentence: We messed up this time; it's over—there's no saving it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次活動到呢度就交吉，唔使再準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 dou3 ni1 dou6 zau6 gaau1 gat1, m4 sai2 zoi6 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次活动到这里就结束了，不用再准备。
examples.english_sentence: This event ends here — that's it; no need to prepare further.

jyutping: gaa1 tung1 dang1, dim2 hung4 dim2 luk6
mandarin_meaning: （字面）交通信号灯亮红灯或绿灯；（比喻）对某事或某人时而允许、时而阻止，即给“绿灯”或“红灯”。
english_meaning: Literally 'traffic lights, light red and green'; figuratively to give someone the green light (allow) or the red light (stop/deny), i.e. to permit or forbid / give mixed signals.
explanation_mandarin: 通常用作比喻，形容對某件事情或某人時而允許（綠燈）、時而不允許（紅燈），也可指給予模糊或矛盾的信號；在字面上則指路口的交通信號燈。
explanation_english: Often used metaphorically to describe giving permission (green light) or stopping/denying (red light) toward something or someone, or sending mixed/contradictory signals; literally refers to traffic lights at intersections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日畀我交通燈，點紅點綠，直接講清楚要我做啲乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 bei2 ngo5 gaa1 tung1 dang1, dim2 hung4 dim2 luk6, zik6 zip3 gong2 cing1 co2 jiu3 ngo5 zou6 di1 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別老是對我發出交通燈式的信號，時而紅時而綠，直接說清楚要我做什麼。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep giving me traffic-light signals, sometimes red, sometimes green — tell me clearly what you want me to do.

jyutping: dai1 tau4 cit3 juk6, baa2 ngaan5 hon3 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 一边低头做自己的事（或假装专注），一边暗中观察、打量或挑剔别人；含有虚伪、指责他人而不检讨自己的意味。
english_meaning: Literally 'keep one's head down cutting meat while watching others' — to pretend to be busy or keep a low profile while furtively watching, judging, or finding fault with others; implies hypocrisy or covert criticism.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人一方面忙於自己的事或裝作專心，另一方面卻暗暗打量、挑剔或議論他人，帶有虛偽或冷嘲的意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who, while appearing busy or keeping their head down, secretly watches, judges, or criticizes others — carrying a tone of hypocrisy or sneering observation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日低頭切肉，把眼看人，見到人有錯就講，自己做錯就唔承認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dai1 tau4 cit3 juk6, baa2 ngaan5 hon3 jan4, gin3 dou3 jan4 jau5 co3 zau6 gong2, zi6 gei2 zou6 co3 zau6 m4 sing4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是低头切肉，把眼看人，看到别人的错就说，自己犯错就不承认。
examples.english_sentence: He always 'keeps his head down cutting meat and watches others' — he points out others' mistakes but never admits his own.

jyutping: dou2 diu3 mou5 dik1 mak6 seoi2
mandarin_meaning: 完全沒有學問／知識（俗語、貶義）
english_meaning: completely lacking knowledge or education; utterly clueless (colloquial, derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 「倒吊冇滴墨水」是廣東話俗語，字面意思是連一滴墨水也沒有，用來形容一個人毫無學問、知識或常識，帶有貶義和口語色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally meaning "not a drop of ink even if turned upside down." It describes someone as having no learning, knowledge, or common sense — an insulting way to call someone clueless or uneducated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀咗咁多年書，但喺科學方面真係倒吊冇滴墨水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 zo2 gam2 do1 nin4 syu1, daan6 hai6 fo1 hok6 fong1 min6 zan1 hai6 dou2 diu3 mou5 dik1 mak6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讀了這麼多年書，但在科學方面真的完全沒有知識。
examples.english_sentence: He studied for so many years, but when it comes to science he's completely clueless.

mandarin_meaning: 把事情弄得一團糟；顛倒混亂（香港口語）
english_meaning: to make a complete mess; to turn things upside down (HK colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「倒吊砂煲」字面意思是把砂鍋倒轉掛起，常用作香港口語，比喻把事情弄得混亂或搞砸了。
explanation_english: Literally 'to hang a claypot upside down.' In Hong Kong Cantonese it figuratively means to mess something up or create a chaotic, upside-down situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成個計劃做得好差，最後真係倒吊砂煲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6 zou6 dak1 hou2 caa1, zeoi3 hau6 zan1 hai6 dou2 diu3 saa1 bou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把整個計劃弄得很糟，結果真的一團糟。
examples.english_sentence: He handled the whole plan terribly — in the end it was a complete mess.

mandarin_meaning: 身無分文；口袋空空（沒有錢）
english_meaning: penniless; broke; having empty pockets
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，字面意思是把錢囊（荷包）倒轉來看，表示裡面沒有錢。用來形容人非常窮、身無分文，語氣多為口語或誇張化的描述。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally meaning 'turn the money pouch upside down' to show it's empty. It describes being penniless or broke and is used informally, often with a humorous or exaggerated tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日出去食飯，月尾就倒吊荷包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 jat6 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6, jyut6 mei5 zau6 dou2 diu3 ho4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經常外出吃飯，月底就身無分文了。
examples.english_sentence: If I keep going out to eat, by the end of the month I'll be penniless.

jyutping: dou3 gwaa3 laap6 aap3, jau4 zeoi2 waat6 lei6
mandarin_meaning: 形容一個人說話油滑、善於花言巧語但不誠懇、不可靠（相當於“油嘴滑舌／口是心非”）
english_meaning: Describes someone who is smooth-talking, glib, and insincere — uses flattering or deceptive talk and cannot be trusted.
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，常用來形容人說話甜言蜜語、圓滑狡猾，但言不由衷或不可信賴。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase used to describe a person who talks smoothly and flatteringly but is insincere or untrustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要小心佢，成日倒挂腊鸭，油嘴滑脷，唔好信佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 keoi5, sing4 jat6 dou3 gwaa3 laap6 aap3, jau4 zeoi2 waat6 lei6, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要小心他，他經常油嘴滑舌、口是心非，不要相信他說的話。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful of him — he's always glib and smooth-talking and not sincere. Don't trust what he says.

mandarin_meaning: 把話全盤說出/洩漏秘密
english_meaning: to spill the beans; to blurt out everything
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俚語，通常指在酒後或情緒激動時不加保留地把事情、秘密或怨言全部說出來，帶有口不擇言、洩密或大吐苦水的意思。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase meaning to blurt out or reveal everything (often after drinking or when emotional). It implies spilling secrets or complaints without restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一杯酒落肚就倒泻箩蟹，將公司嘅事全部講晒出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 bui1 zau2 lok6 tou5 zau6 dou3 se3 lo4 haai5, zoeng1 gung1 si1 ge3 si6 cyun4 bou6 gong2 saai3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一喝酒就把公司的事情全都說出來。
examples.english_sentence: He starts spilling everything about the company as soon as he has a drink.

mandarin_meaning: 把心裡話或私事全部傾訴出來／把苦水全倒出來
english_meaning: to pour out one's heart; to spill one's guts; to complain at length or reveal private matters
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指把心裡的話、苦水或私人事情全部向別人傾訴或洩露，常帶有抱怨或訴苦的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning to pour out one's innermost thoughts or private matters to someone, often including complaints or lengthy venting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺人面前倒瓤冬瓜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 dou3 joeng4 dung1 gwaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在別人面前把心事都倒出來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pour out all your feelings in front of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺我度倒瓤冬瓜，講晒啲私人嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 dou6 dou3 joeng4 dung1 gwaa1, gong2 saat3 di1 si1 jan4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在我面前傾訴，把私事都說光了。
examples.english_sentence: He often pours out his troubles to me, telling all his private matters.

mandarin_meaning: 掃興的壽星；把生日氣氛弄糟的人（香港口語）
english_meaning: a birthday person who spoils the celebration; someone who ruins the birthday mood (Hong Kong colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 倒米壽星是香港粵語俚語，字面意思是“把米倒掉的壽星”。用來比喻在慶生場合掃興或弄砸派對的人。此詞帶有玩笑或貶義，屬於口語用法，具地域性。
explanation_english: 倒米壽星 is Hong Kong Cantonese slang literally meaning "the birthday person who pours out the rice." Figuratively it refers to someone who spoils or ruins a birthday celebration—i.e., a party pooper at a birthday. The term is informal and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期想幫佢慶生，但唔好搵佢好朋友嚟，佢上次已經係個倒米壽星，成枱人都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 soeng2 bong1 keoi5 hing3 saang1, daan6 m4 hou2 wan2 keoi5 hou2 pang4 jau5 lai4, keoi5 soeng6 ci3 ji5 ging1 hai6 go3 dou3 mai5 sau6 sing1, sing4 tou2 jan4 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下星期想幫他慶生，但不要找他那個朋友來，他上次已經弄砸了慶生，大家都不高興。
examples.english_sentence: We want to celebrate his birthday next week, but don't invite that friend—last time he was the birthday spoiler and everyone was unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: （儘管）表面上裝作⋯⋯但實際上仍然是⋯⋯
english_meaning: even if someone is pretending/putting on an act, it still (is/means) ...; (colloquial) pretendingly but nevertheless
explanation_mandarin: 「假假地」表示裝作、做樣子，與「都系」連用，強調儘管表面如何裝作，實際上仍是某種情況或事實，常用於口語或諷刺語氣。
explanation_english: “假假地都系” combines “假假地” (pretending/putting on an act) with “都係” (still/is), used colloquially to stress that despite someone's pretence, the reality remains the same. Often carries a mocking or dismissive tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢假假地都系話唔介意，其實心入面好介意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa2 gaa2 dei6 dou1 hai6 waa6 m4 gaai3 ji3, kei4 sat6 sam1 jap6 min6 hou2 gaai3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他裝作說不介意，其實心裡很介意。
examples.english_sentence: He pretends he doesn't mind, but actually he cares a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 裝無辜；裝可愛以逃避責任或掩飾真實意圖
english_meaning: to feign innocence or act cute to avoid responsibility or conceal true intentions
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容故意裝無辜、裝可愛或假裝若無其事，以掩飾真正意圖或逃避責任的行為（粵語俗語／俚語）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase describing the act of pretending to be innocent or acting cute to hide real intentions or dodge responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再假過賣貓啦，你做錯嘢要負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi6 gaa2 gwo3 maai6 maau1 laa3, nei5 zou6 co3 je5 jiu3 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再裝無辜了，你做錯事要負責。
examples.english_sentence: Stop pretending to be innocent — you made a mistake and must take responsibility.

jyutping: gwong1 tau4 lou2 daam1 ze1, mou4 faat3 mou4 tin1
mandarin_meaning: 目无法纪 / 无法无天（形容人肆无忌惮、无法无天）
english_meaning: utterly lawless; brazenly defying rules and authority
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人行為放肆、無視法紀或規矩，毫無顧忌、肆無忌憚。此處“无发（法）无天”應為“無法無天”。整句屬粵語俗語或俚語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression describing someone who behaves outrageously and without regard for law, rules, or decency. The part shown as “无发（法）无天” should be read as “無法無天.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日亂嚟，真係光頭佬擔遮，無法無天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lyun6 lei4, zan1 hai6 gwong1 tau4 lou2 daam1 ze1, mou4 faat3 mou4 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是胡作非為，真是目無法紀、無法無天。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps acting recklessly — truly lawless and without any respect for rules.

cantonese: 光棍仔教仔，見便宜莫貪
jyutping: gwong1 gwan3 zai2 gaau3 zai2, gin3 bin6 ji4 mok6 taam1
mandarin_meaning: 光棍（沒經驗的人）教孩子，看到便宜別貪小便宜
english_meaning: A proverb warning that inexperienced people shouldn't be relied on for advice (literally 'a bachelor teaching a child'), and advising not to be greedy for small bargains ('don't grab cheapness')
explanation_mandarin: 這句粵語俗語包含兩層意思：一是指沒經驗或不適合的人不應妄自指導（「光棍仔教仔」）；二是提醒人在面對看似划算的東西時不要貪小便宜，以免吃大虧（「見便宜莫貪」）。常用以勸戒聽信無經驗者和避免貪心。
explanation_english: This Cantonese proverb has two related warnings: first, don't take advice from someone inexperienced or unqualified ('a bachelor teaching a child'); second, don't be greedy for seemingly cheap bargains ('when you see a bargain, don't be greedy'). It's used to caution against listening to inexperienced people and against short-sighted greed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光棍仔教仔，見便宜莫貪，唔好聽晒冇經驗嘅人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 gwan3 zai2 gaau3 zai2, gin3 bin6 ji4 mok6 taam1, m4 hou2 teng1 saai3 mou5 ging1 jim6 ge3 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別完全相信他們，沒經驗的人別亂教；看到便宜不要貪小便宜。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe everything they say — inexperienced people shouldn't be giving advice; and when you see a bargain, don't be greedy.

jyutping: gwong1 gwan3 lou2 jyu6 zoek6 mou5 pei4 caai4
mandarin_meaning: 单身汉遇到不会“点燃感情／没吸引力”的对象（比喻感情上倒霉、遇不上合适的人）
english_meaning: A bachelor meets someone who can't 'spark' (i.e. an unsuitable or unresponsive partner) — used to say someone is unlucky in love or meets the wrong person.
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，形容單身男子遇到不合適或沒有吸引力、點不著感情火花的人，表示感情上倒霉或無緣分。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese saying that describes a single man encountering someone who cannot 'ignite' a relationship — i.e., an unsuitable or unresponsive partner; expresses being unlucky in romance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係光棍佬遇着冇皮柴，鍾意嘅女仔根本唔理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 gwong1 gwan3 lou2 jyu6 zoek6 mou5 pei4 caai4, zung1 ji3 ge3 neoi5 zai2 gan1 bun2 m4 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是光棍遇到沒皮柴，喜欢的女孩根本不理他。
examples.english_sentence: He's really an unlucky bachelor — the girl he likes doesn't even pay attention to him.

jyutping: gwong1 gwan3 m4 sik1 ngaan5 cin4 kwai1
mandarin_meaning: 单身的人不要错过眼前的便宜／机会；别过于挑剔，要把握眼前的机会。
english_meaning: A joking/colloquial saying meaning a single person shouldn't miss the immediate opportunity—don't be too picky, seize what's available now.
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的俗語，通常用來勸或戲謔單身的人把握當下的對象或機會，不要為了追求更好而錯失眼前的利益。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial proverb used to tease or advise single people to seize available opportunities (often romantic) instead of being overly picky and losing the immediate benefit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家都係單身，遇到鍾意嘅就把握住啦，光棍唔蚀眼前亏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 dou1 hai6 daan1 san1, jyu6 dou3 zung1 ji3 ge3 zau6 baa2 ngok6 zyu6 laa3, gwong1 gwan3 m4 sik1 ngaan5 cin4 kwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你現在也是單身，遇到喜歡的就把握住吧，光棍不要錯過眼前的好機會。
examples.english_sentence: You're single right now—if you meet someone you like, seize the chance; don't miss the opportunity in front of you.

mandarin_meaning: 表面功夫
english_meaning: surface-level effort; superficial work; window-dressing
explanation_mandarin: 指只做表面、裝飾性或形式上的工作或努力，缺乏實質內容或深入處理。
explanation_english: Refers to work or effort that is only surface-level or cosmetic—mere show or window-dressing without substantive or in-depth handling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰份報告只係光面工夫，根本冇深入研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 hai6 gwong1 min6 gung1 fu1, gan1 bun2 mou5 sam1 jap6 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那份报告只是表面功夫，根本没有深入研究。
examples.english_sentence: Their report is just surface-level work; there was no in-depth research at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府搞呢啲措施只係光面工夫，未能解決實質問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gaau2 ni1 di1 cou3 si1 zi2 hai6 gwong1 min6 gung1 fu1, mei6 nang4 gaai2 kyut3 sat6 zik1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府搞这些措施只是表面功夫，未能解决实质问题。
examples.english_sentence: The government's measures are just window-dressing; they fail to solve the real problems.

mandarin_meaning: 光鲜亮丽、整洁得体（常用于粤语，形容外表或打扮）
english_meaning: Well-dressed, smart-looking, neat and presentable
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人的外表或打扮光鮮亮麗且整潔得體，給人很體面的印象。屬於粵語口語用詞。
explanation_english: Describes someone's appearance or dress as smart, neat, and presentable. A colloquial Cantonese expression often used to comment on personal grooming or presentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打扮得光鮮企理，去到邊都好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 daa2 baan6 dak1 gwong1 sin1 kei5 lei5, heoi3 dou3 bin1 dou1 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是打扮得光鮮亮麗、整潔得體，去哪裡都很搶眼。
examples.english_sentence: He always dresses smart and neat; he stands out wherever he goes.

mandarin_meaning: 愛誇耀、裝腔作勢但實際能力有限或無所作為的人
english_meaning: a show-off; someone who pretends to be important or capable but is actually ineffectual
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語/俚語，通常帶貶義，用來形容愛吹噓、裝腔作勢但並無實際能力或成效的人。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial/slang term (usually derogatory) used to describe someone who brags or pretends to be important or capable but lacks real ability or results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度兜笃将军，講大話、吹水，做嘢又冇做成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 dau1 duk1 zoeng1 gwan1 gong2 daai6 waa6 ceoi1 seoi2, zou6 je5 jau6 mou5 zou6 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天在那裡裝腔作勢，說大話、吹牛，工作又做不好。
examples.english_sentence: He's always pretending to be important, telling lies and bragging, and he can't get anything done.

jyutping: gung1 bat1 lei4 po4, cing3 bat1 lei4 to4
mandarin_meaning: 夫妻形影不離；比喻兩個人或事物總是密不可分、在一起
english_meaning: Inseparable (literally: the husband doesn't leave the wife; the scale doesn't leave its weight) — describes two people or things that are always together
explanation_mandarin: 這句俗語用來形容夫妻或密切關係的雙方總是形影不離，也可泛指任何經常在一起、難以分開的兩者。
explanation_english: A proverb used to describe spouses or closely related pairs who are always together; more generally refers to any two people or things that are inseparable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日一齊出現，真係公不離婆，秤不離砣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 ceot1 jin2, zan1 hai6 gung1 bat1 lei4 po4, cing3 bat1 lei4 to4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常一起出现，真是公不离婆，秤不离砣。
examples.english_sentence: They always show up together — they're truly inseparable.

mandarin_meaning: 他媽的 / 該死（廣東話的粗口感嘆詞）
english_meaning: a vulgar Cantonese expletive used like 'damn it' / 'fuck' (an angry or frustrated interjection)
explanation_mandarin: 「冚唪唥」是廣東話粗口，通常用作強烈的感嘆或咒罵，表示憤怒、不滿或挫折。語氣粗俗，屬口語髒話，常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: “冚唪唥” is a Cantonese vulgar expletive used as a strong interjection to express anger, frustration, or contempt. It is coarse and colloquial, commonly heard in Hong Kong speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冚唪唥！啲錢又唔見咗！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ham2 fung2 long6! di1 cin2 jau6 m4 gin3 zo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他媽的！錢又不見了！
examples.english_sentence: Damn it! The money's gone again!

mandarin_meaning: 對某人及其全家發出的粗俗詛咒，字面看似祝福（全家富貴），實際為強烈的罵語，相當於「去你全家/你全家不得好死」。
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese curse directed at someone's entire family. Literally reads "may your whole family be rich," but is used as a strong insult similar to "damn your whole family" or "go to hell, your whole family."
explanation_mandarin: 「冚家富贵」是香港粵語常見的粗俗罵人語，通常用來表示極端憤怒或厭惡，並不是字面上的祝福。屬於攻擊性語言，不宜在正式場合使用。
explanation_english: "冚家富贵" is a common vulgar Cantonese curse used to express extreme anger or contempt toward someone and their family. It is not a literal blessing but an offensive disparagement. Not appropriate in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講大話，真係想同佢講句：冚家富贵！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 geoi3: ham2 gaa1 fu3 gwai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說謊，真想對他說：冚家富贵！
examples.english_sentence: He lies all the time. I really want to tell him: "冚家富贵!" (Damn your whole family!)

cantonese: ‌冬在月头，卖被置牛；冬在月尾，卖牛置被
jyutping: dung1 zoi6 jyut6 tau4, maai6 bei3 zi3 ngau4; dung1 zoi6 jyut6 mei5, maai6 ngau4 zi3 bei3
mandarin_meaning: 冬天若在月初到来，就卖被子去买牛；若在月末到来，就卖牛去买被子。比喻因时机不同而做出互相矛盾或错误的选择，或讽刺人见机行事反复无常、判断失误。
english_meaning: Literally: If winter arrives at the start of the month, sell quilts to buy oxen; if it arrives at the end of the month, sell oxen to buy quilts. Figuratively: used to describe contradictory or ill-timed decisions due to changing circumstances; criticizes inconsistent, short-sighted, or poorly timed behavior.
explanation_mandarin: 这句俗语用生活化的比喻说明时机对决策的重要性，指出因判断或时机错误而作出自相矛盾或得不偿失的选择。
explanation_english: This proverb uses a down-to-earth image to show how timing affects decisions, pointing out that bad timing or poor judgment can lead to contradictory or self-defeating choices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意好反覆，真係冬在月头，卖被置牛；冬在月尾，卖牛置被。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 hou2 faan2 fuk1, zan1 hai6 dung1 zoi6 jyut6 tau4, maai6 bei3 zi3 ngau4; dung1 zoi6 jyut6 mei5, maai6 ngau4 zi3 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意反复无常，真是“冬在月头，卖被置牛；冬在月尾，卖牛置被。”
examples.english_sentence: His business decisions are inconsistent — it's exactly the case of 'if winter comes at the start of the month, sell quilts to buy oxen; if it comes at the end, sell oxen to buy quilts.'

mandarin_meaning: 比過年還冷（誇張說法）
english_meaning: colder than Chinese New Year; extremely cold (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，用來形容天氣非常寒冷，誇張地說「比過年還冷」。通常用於日常對話中表示冷得異常。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe very cold weather — literally "colder than New Year." It's a hyperbolic way to say it's unusually or extremely cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日真係冬大過年，記得著多啲衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 dung1 daai6 gwo3 nin4, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 di1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真的比過年還冷，記得多穿衣服。
examples.english_sentence: Today is really colder than Chinese New Year — remember to wear more clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 冬瓜豆腐
english_meaning: winter melon and tofu (a simple homestyle dish/soup)
explanation_mandarin: 指以冬瓜和豆腐為主要材料的家常菜或湯，口味清淡，常見於中國各地的家常菜譜，夏天常用來解暑。
explanation_english: A homestyle dish or soup made primarily from winter melon and tofu. It is light and refreshing and commonly served in Chinese households, often enjoyed in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽整咗冬瓜豆腐俾我哋食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 zing2 zo2 dung1 gwaa1 dau6 fu6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈做了冬瓜豆腐给我们吃。
examples.english_sentence: Mom made winter melon and tofu for us to eat.

jyutping: dung1 zi3 ceot1 jat6 tau4, laap6 ceon1 dung3 sei2 ngau4
mandarin_meaning: 冬至日出了太阳，立春时会冷得连牛都冻死（民間天氣諺語）
